rows.name: Crypt
rows.short_description: This is not a video game. This is a psychological torture device. Do not attempt to play this game. You won't have an enjoyable experience. And that's intentional.
rows.description_html: If you've found this game by chance through Steam, I advise you not to play it. My name is Valefisk, and I'm a YouTuber. I made this game as a joke - it's not designed to be fun, but to be awful to play. And in this it succeeds. This version that has found its way to Steam is slightly different from the one in the original video. This one is beatable. Personally I think the way this game is best played is with you making someone else play it with no context as to what the game contains. It presents itself (successfully) as a real indie game until you really start to play it, so feel free to torture your friends with this abomination of an experience. Enter the Crypt. Retrieve the Essence and Make your Escape. The objective is - on the surface - simple. Steal the jar from the Crypt and then make your escape. The idea is easy, but finding all the keys wont be. Solve the Puzzles. Can you actually solve the puzzles necessary to access the keys to escape? Sure you can. Does the game include any actual helpful information as to how to solve them? Of course not. Trust your instincts, and not your eyes. Survive Him. You are not alone down within the Crypt. Someone or something is there with you - and it's never too far behind you. Escape! Once you've gotten all the keys, you can finally open the door to Escape...assuming you've done everything right. I mean, I put an achievement in for winning so it's definitely possible - perhaps you've simply missed a nasty prerequisite... Good luck. You're gonna need it.

rows.name: Dodge The Missionaries
rows.short_description: How long can YOU run from God?!
rows.description_html: Nothing gets the energy pumping like some banging music in a sweet ass venue, but what happens when the local religious folk rise up and revolt against the MetalHead movement and swarm you with the gospel? Play as 9 characters, 8 of which are based off of REAL PEOPLE on Twitch, and do your best to avoid the Missionaries and Bosses all while picking up illicit items to boost your score AND your speed across 3 completely designed and honed levels! Reach new heights and unlock any of the NEW 25 Achievements and keep track of your records! Features: Banging Music Tracks 3 complete sweat-inducing levels, one with a Blood Moon and Day / Night Cycle! 9 custom characters based off of REAL people 3 different bosses and 3 different Missionaries Multiple item pickups to boost speed, points, AND remove an enemy from the field! Highscore counter and Per Level score counter so you can flex on your friends 25 New Achievements! Fun environment and SFX to keep you engaged and entertained Satire GALORE!!! Credits: Big thanks to all who assisted in the development of this! We specifically want to thank the talented individuals who made their art and skills available for use, as we wouldn't have what we have without them! DavidKDB : Music Pixel_Poem : Level Assets WaltonSimmons : Level Assets Exuin : Level Assets Emmanuel Montero : Decoration / Interior Assets

rows.name: Once Human
rows.short_description: Once Human is a multiplayer open-world survival game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world.
rows.description_html: Join our Discord! About the Game Survive in the wilderness You wake up in the middle of nowhere. You'll have to brace yourself for the cruelty of nature (from monsters to lack of food); however, Stardust's influence does not restrict to living things, it also affects the soil and water. Eating polluted food and drinking dirty water will reduce your Sanity. When your Sanity drops, your max HP would drop accordingly. To eat or not to eat, it's a question. Fight against monsters Battle numerous enemies that are once human, and challenge bosses from another dimension to gain powerful items and ease Stardust pollution. You are not only fighting for yourself, but also fighting for the survivors. Customize weapons With about 100 gun blueprints divided into seven categories for you to collect and craft, every loot grants you something new. Did I mention accessories and gun perks? Right, they are the heroes here. If our current weapon cannot satisfy your need, you can add different parts and perks, upgrade your firearm to your heart's content. Build territory Use Territory Core to build a house of your own. You can keep a practical style, jamming everything needed in a small room; or you can design a townhouse with a patio, kitchen, garage… The best part is, you can relocate your territory any time you want! Find out the truth Delve into the truth of Stardust, find out where it came from, and what it wants. In the journey of seeking truth, you may feel alone, but you are never alone. There are several factions in the world, some can be violent and hostile, others might be friendly and helpful. Explore human settlements to learn their stories or exterminate bosses without leaving a name for survivors to praise, the choices are yours.

rows.name: Obedient Women
rows.short_description: This is the main game for accessing each heroine's story in Obedient Women.
rows.description_html: Featured DLC Obedient Women Episodes Compelete Set About the Game GAME CONTENT A variety of episodes, such as flirting or playing with a man, are featured in this game. This game is a visual novel. COMMON TITLE Obedient Women GENRE Adventure CONCEPT Unforeseen events occur in a housewife's life, the seduction of lonely women and relationships between couples, etc. A variety of events occurring in different women's lives is depicted. All of the heroines are enjoying their lives. But, each one has a hidden secret. The main character discovers their secrets and manipulates them to be obedient to him. They project a life of happiness in public, but actually reveal their humiliation and erotic pleasure in private with you. You are the only one who will know! GAME INFORMATION This is the main game for accessing each heroine's story in Obedient Women. You will need to purchase additional episodes as DLC to play each episode. More additional episodes of DLC will be added in the future.

rows.name: Skelethrone: The Prey
rows.short_description: This game is a challenging 2D action platformer with RPG elements inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Skelethrone: The Prey is a free prequel to the main game, setting the stage for the events that will unfold throughout Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona campaign.
rows.description_html: You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey. PROLOGUE KEY FEATURES: Metroidvania - Unlock unique upgrades for movement and combat to expand the world. Maintaining the game's progression requires you to use different relics, items and abilities. Challenging bosses - Test your skills against multiple bosses and other creatures from the Dark Ages. The game will constantly test your patience as you face challenging battles that require their own unique approach.. Exploration - The game features a huge world represented by a variety of hand-crafted levels. From fog-shrouded ruins, where undead corpses cling to any living being passing by, and shambling figures emerge. To the Sun-city that hides in the labyrinthine of an ancient tomb where an unspeakable evil lingers, long forgotten by mankind. AVAILABLE IN FULL GAME: Weapons and Equipment – Your character can be armed with bows, scythes, longswords, whips, pistols, rifles, and many more traditional weapons. More exotic weapons will also be available to you, so use any means to achieve success. Multiple Endings – Make key decisions along the way to determine Ericona's fate as you progress through the story. Non-linear exploration – Play through levels and bosses, discover side areas with more secrets and enemies to defeat. Combat galore - You must use an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons and equipment to repel a wide variety of enemies. Put your courage, skills, and resolve on display for them. 'Skelethrone: The Prey' is a free prequel to the main game, setting the stage for the events that will unfold throughout Skelethrone's main campaign. The story takes place a few decades before the events of the game's main campaign. Assume the role of Derek Ericona, a lord who escaped the persecution is now trying to get to the borders of the neighboring kingdom to resist the tyranny of Queen Aurora, but he is being chased and faces an uphill battle. Prepare all your skills to overcome all the obstacles and difficulties prepared for our hero. And now the hunt is on!

rows.name: Cage of Etha
rows.short_description: A story-oriented visual novel set in historical France. Play as Emile, a lonesome boy whose past has caught up with him. Witness as the choices he makes continue on a downward spiral…
rows.description_html: Haunted by his mother’s death, young Emile suffers under his father’s gaze. Until, one day, he finds solace in another who resembles her. But is this eerie resemblance a blessing or a mockery of memory? ❖❖❖❖❖ A story-oriented visual novel set in historical France. Navigate the world as Emile, a lonesome boy whose past has caught up with him. Play by his side as he struggles to find a voice in a home that offers none. Stay as his witness as the choices he makes continue on a downward spiral… Features A story driven visual novel with elements of psychological horror. Hand-drawn character art that fits the atmosphere of the game. Nonlinear narrative incorporating dreams and memories. Different endings based on player choices.

rows.name: Town of Salem 2
rows.short_description: A multiplayer online social deduction game for 7–15 players. Use deception, strategy, and teamwork to find the truth—or get away with murder.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Town of Salem, a gripping online multiplayer game of murder, deceit, and survival set in the quaint yet treacherous town of Salem. Immerse yourself in this thrilling social deduction adventure, where your strategy, wit, and ability to read others are your greatest assets. Can you uncover the truth before it's too late, or will deception lead you astray? Features: • Intricate Gameplay Mechanics: Engage in a complex universe with over 50 unique roles, each with its own objectives and abilities. From the protective Bodyguard to the deceptive Witch, choose your path wisely. • Online Multiplayer Mayhem: Battle wits with up to 15 players in online matches. Forge alliances, betray friends, and navigate through lies to maintain your survival. Each game is a new mystery. • Dynamic Social Interaction: Communicate with other players using the in-game chat feature. Persuade, deceive, and discuss strategies to uncover the roles of your fellow townsfolk or to conceal your own identity. • Customization and Variety: Customize your experience with exclusive bundles, themes, and pets. Enjoy endless replayability with roles, game modes, and player-driven scenarios that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging. • Strategic Depth and Team Play: No two games are the same. Your ability to adapt, strategize, and work with your teammates is crucial, whether you’re maintaining order or sowing chaos. Immersive Experience: Dive into the atmospheric setting of Salem, beautifully crafted with attention to detail. The charming visuals and thematic sound design enhance the suspense and intrigue, making every game an immersive experience. Community and Events: Join a thriving community of players from around the globe. Participate in seasonal events, special challenges, and community-driven projects to earn rewards and bragging rights. Critical Acclaim: Praised for its innovative gameplay and strategic depth, Town of Salem has captivated millions of players and critics alike. Experience the game that has redefined the social deduction genre. Are You Ready to Uncover the Truth? Download Town of Salem 2 now and test your ability to discern friend from foe. In this town, trust is a scarce commodity, and every decision could be your last. Welcome to Salem, where your survival depends on your ability to deceive or to see through the deception of others. Download Now and Let the Mind Games Begin!

rows.name: Stunt Legends
rows.short_description: Drift, speed and all sorts of stunts await you in this unique and innovative game. The realism of the details will envelop you until you feel the movement of the pistons in your bones. Stunt Legends is an explosion of colors and adrenaline. Speed and fun with no limits.
rows.description_html: Stunt Legends is a blast of colors and adrenaline, high speed and fun with no limits. This car stunt racing game lets you drive high octane number muscle cars. Explore British countryside roads freely and uncover every mistery of the city. Dive into the bright nature and cover your car with mud of offroad trails. Drifting, high speed and every sort of stunt are waiting for you, only in this unique and innovative stunt racing game. The realism of details will grab you until you feel the pistons moving in yout bones. Weekly updates will add new cars and events for unlimited fun in an ever-evolving world.

rows.name: AQRA Tenses [Learn English]
rows.short_description: Are you having trouble with English tenses? This game is specially designed to improve your memory in a short time.
rows.description_html: هل تواجه مشكلة مع الأزمنة الإنجليزية؟ تم تصميم هذه اللعبة خصيصًا لتحسين ذاكرتك في وقت قصير. يركز مفهوم اللعبة على تطوير ذاكرة المستخدمين بطرق جديدة تتميز بالمرح والمعرفة. بدون ذكر قواعد قواعد اللغة الإنجليزية ، تم تصميم هذه اللعبة لمساعدة الأشخاص على تعلم القواعد مع ضغط أقل. بالإضافة إلى ذلك ، هناك هدية في اللعبة ، 14 مستوى من لعبتنا التالية للأطفال والمبتدئين (AQRA Steps) لتعلم اللغة الإنجليزية. الهدية متاحة حاليًا بـ 14 لغة فقط (العربية والتركية والألمانية والهولندية والصينية واليابانية والبرتغالية والإسبانية والفنلندية والنرويجية والسويدية والإيطالية والدنماركية والفرنسية). يرجى ملاحظة أنك بحاجة إلى استخدام زر الماوس الأيمن لاستخدام رموز القائمة والمفاتيح.

rows.name: Fit Puzzle Blocks
rows.short_description: Solve a lot of puzzles in Fit Block Puzzle. Try to fit all the different shaped blocks on the grid.
rows.description_html: Get ready to relax and unwind with Fit Block Puzzle , a fun and colorful block-fitting puzzle game. Inspired by classic Tetris, this game challenges you to fit uniquely shaped blocks onto a grid that changes with every level. From rectangles to round grids, each puzzle brings a new, fresh challenge, keeping you engaged without being overly difficult. The game's gradual difficulty progression ensures that you'll be able to complete levels at your own pace without getting stuck for long. It's a perfect game for players who enjoy a calming, stress-free experience while still offering enough complexity to keep things interesting. The mechanics are simple—just move, select, and place the blocks using your keyboard, gamepad, mouse, or even touch controls. Best of all, no need to rotate the blocks! Key Features: Hundreds of levels with unique grids and block shapes Relaxing gameplay that's easy to pick up but keeps you engaged Customizable camera angles , switch between top-down and isometric views Flexible control options —play with keyboard, gamepad, mouse, or touch A colorful, dynamic background that you can change from the pause menu Every completed level unlocks two more , giving you plenty of puzzles to solve Whether you’re looking to pass time or unwind after a long day, Fit Block Puzzle is the perfect game to chill out with. Try it today and see why players are calling it 'simple, fun, and relaxing!'

rows.name: Pushing POPO
rows.short_description: This game is a simple and highly challenging 2D puzzle game for those who like to think but are too lazy to remember. By sharing stage codes, players can play the same stage even if they have just downloaded the game. Move the boxes in the stage and reach the goal to clear the stage.
rows.description_html: This game is a simple and highly challenging 2D puzzle game with a system similar to 'Sokoban,' in which the player moves boxes to secure a path to the goal. As you progress, gimmicks are added, such as 'unlocking a passageway with a key,' 'shooting arrows to destroy balloon objects,' 'disappearing blocks that disappear once you get on them,' 'transfer gates connecting two points,' 'elevating blocks that switch with arrows,' and 'interlocking tags that move another box together when you move a box. Gimmicks are added to the game. If you get stuck, you can share the stage codes set for each stage with your friends, allowing each of you to play the same stage regardless of your progress. This game is a fan game for the archer 🏹 Ieiri Popo of the Vtuber unit 'HIYOCRO'. BGM is provided by 'DOVA-SYNDROME', a music material site. Sound effect creation software 'sfxr' is used. [About the distribution of gameplay videos] No report is required when distributing gameplay videos. Please note that we are not responsible for any damage caused by the actual game play and distribution.

rows.name: Magical Girl Survivors: Prologue
rows.short_description: FREE DEMO features ,Play as the Magical Girl, constantly upgrade your magic, build skill sets, and fight the tide of orcs! 15 minutes of fast rougelike game!
rows.description_html: Magical Girl Survivors: Prologue is a bullet screen survival game in rougelike mode. FREE DEMO for Magical Girl Survivors. You play as a magical maiden, holding up for 15 minutes against endless orcs. Game Features [/] Three beautiful magic girls and a special costume to choose from (there will be more magic girls and costumes for the standard edition) Active and passive skills are no longer limited by slots, and you can even learn all active and passive skills! Fire, Thunder, Water, Blade, Dark 5 categories of more than 20 skills, different skills can buff each other! A variety of genres to choose from, blood rage build, thorn build and so on. Game mode Kill Orcs with magic to gain experience and upgrade dozens of active and passive skills in the 5 series of Fire, Power, Water, Blade and Darkness. There is interaction between different skill groups, and lower skills can also reinforce higher skills. Forbidden spells In the case of an orc siege where ordinary magic is not enough to break through, Magical maidens can use powerful forbidden spells, such as Mooncannon, Meteor Shower, and Blade Storm.

rows.name: Winged Raider
rows.short_description: Save the Kingdom of Daanco from the curse of Turkzu in Winged Raider! Unlock the story by progressing in this goofy roguelike 2D shooter. Fly around the Winged Castle, find new weapons, unlock abilities with colored wings, kill your enemies, and DIE?! Try not to die.
rows.description_html: Winged Raider is a 2D Shooter roguelike game where you navigate a castle that is crawling with goofy enemies and evil bosses. When you die you have to start back at the beginning, but the further you progress, the more story you unlock. Do you have what it takes to be the Winged Raider? Character Customization! -28 hats (some have multiple colors) -30 hairstyles in 8 colors -29 facial hairstyles in 8 colors -7 skin colors -12 body colors Guns and Wings! -9 guns (5 primary guns, 4 secondary guns) (You can carry one primary and one secondary gun) -6 wing abilities (different colored wings grant different abilities) Evil Enemies! -16 Different enemies -6 Bosses All enemy, gun, and wing stats are available to read about in the main menu! Check under the more button for item info (guns and wings) and enemy info. Info on bosses is unlocked under enemy info when they are defeated. The Kingdom of Daanco was saved thousands of years ago by a great hero. However, the Winged God stands to destroy everything. Turkzu has begun the attack of the Winged God and seeks to rule the Kingdom of Daanco under the Winged God. Save the Kingdom of Daanco from the curse of Turkzu! Your mission: -Infiltrate the Winged Castle -Defeat any who dare stand in your way -Eliminate Turkzu -Daanco is saved But one question still remains. . . Who is Turkzu?

rows.name: Magic: The Gathering Arena
rows.short_description: Magic: The Gathering Arena empowers you to discover your strategy, meet the planeswalkers, explore the multiverse, and battle friends around the world. Start playing for free, challenge your friends, unlock cards, and feel the magic of the original fantasy CCG!
rows.description_html: Magic: The Gathering — FINAL FANTASY Join your favorite FINAL FANTASY heroes, villains, and more for an adventure! These larger-than-life characters and epic, action-packed worlds are now in your deck. Cast spells and draw swords as you shape your Magic story. © SQUARE ENIX   TM & © 2025 Wizards. About the Game Welcome to the digital Multiverse! Magic: The Gathering is the original trading card game- and now you can download and start playing for free with your friends from anywhere! Magic: The Gathering Arena empowers you to discover your strategy, meet the planeswalkers, explore the multiverse, and battle friends around the world. Collect, build and master your unique deck that will become its own legend. Your battle is only the beginning; duel on stunning battlefields, and enjoy Arena’s game changing battle effects and immerse yourself in the game. Start playing for free, challenge your friends, unlock cards, and feel the magic of the original fantasy CCG! NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY Never played Magic before? No problem! Magic: The Gathering Arena’s tutorial system takes you through the playstyles so you can find your strategy and decide if you’re the type to overwhelm your opponent with brute strength, if subterfuge is more your style, or anything in between. Meet characters from around the multiverse and try out spells and artifacts that make learning to play the original fantasy collectible card game quick and fun. It’s never been easier to play Magic! Collect cards to build a deck that matches your personality, then master your strategy to battle friends and be part of the TCG that started them all. GAME ON(LINE) The original TCG is now digital! Explore the fantasy worlds of Magic: The Gathering Arena and build your deck, play a variety of game formats to collect cards, master multiple strategies, and hone your skills against friends or the AI. With multiple game formats like Draft and Brawl, 15 unlockable collectible decks, and explosive card combo effects: Your ideal Magic: The Gathering playstyle is at your fingertips! Show off eye-popping cosmetics like avatars, card sleeves, and pets and collect daily rewards to grow your collection and build powerful decks that reflect your personal strategy. CHALLENGE AND PLAY Duel your friends for glory or enter in-game tournaments for exciting prizes! With Draft and Brawl pairing, there is always someone to game with. Special in-game events offer exciting rewards, and with Esports qualifiers your Pro-Magic dreams are closer than you think in the Arena Premier Play League! Queue into casual battles to hone your strategy at your own pace, or battle in Esports qualifiers and frequent tournaments to flaunt your mastery. FANTASY AND MAGIC Dive into the fantasy planes of Magic: The Gathering and write your own legend through Magic’s immersive lore and vibrant card art. Find your path through the multiverse using only favorite characters and their most iconic spells and artifacts, or create a theme deck with a narrative that makes sense only to you. Your story is only just beginning! All prices inclusive of VAT. rows.name: The Riese Project - Prologue
rows.short_description: Some stories are better left in the dark. But some will find you. In Riese, echoes don’t always answer the same. A narrative FPP/VR experience about a past that refuses to stay silent.
rows.description_html: 🎮 Welcome to the prologue of The Riese Project A missing grandfather. A hotel with a past. Underground tunnels that refuse to stay buried. „I got you... Wait. I’ve seen this place before.” Anna returns to her family's old guesthouse in the Owl Mountains. Not for rest. For the truth. rapped in a room, with a fogged mirror and a phone call from her mother, she triggers a chain of events that lead straight to “Projekt Riese” — a real, unfinished Nazi complex buried deep beneath Lower Silesia. This is a free prologue of a narrative game where every click speaks. Every item means something. Every decision echoes. 🔍 What to expect? 🎙️ Anna speaks — you listen You’re not a silent shell. You’re the protagonist — sarcastic, stubborn, sharp. „Yesterday I was a quiet student. Today? A seasoned break-in artist.” 🧠 uzzles driven by context, not code Open grandpa’s safe, find a hidden map, match piano tones to underground valves. You think like Anna. You feel like Anna. That’s the key. 🌍 Real location, digital obsession Hotel Szyprówka, photogrammetry, Lumen, Nanite — but the spotlight isn’t on tech. It’s on touchable atmosphere. 🕹️ FPP or VR (OpenXR) Play your way: keyboard, controller, headset — everything works. The choice is yours. 🆓 Free. No strings attached. This is just the first chapter of a larger story. Leave feedback. Help us shape what comes next. 🎯 For players who: Want silence that hurts more than jump scares. PRemember “Gone Home”, “Firewatch”, “Ethan Carter” — and want more. Own RTX, but value truth in pixels over realism for realism’s sake. 🔓 Not a tech demo. A trial by story. The clock is ticking. Someone’s walking up the stairs. And the map doesn’t lie. „Be a bull terrier. Be a storm. Be Jodie Foster in ‘The Silence of the Lambs’.” 📥 DOWNLOAD NOW. Play. Review. Leave a trace. Help forge the full game. Because if not you — then who?

rows.name: The Doll's Window
rows.short_description: A horror exploration game that takes place in an underground labyrinth. Avoid malicious creations that are hungry for your soul. Depart from the nightmares that constantly haunt you.
rows.description_html: Alva follows a mysterious girl named Elma, who may be an end to their despair. Elma latches onto Alva, who holds the key to her release. Together, they try to escape the labyrinth lying under the pretense of a circus. Together, they try to find a way to be freed. ♢♢♢♢♢ A horror exploration game that takes place in an underground labyrinth. Navigate your way through various traps and mazes. Dodge malicious creations that are perpetually hungry. Depart from the nightmares that constantly haunt you. Features Advance through different levels of the labyrinth. Uncover stories and converse with others to survive. Solve puzzles by finding bits of what's past. Find another puzzle within a puzzle. Try and stop the memories that torment you. Avoid those who are eager to consume your soul. Controls Arrow keys — Movement Enter or Space bar — Interact Save — Interact with Rabbit Dolls X or Escape — Check Inventory W or F12 — Return to Title screen F5 — Toggle Fullscreen/Window modes F1 — View/Change display settings To use Steam Overlay, please change the screenshot key settings to another key other than F12, F5, or F1.

rows.name: MITTIN: Clean Flat Surfaces
rows.short_description: Learn how to clean a variety of surfaces in the kitchen and living room of your home with MITTIN: Clean Flat Surfaces. MITTIN is a library of dynamic modules that foster the development of independent living skills in the home and community.
rows.description_html: The Michigan Transition To Independence (MITTIN) is a virtual life skills library of dynamic modules that foster the development of independent living skills in the home and community. Designed to support special education transition-related instruction, these virtual resources are free and available to parents, schools, educators, and students in Michigan. MITTIN is a partnership of the Michigan Association of Administrators of Special Education (MAASE), Michigan Council for Exceptional Children (MCEC), Great Lakes Reality Labs (GLRL), and Public Policy Associates (PPA). The topic covered in this game is'Cleaning Flat Surfaces', where the student can learn how to clean a variety of surfaces in the kitchen and living room of their home.

rows.name: Tower Survivors
rows.short_description: Fight an endless horde of evil minions and survive as long as you can. Collect loot and purchase new upgrades and magic abilities. Summon allies to stand along side you and survive the horde!
rows.description_html: The Story The evil Necromancer has escaped the tower, and overrun the kingdom with their vile minions! You are the last surviving elf in the kingdom, and they will hunt you down as long as you live. All hope is, however, not lost! Collect gold to summon defenders. Use them to protect the portal, and if you can keep it open for 5 minutes your armies can retake the kingdom and capture the Necromancer again. Join our Discord to make suggestions or report bugs!

rows.name: Nameless - The Departed Cycle
rows.short_description: Follow the red star to the Umbral Forest and unravel the mysteries within, in this gay, romantic, dark fantasy visual novel.
rows.description_html: Something lurks in the Umbral Forest, its wicked tendrils snaking out to reshape the very woods themselves. Is this the beast Israh Almasi seeks to hunt and slay for the sake of his dying son? Or something even darker and more sinister than he ever could have imagined? Meanwhile, a mysterious man has made himself at home at Israh’s campsite. He calls himself Nameless… and he only comes at night. Follow the red star to the Umbral Forest and unravel the mysteries within. Nameless: The Departed Cycle is a dark fantasy/horror visual novel featuring a prominent male/male romance. Make choices to determine Israh's fate, and strive to survive -- perhaps even slay -- the monster stalking the Umbral Forest. A magical dark fantasy narrative comprised of over 20,000+ words. Make choices to determine the fates of Israh and Nameless, and unlock five unique endings -- four bad, and one 'true.' Wholly original artwork including six backgrounds, three unlockable in-game illustrations, and five unique character sprites with multiple variations. A rich audio experience, including an original soundtrack which sets the tone with multiple haunting and fantastical scores, plus partial and key line voice acting for the leading characters. Gay men.

rows.name: Light of Alariya
rows.short_description: Light of Alariya is an open-world, third-person, exploration puzzle game in which you traverse ancient alien temples and ruins to restore the power of the stars and awaken your sleeping civilization.
rows.description_html: Light of Alariya is an open-world, third-person, exploration puzzle game made by students at SMU Guildhall. In Light of Alariya , you traverse the ancient alien temples and ruins to restore the power of the stars and awaken your sleeping civilization. Alariya was once a quiet and peaceful desert town. Soothsayers foresaw a terrible storm that would last for centuries, so all the townspeople decided to fall asleep until it passed. However, as the world decayed over time, the ancient temples that focused the power of the stars began to crumble leaving the world’s goddess, Ari, with only enough power to wake up one young hero, Rumi. With Ari’s help, Rumi must realign the Constellation Crystals in each of Alariya’s three Star Temples to give Ari enough power to wake everyone up. In her exploration, Rumi discovers a series of notes, memories, and murals that help her uncover the mysteries of Alariya. Features: Single-player, open-world exploration game Playtime (main story): 1-2 hours Playtime (full exploration): 3-4 hours Made in Unreal Engine 5 Original music score

rows.name: Conjury Revell
rows.short_description: Conjury Revell is a first-person action game from the students at SMU Guildhall. Use your magical spells and abilities to eliminate waves of faceless oppressors as they attempt to keep you from rebelling against the system.
rows.description_html: Conjury Revell is a first-person shooter with wave-based arena combat. Play as a rebellious dissident fighting to rid their world of magical oppression and forge a better future for their city in the clouds. Diverse Magical Arsenal Switch between 3 different spells and gravity powers to make the arenas work for you to defeat overwhelming numbers attempting to halt your rebellion. Choose between Ice, Fire, and Lightning spells with calculated precision to destroy your foes. City in the clouds Fight between city streets and above the clouds on airships as you assault your foes. Explore a gothic steampunk world and save the city. Visceral frenetic combat Shooter gameplay that keeps you on your toes. Dash, jump, and blast your way through anyone who stands in your way. Use your environment against your foes to keep them at bay while you charge up a powerful spell to eviscerate them.

rows.name: Cave Crawlers
rows.short_description: Cave Crawlers is a 1-10 player rogue lite set deep underground in a system of randomly generated caves. Players use weapons, spells, and talents to defeat the unique bosses and enemies found in each biome.
rows.description_html: In Cave Crawlers you and your friends play as Dwarves searching for glory, power, and loot in the form of armor, weapons, potions, and items hidden underground from the world above. Your player has a fun, complex talent and stat system that you will use to fight powerful bosses and enemies. You'll find all kinds of mysteries along your journey, exploring different biomes, mobs, and items along the way. As a dwarf searching for treasure and glory, you'll find that your journey can be quite tough without some allies at your side. Each player uses their own personalized talents, spells, and items to help defeat treacherous bosses. CO-OP UP TO 10 PLAYERS Crawl through the caves alone or with a group of friends! Cave Crawlers supports up to 10 players in one game. You must rely on the great strength and wit of your teammates to defeat the threats deep in the caves. Be careful though, the power of the caves grows as more dwarfs adventure together. BIOMES As you explore, players will find complete environment changes, new enemies, and new items in each biome. In these biomes, you may stumble upon trapped rooms that contain magnificent rewards. BOSSES Biomes will include their own themed boss. Each boss has its own challenging mechanics that must be overcome to gain access to the next biome. Bosses drop their own unique loot. DEATH At the beginning of your journey, you create a new character and begin that character's journey. Each character has its own set of items and expertise talents. When a character dies, they are permanently dead. LIGHT The caves are extremely dark, players must make use of their limited light. Torches burn out over time, yet players may use their flint and steel in the darkest of situations. TALENTS, SPELLS, PERKS Choose your character's path with over 100+ weapon-specific talents at your disposal. Will you ravage enemies with an axe? Swing extremely fast with a dagger? Heal allies with a torch? Become a tank and block attacks? Try each path and forge your own builds. ITEMS Many unique and powerful items can be found throughout your journey. Each weapon has its own unique talent effect tied to it, helping you defeat increasingly difficult enemies.

DEATH At the beginning of your journey, you create a new character and begin that character's journey. Each character has its own set of items and expertise talents. When a character dies, they are permanently dead. LIGHT The caves are extremely dark, players must make use of their limited light. Torches burn out over time, yet players may use their flint and steel in the darkest of situations. TALENTS, SPELLS, PERKS Choose your character's path with over 100+ weapon-specific talents at your disposal. Will you ravage enemies with an axe? Swing extremely fast with a dagger? Heal allies with a torch? Become a tank and block attacks? Try each path and forge your own builds. ITEMS Many unique and powerful items can be found throughout your journey. Each weapon has its own unique talent effect tied to it, helping you defeat increasingly difficult enemies.

rows.name: The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann
rows.short_description: The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann is a first-person point-and-click detective game inspired by German expressionist cinema. Solve environmental puzzles to uncover the tragic history and secrets of a doomed town.
rows.description_html: Inspired by German expressionist cinema, The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann is an atmospheric and haunting exploration of radicalisation and the apathy of evil. A first-person point-and-click puzzle/horror game, it will challenge your logic and critical thinking skills just as it horrifies you with its disturbing narrative. Uncover the Mystery of a Doomed Town Use your detective skills to piece together the history of a town and find the secrets behind its ultimate fate. Solve Environmental Puzzles Apply your understanding of the mystery to solve environmental puzzles and escape the same tragic fate that befell the town's inhabitants. Experience a Haunting Atmosphere Taking inspiration from German expressionist cinema and gothic 19th century literature, The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann features a surreal art design and atmosphere that will leave you questioning your own reality. Note: Currently, only Act 1 is available to play. The game will be updated in the future when more content is complete.

rows.name: Dark Nights
rows.short_description: Nothing is as it seems.
rows.description_html: Story You live in a small, peaceful village. Every day is the same as any other; boring. Right when you wish for something exciting to happen, strange things start to occur, stemming from the nearby forest. If that isn't enough, the locals have begun disappearing. At the same time, you meet four mysterious guys. Will you discover the truth before becoming the next target? Features ♦ 4 routes, each with a unique storyline ♦ 16 possible endings, 4 per storyline ♦ At least 10 hours playtime - 60,000 - 70,000 words per storyline. Total 270,608 words ♦ 8+ side characters, vary per route. ♦ 60 CG art/20+ cut scenes ♦ 60 Original background art ♦ 37 Original soundtracks ♦ 29 Achievements ♦ Opening video ♦ Bonus material Notes There isn’t an official order, because each route is a puzzle piece of the whole. Although, some routes are more connected than others. Like Zeikun and Sachiro. If you are going to play all routes anyway, I suggest starting off with Zeikun or Sachiro as an introduction to the story. Kurato and Junoru routes are more plot-heavy so I’d do them as last. If you enjoy keeping hooked on mysteries I suggest this order: Sachiro> Zeikun> Kurato > Junoru. To understand hints given in other routes I suggest this order: Kurato > Zeikun > Sachiro or Junoru. Reach all 16 endings to unlock bonus content.

rows.name: Red Haven
rows.short_description: Navigate through the Red Haven complex and uncover secrets and survive!
rows.description_html: Overview: In Red Haven, there are mysteries and secrets that have been locked away! In this horror game, the player can investigate the complex and discover what's inside or maybe who. There are multiple levels filled with jump scares, puzzles, and patterns that the player will have to follow if they want to survive! The player will also have to be stealthy and know when to hide from enemies within the complex. Feedback is much appreciated and if you enjoy it share it with friends! NOTE: This is an unfinished game so I acknowledge there is some bugs with it. Bugs are mainly on some of the monsters but I wanted to give people a chance to play the game who wanted to so I released this version. Also the game is suppose to be very challenging, I did not want it to be easy on purpose!

rows.name: Spirits of Baciu - Prologue
rows.short_description: SPIRITS OF BACIU - PROLOGUE is the enigmatic adventure of a mysterious cat-like spirit who suddenly awakens in the dark forest of Baciu. Join him on this strange journey and meet many spirits that inhabit the forest. Help him to solve puzzles and to find his way through the forest.
rows.description_html: Join us on discord! About the Game SPIRITS OF BACIU - PROLOGUE SOB is an atmospheric puzzle adventure game set in Hoia Baciu forest, one of the most haunted places of the planet. You will follow the adventure of a little spirit waking up into the woods. How did he get here and what haunts this place? Interact with the environment and solve many riddles Talk to the spirits and collect clues and objects Combine them to get new information Listen to the forest and its habitants...only they can help you! Features Mechanics are point-and-click like but you can walk and run with keyboard The hand drawing graphic is full of details : observing the environment is very important to catch clues and collect objects Talking to forest dwellers will help you to solve puzzles and to find your way The involving music with nostalgic vibes will give you a more immersive experience: we suggest to keep the audio ON, or use your headphones, and listen well! This is crucial for some puzzles! This Is A Free Prologue! We really hope you enjoyed it and we invite you to FOLLOW US on our social pages to be updated about the rest of the story and SAVE the upcoming Kickstarter Campaign! Horns Level Up Games

rows.name: Half Hour Hexagon
rows.short_description: Obliterate a never-ending horde of enemies while you attempt to reach the 30 minute mark. Race to earn XP and level up to gain new items and opportunities for each run to become stronger than the last.
rows.description_html: Half Hour Hexagon is a minimalist survival game with roguelite elements where you must defeat waves of enemies in an endless map in order to reach the 30 minute mark. Spend cash earned during runs and complete achievements to unlock permanent weapons, abilities, and stat bonuses for future runs and master the art of the Hexagon. Use cash earned during gameplay to buy permanent Upgrades. Some of these Upgrades can have negative effects, but they reveal Upgrades with much more powerful effects later in the tree. There are 5 additional weapon types to unlock by defeating certain enemies across multiple runs. Try to overcome each milestone as you work towards new equipment. There are 13 different items to unlock on top of the 5 that start in your item pool. These are additional milestones for you to work towards and assist you in making it further and further. Finally, you can see a full list of all the enemies you've encountered and view their stats (alongside a brief description)

rows.name: Eterspire
rows.short_description: Eterspire is a true free-to-play, cross-platform MMORPG where your skill and dedication define your progression!  Play on PC and Mobile with crossplay, join a friendly and active community, discover new content updates every two weeks, and explore a massive world full of charming characters.
rows.description_html: Early Access Eterspire is in Early Access on PC. We release new updates every two weeks to add content, polish features, and improve performance. Your feedback helps us a ton! We read the Discussions hub and publish detailed patch notes for every update. ------ Eterspire is a fantasy MMORPG built for players who want real progression that's fun and rewarding. Explore a handcrafted fantasy world, join other adventurers in real-time co-op battles, and earn gear through skill and grinding. If you’re looking for a true MMO with real depth, loot, and customization, Eterspire delivers a classic MMORPG experience that you can play on PC and on the go. GRIND FOR GEAR Level up by battling monsters, completing quests, and collecting loot. There are no paid top-tier weapons or shortcuts—your strength comes only from dedication, strategy, and skill. MASTER PVE TRIALS WITH FRIENDS Team up in co-op parties of up to 4 players to face Trials—wave-based PvE challenges with rare loot, EXP, and powerful boss encounters. Build your party, coordinate your attacks, and conquer Aetera’s toughest challenges. CUSTOMIZE YOUR ADVENTURER Choose your class and shape your identity. Use crafting to convert gear into cosmetics, so you can wear your favorite armor and weapons without sacrificing stats. Create a look that’s yours—no matter how you fight. CONTROLLER SUPPORT Eterspire is compatible with a wide variety of wired and Bluetooth controllers! With intuitive button mappings for both combat and UI, it provides one of the best controller experiences among MMORPGs! FIGHT FOR THE TOP RANK IN THE BASTION CHALLENGE Face endless waves of enemies in the Bastion Challenge. Each wave you defeat brings you one step closer to the top rank. Place on group, solo, and class ladders and earn points for fancy cosmetics with every wave you survive! JOIN A TRUE MMORPG COMMUNITY Eterspire is more than just a game—it’s a living, growing fantasy world. Chat, trade, party up, and explore with players around the globe. Join contests, community events, and Discord Q&As with the devs. DISCOVER THE WORLD OF AETERA From lush valleys and deep forests to ancient ruins and sun-scorched deserts, Aetera is packed with places to explore and secrets to find. Meet unforgettable characters as you shape your own legend. NEW CONTENT EVERY 2 WEEKS With biweekly content updates, feature improvements, and regular events, Eterspire evolves alongside its community. Every patch brings something new to discover or conquer.

rows.reviews_html: “I don’t really do reviews on the App Store, especially on MMOs. Most of them don’t come anywhere close to PC or even console counterparts… but Eterspire does. It’s a breath of fresh air with its design and ideas in the mobile marketplace. It’s easy to play, quick, and fun. It gives you a portable MMO experience that you can’t get anywhere else. I highly highly recommend it if you’re a fan of the genre and want something to play on mobile!” 5/5 – Appstore “I rarely write reviews, generally only for particularly awful or exceptional things. This is thankfully the latter. Eterspire has quickly become my MMORPG of choice. Not mobile MMORPG of choice, overall MMORPG of choice. The stylized graphics are eye-grabbing, the monster design is varied and hits just the right good brain chemicals that gives me a feeling of longing and nostalgia. The developer team is incredible, both in their game design choices and community involvement. Give this game a go.” 5/5 – Google Play “Eterspire is easily the best mobile MMORPG of recent years. It's a lovely indie MMORPG where you just pick a class and then dive into a world full of monsters, quests, and loot. And the free-to-play experience is great.” 85% – Minireview

rows.short_description: Survive in this terrific Battle Royale with 2000 creatures around you. Be the last person standing to enter the Zombie Horde Mode. Good luck, survivors!
rows.description_html: In this demo version you can play in matchmaking but you will not have stats and skins. Battle Royale Survive against not only AI players, but also over 2000 creatures surrounding the zone and coming for YOU ! Be the last person standing and eliminate a maximum of creatures to maximize your final score. Zombie Horde Mode Once you are the last person standing, the game isn’t over yet. Creatures will chase and you will need to run for your life in order to survive until you manage to catch the helicopter to escape. Your score will be calculated based on the number of creatures and players you managed to eliminate, as well as whether you’ve successfully escaped ! .

rows.short_description: Re-Enter the world of Kaz's Adventure and travel through the underworld in 5 new amazing worlds with new graphics and places to explore!
rows.description_html: Welcome back to the world of Kaz's Adventure, after Kaz meets with a terrible fate, he goes looking to reunite with his long lost brother as he adventures through the vast underworld! Kaz's Adventure 2 uses hand drawn, cartoon styled, 2D graphics compared to the first games pixel art style! Kaz gains a new ability during the story which allows him to do a short dash forward which allows for a faster paced and more risky adventure! Level Editor 2.0 is instantly unlocked when you startup the game. This game also comes with 2 other new bonus modes for players to enjoy once unlocked by collecting 15 or 30 Soul Orbs, you may unlock the modes before or after the story is complete, one of the new modes is the survival mode where players must survive as long as possible on a small platform as the returning enemy: 'Cloaked', constantly float towards you, the theme will change each attempt you do to reflect the different world environments within the story!

rows.name: BomberGuys
rows.short_description: BomberGuys is a multiplayer game made with Unreal Engine. It is played by 2 to 4 players in an arena. Your task is to undermine all opponents. The last one left in the arena wins.
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD How to Play About the Game 💣 BomberGuys is a top-down multiplayer game with simple controls. In fact, apart from movement, the player only has one ability: placing bombs. Each bomb explodes in four directions, the explosion can destroy enemies or destroy brick blocks. In the blocks you can find bonuses that increase the range of the explosion, you can place additional bombs or increase the speed of your character. The goal of each player is to destroy all enemies and remain alone on the field. LEVEL EDITOR Create and play with your friends on your own maps with your own rules. CO-OP \ MULTIPLAYER Join the game or create your own with your friends. ENDLESS FUN Thanks to your support and suggestions, we try to do the best for you.

rows.name: Builders of Greece: Prologue
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in the beautifully recreated golden age of Hellenic city-states. Builders of Greece: Prologue, being a shortened version of the full game, is a great way to try your hand as a ruler of an ancient Greek city-state, practice your management skills, and learn basic game mechanics.
rows.description_html: EA Roadmap About the Game Put your management skills to the demanding test and prove yourself as a fine ruler of the ancient Greek city . Throughout your journey, you will face many challenges, unexpected events, and promising opportunities. Make world-shaping decisions, command your subjects, erect magnificent structures, and make your Polis the most glorious place in the whole ancient world! Builders of Greece: Prologue , being a shortened version of the full game, is a great way to practice your management skills and learn basic game mechanics. Features: Dozens of varied buildings Extensive management and decision-making system Random events and weather conditions Trading, politics, and war systems Old-school City Builder gameplay with a modern twist Plan out your Polis with great precision - work out your own meticulously detailed city layout and establish unabated production chains. Choose from dozens of varied buildings at your disposal and decide which of them will best serve your loyal subjects. Maintain a balance between residential zones, administrative institutions, workshops, service buildings, and military facilities to provide your city with stable, dynamic development. Make fateful decisions and manage all the aspects of your city's life. Set your taxes, establish new trade routes, occupy resource-rich terrains, increase the population of your empire, react to unpredictable events, or become a local military power. The way you rule is entirely up to you! Take good care of your citizens' needs, guarantee their safety and secure their well-being. If you fail, your Polis will soon be hit by riots, plagues, or rapid emigration. Only a good, wise politics will encourage the local population to settle in your city. Prove as an efficient ruler and turn your small provincial town into a huge metropolis known throughout the whole glorious Greece! If you succeed, your city will become famous for its elite, top class society, astonishing wealth, magnificent buildings, and superb military power. rows.name: Chamber's Reunion
rows.short_description: Following a message from an old friend, you visit abandoned estate. Suddenly, you're knocked out. As you wake up, your only job is to escape as quickly as possible..
rows.description_html: Disclaimer: Purchase of this base game includes the first chapter. Further chapters are DLCs. Following a mysterious message from an old friend, you drive to an abandoned estate shrouded in mystery and decay. The air is thick with the scent of damp wood and overgrown vegetation as you approach the looming structure. Before you even reach the entrance, a figure emerges from the shadows, and everything goes black. You awaken in a dimly lit, decrepit room inside the estate, your head throbbing and your senses disoriented. The walls are covered in peeling wallpaper, and the faint sound of whispers seems to echo through the corridors. Disoriented and alone, you realize that your only goal is to escape this nightmarish place as quickly as possible. As you navigate the eerie surroundings, you uncover dark secrets hidden within the estate. Cryptic notes, disturbing artifacts, and fragmented memories hint at a sinister history connected to your friend's message. The shadows seem to move on their own, and you can't shake the feeling that you're being watched. Sinister forces lurk in the darkness, waiting for the right moment to strike. Key Features Atmospheric environment Player voice activity Graphically advanced

rows.name: Card Survival: Tropical Island - The First Days
rows.short_description: Card Survival is a card-based survival experience. Stranded on a desert island you must use your wits and skills to stay alive. Use cards and combine them together to explore, gather resources and craft useful tools.
rows.description_html: Full Game Available About the Game Card Survival: Tropical Island is a card-based survival experience from the creators of Card Quest. Experience what life would be like if you were stranded on a desert island, all in a card format. Explore, craft tools and manage your needs in order to survive in this hostile environment. The First Days In this free version you'll be able to get a glimpse at the Card Survival experience by playing as the Hunter character for up to 7 in-game days, in a limited area of the island. The full version of the game features more characters, a character creator and a lot more content to explore. Games that you started playing on The First Days can be resumed in the full game. Key Features Simple but deep system: all interactions are done by using cards or combining them together. Tons of Content: Go from a starving castaway in rags to a prosperous island farmer. Realistic Simulation: Tracking everything from body weight to calluses on hands and feet and even your stool consistency. Explore a Desert Island Explore a large island with 8 different environments, including beaches, jungles, grasslands and mangroves. Learn to coexist with the many different animals of the islands, be predator and prey and even learn to domesticate and breed them. Learn of the different culinary and medicinal uses of the diverse flora of the island and discover the secrets of how to grow it. Keep yourself busy with lots of activities Work wood, stone, copper, fiber, leather and clay to craft yourself lots of different tools, weapons, clothes and containers. Build yourself a home and other structures out of wood and mud, including animal enclosures, crop plots and water reservoirs. Roast, smoke and salt different meats, make your own bread, oil, cheese, sugar, wine and cook lots of different recipes. Complex health system Suffer from foot and hand sores, back pain, sunburns and even bug bites. Craft protective clothing and use multiple medicinal plants to treat these ailments. Sprains, fractures, abrasions, bleeding lacerations and animal bites are some of the many ways in which you can get hurt. Wash and treat your wounds to stave off infection and promote healing. Get fever, diarrhoea, nausea, headaches and rashes from the bacteria and parasites you can catch on the island. Feed yourself well and keep your morale high to help strengthen your immune system.

rows.description_html: Welcome to WarKind! Play against other players in teams or alone. Use different races, heroes and their abilities strategically, to defeat your opponents in different game modes. Various game modes . - Play against other players in 1vs1, Free for all or single player mode Dynamic game world - Strategically exploit natural events to destroy your opponents - Randomly appearing natural events in the form of a meteor shower, tornado or volcanic eruption! - Attack your opponents in a forest or from a hill to gain an advantage in battle! Different races - Play with different races and master their advantages - Customize the appearance of your units Different heroes - Use different heroes and their different abilities - Customize the appearance of your heroes! - Gain experience with your heroes to unlock new abilities Countless abilities - Use global abilities and those of your units/heroes strategically - Reach new player levels to unlock global abilities and other benefits! Daily Challenges - Complete daily challenges to receive additional content

rows.name: Super Galaxy Ball
rows.short_description: A 3D Platformer set in space with 40+ levels and a built-in level editor. Race for the fastest times in campaign or custom levels either by yourself or with your friends online.
rows.description_html: Fast Paced Gravity Defying Action Super Galaxy Ball is a gravity defying 3D platformer set in space with an amazing electronic soundtrack. Navigate your way through each level by double jumping, climbing and sticking to walls to dodge any obstacles in your path to reach the finish. Unlock new skins by completing achievements and race for the fastest time by yourself or online with friends. Powerful Built-in Level Editor The built-in level editor allows you to create levels that are out of this world. Instead of choosing from a set list of pre-sized building blocks, the built-in level editor allows you to dynamically scale all regular blocks to any size, allowing them to fit perfectly wherever you need them. There are also tons of obstacles and behaviors to choose from, each of which contain multiple options that can be tweaked to enhance level design. Play With Friends Race against friends online or through LAN in lobbies of up to 16. The hosting player can choose any campaign or custom level they have on their device. This even includes levels that only the hosting player has downloaded! This allows everyone to easily share their levels with each other online without the need for downloading them first.

rows.short_description: Pets Hotel: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Pets Hotel: Prologue gives you a unique opportunity to build, design, and run a place where pets can feel at home. Cats, dogs, turtles, and many other animals are waiting for you to take care of them!
rows.description_html: Take care of the different types of animals All your little guests have different needs. Pet owners will tell you about them; it is your job to feed them according to their demands. Don’t forget about grooming and play-time! A satisfied customer is the best business strategy of all! Manage your pet hotel One of the biggest challenges that await you in Pets Hotel is designing and running a place where your customers can stay assured that they are leaving their beloved pets in good hands. Your competition never sleeps! Have fun with your guests! Your guests have their requirements! Make sure you get enough daily entertainment and exercise to keep them strong, healthy, and relaxed. Take them for walks, pet them, give them treats, and play with balls. Make all kinds of animals feel at home in your hotel. Start from scratch and build your pet hotel empire! As the game progresses you will expand your business and make it the most premier pets hotel of all time! Imagine a place with a multitude of rooms, each designed and decorated for a different type of animal, with huge playgrounds surrounding your premium hotel! A truly fabulous place that you can create yourself.

Build bunkers that will ensure safety from any danger!

rows.name: Havoc
rows.short_description: Havoc is an arcade tactical first-person shooter with semi-destructible environments. It offers a variety of game modes, including Bomb Defusal, Team Deathmatch, Free for All, and Gun Game, along with extensive options to customize lobby settings to your preferences.
rows.description_html: Experience an Arcade team-based action in Havoc, a tactical FPS that takes the genre to new heights with semi-destructible environments. Use strategy and skill to plant and defuse bombs, destroy walls to reach your target, and more. Immerse yourself in team-based action across various game modes, including bomb defusal, team deathmatch, and more. Havoc introduces semi-destructible environments, adding a whole new layer of strategy to the gameplay. Destroy walls and obstacles to create new paths, catch opponents off guard, and create distractions. Every match is filled with unexpected twists and turns, keeping you on your toes and demanding quick thinking and skill. With multiple game modes at your disposal, you can choose the experience that suits your preferences. Engage in high-stakes bomb defusal matches, where teamwork and strategy are essential. Or jump into team deathmatch mode and engage in epic battles against 5 other players. The choice is yours. Havoc allows you to customize your lobby settings, giving you control over gravity, movement, and more. Tailor the game to your liking, whether you prefer fast-paced, gravity-defying combat or a more grounded and realistic approach. Prepare to defend bomb sites, plan your strategies, and customize your loadout to emerge as the winning team. Havoc offers an immersive and customizable experience that will keep you hooked. Gear up, dive into the action, and embrace the chaos of Havoc now!

To be victorious you must take the fight to your enemies by traveling to Hell and destroying twelve demon generals in boss battles.

The demons of Hell have invaded a remote hotel, and you must defeat them using a combination of spells and your trusty Rune Stone. The Rune Stone is your primary weapon, throw it at demons to destroy them. Don’t worry, it comes back… To be victorious, you must take the fight to your enemies by traveling to Hell and destroying the twelve demon generals leading the invasion. You are the Doctor, and it’s time to cleanse this hotel.

rows.description_html: You found yourself in the future where robots have taken over the world. As the woman protagonist, you are trying to escape the robots. In this endless run, you jump from platform to platform. First, the turrets, then the first ship that rains projectiles, then the second shop shoots at you which feels endless, and lastly the drone when all of them fail. In the end, all of them attack you. How long could you survive while trying to escape them?

rows.name: Fantasia Medieval
rows.short_description: A short Visual-Novel, made with Artificial-Inteligence art, about a party of adventurers on a medieval setting.
rows.description_html: Medieval Fantasy was a surge of inspiration, which came with the emergence of artwork created by robots. I've been wanting to test my writing on a Visual Novel for a while, so this new technology was the excuse I needed to create this adventure, which simulates a tabletop RPG session with friends. It's a short story, with some ramifications that might spark interest in replaying from the beginning to see all the possible interactions. This game is also a personal experience, to see the acceptance of the Brazilian public with Visual Novels, and to see the shortest possible time that I could create a game from beginning to end. If your experience is worthwhile, consider purchasing the deluxe edition, which comes with extra high-res images and a Thank you letter. Thanks for reading this far, I hope you enjoy the game!

Some Traps are really tricky to escape Fast reflexes may help you. Can you beat the game in under 10 minutes? Mature Content Description The Game Is Recommended For All Ages.

rows.name: TIMORE REMAKE
rows.short_description: Official remake of the original Timore, that was released in 2014. Mannequins, darkness, blood, loneliness and horror.
rows.description_html: Official remake of the original Timore, that was released in 2014. Mannequins, darkness, blood, loneliness and horror. Timore Remake features atmospheric environment open for exploration with horrors, items, inventory, environment changes, weird progression puzzles, creepy sound design, nightmare and dream-like scenarios, the game built to make you creeped out. Strange creatures are always stalking you, weird mannequins appearing out of nowhere and constantly looking at you as you try to progress in your path, various mannequins behave differently and the world itself keeps adding more and more horrors along the way. While exploring, the game's inventory system allows you to collect items to find many new areas and uncover more horrors, surrealism and dark atmosphere of this place. Gameplay: you get to explore abandoned locations where you'll find items that let you progress, for that you have your inventory where you keep the collected items and read more about them. Along the way the environment brings more horrors, creatures, atmosphere and even a few extra areas for you to explore where you can find additional creepy sequences including new enemies and scares. The main destination will lead you deeper into the dark hallways and horrors with new items to find and scary locations to explore. The game is split into two environments: the first one lets you explore and navigate around it as things change and more paths open up, while the 2nd part of the game lets you dive deeper into horrors in a more linear path, constantly pushing you to new scares and atmosphere that keeps changing. Completely remade game from the original Timore, new environments, additions and changes, new locations built and a lot more atmosphere as well as reworked scares.

rows.name: Dusk Hollow
rows.short_description: Dusk Hollow is a horror hack-and-slash game that follows a miner braving the depths of an underground cave system, to rescue his friends who have seemingly been taken by the cave itself. Using what tools he finds around him, the protagonist has to fight against monsters inhabiting the cavern.
rows.description_html: Dusk Hollow follows a miner braving the dark depths of an underground cave system, all to rescue his friends who have seemingly been taken by the cave itself. Using what tools he finds around him, the protagonist has to fight against rock monsters inhabiting the recesses of the cavern. The game encourages quick thinking, with fighting hinged on using weapons found around the environment and using materials to upgrade the player’s abilities to assist in combating the creatures of the depths. The flashlight is the most important tool in the player’s arsenal, being the main way to view and traverse the level, and importantly, visibly see enemies through the darkness. Dusk Hollow features multiple levels with unique themes and mechanics that challenges the player’s use of both combat and flashlight mechanics. This game was made in 4 months by a team of 5 designers, and 3 artists.

rows.name: Word
rows.short_description: Type the Bible and record your best WPM for each verse!
rows.description_html: Type any verse in the Bible and record your best WPM for each verse-set (1 - 2 verses per set). Key Features: Type the entire Bible in any order you like. Word is a non-linear typing game in which you can type any book, chapter or verse in the Bible. Record your highest WPM for each verse-set. Each menu and button show your progress and best WPM. Replay levels to improve your stats! Think of Word as a long term game with tons of replay value; over time, type the entire Bible or just one book or just the famous verses and then go back to improve your score. Record your most efficient performance for each verse-set. Navigating the menus, if you have played the level previously, your best performance will be displayed; efficiency score increases with both higher-WPM and fewer-mistakes. Featuring instrumental hip hop by Fidget !! Includes an ample sampling of super talented audio genius, Fidget! Choose his playlist on the options menu; the default gameplay audio is a satisfying Chopin piano playlist. Word makes use of the World English Bible (WEBP) The World English Bible is a Public Domain Modern English translation of the Holy Bible.

rows.name: Singularity Runner
rows.short_description: How good a runner are you? Compete against other players in the ranking of the best runners.
rows.description_html: Join our Discord About the Game Singularity Runner is a simple casual game that relies on your reflexes. The player-controlled hero runs forward automatically, and the player can control his running path. When a hero changes course, the player scores points, but he cannot touch enemies unless he is in possession of a sword or shield. The shield will protect the player from death, but it will disappear after hitting the enemy and interrupt the combo score. The sword also disappears after hitting an enemy, but additionally it defeats him and does not interrupt the combo score. When a player enters an opponent without a sword or shield, the game ends and the points scored are saved in the ranking. Game Modes You can play campaign or arcade. Campaign has 6 levels to finish. There are three arcade game modes: Endless Game, Time Limit and Time Attack. Each mode has a separate ranking. Run to victory, avoid or defeat your opponents, catch animals - helpers, collect useful items and much more! Game Control Left click to change the player's path. Achivements: Lots of achievements to unlock!

rows.name: TBoF (The Book of Fredley)
rows.short_description: Gather the Pages, Mend the Book, and harvest the innocent to defy The Reaper. A retro stealth-adventure. Collect Keys to progress and avoid enemies while you explore the town and search for the missing pages that Fredley needs to fix his book and bring his friend back to life.
rows.description_html: A dark and silly twist to the retro adventure genre. Explore the town of Humberbumpton as Fredley: once a loving child now turned into a living abyss through the loss of his closest friend.As Fredley's heart broke in two, his tome torn open and it's pages scattered, Fredley sunk into the darkness. Now 6 years later, Fredley must gather the lost pages, and mend his book to bring his friend back. Pickup keys and other collectables to unlock doors or buff Fredley to change the dynamics of the game. Fredley is not a fighter and he HATES being molested; a lot of scary things are out there in and outside of Humberbumpton. Sneak past wandering foes and avoid getting spotted, or throw a few firecrackers to scare pursuing enemies. If all else fails, find the nearest hole and hunker down. Talking to the various children around the area is a good way to gain some insight and maybe even an upper hand. But they look so tasty... will you consume the souls of the innocent to satiate your hunger and experience a darker and more dynamic journey? Or show mercy and release them for the greater good and maybe a nice shiny item? TBoF has multiple Unique areas to explore; each more expansive then the last. Numerous enemies with varied attributes and quirks, and different reasons for getting their hands (Or Ghost Jizz) on Fredley.

rows.name: Battle for borders
rows.short_description: The purpose of the game is to demonstrate the military weapons of different countries and their use in combat conditions.
rows.description_html: A game about military weapons. At the moment it is a single player game with bots in tank battles. In the future, it is planned to add other various types of vehicles and weapons, as well as multiplayer. By adding details from containers for game currency earned in battles, the player collects a collection of military vehicles. Mechanics are made in the game: types of tank armor protection (steel, combined and dynamic), types of tank ammunition (armor-piercing, cumulative, high-explosive, ATGM and smoke), the possibility of shooting and controlling a machine gun, the behavior of the tank suspension, partial destruction of the tank. Destruction of surrounding objects and different weather conditions at combat locations. Each MBT has the indicators, sights and shells of the originals.

rows.name: Voice of the Wizard by Brett Farkas
rows.short_description: Voice of the Wizard is a 100% voice recognition controlled adventure game. Explore an open world of forests, fields, and shorelines. Learn spells, solve mysteries, and defeat enemies. It's up to you to be the Voice of the Wizard.
rows.description_html: The game is now free since the voice recognition capabilities suffer from false positives. Nevertheless, it is an interesting early example of voice recognition gaming, so I am leaving the game up. Touch control versions of the game without any voice control are available for free on mobile IOS and Android. Voice of the Wizard is a 100% voice recognition controlled adventure game. It features bright pixel art graphics in a 42 screen overworld map. Including hidden areas, there are 115 backgrounds total. You are free to traverse an open world. Learn magic spells along the way and cast them using your own voice. Roam an island, encountering witches, knights, warlocks, ogres, and centaurs. It is up to the little blue Wizard to discover the circumstances of his imprisonment. A mysterious castle looms in the center of the island. Mermaids sing idly by the seashore. Fairies flit about with their secrets held close. Explore and discover hidden adventures in the tropical island. As the Wizard learns new spells he comes to new realizations about his circumstances, and unlocks new areas. Discover the secrets. Solve the mysteries. Defeat your enemies. You will be the Voice of the Wizard!

rows.name: Unscramble Heroes
rows.short_description: How do you like your English words? Scrambled? Then you're going to love this one. Save the generic fantasy setting from scrambled word monsters using the best weapon you have -- a keyboard. Type words, gain experience, level up, upgrade skills, unlock achievements, and post to leaderboards.
rows.description_html: Calling all keyboard warriors that know (some) English! The generic fantasy setting is being overrun by monsters with scrambled words for names. Unscramble the words using your sword (keyboard) and shield (brain) to defeat wave after wave of minion and master. Earn experience based on the level (word length) of each foe and LEVEL UP! to improve your abilities. Collect hearts and items to extend your battle and ACHIEVE (ments) greatness. Etch your name in the HALL OF HEROES (Steam Leaderboards) and compete against your fellow keyboard warriors to claim the title of UNSCRAMBLE HERO!!! Unscramble Words This game contains thousands of common American English words. As enemies appear on screen, a mix of letters will appear below them. Unscramble the letters and type the correct word to defeat the enemy and move on. You even get a little bit of help -- the first and last letters are already in the correct position! Gain Experience Each word you unscramble grants you experience. The longer the word, the more experience! You can adjust the word length in the options, or go for particularly challenging words during the boss encounters. Level Up Think of it like a word based RPG where you gain experience and level up. Yup, you read that correctly. A word based RPG. Upgrade Skills Once you've acquired enough experience to level, you can spend points to enhance your abilities. Gain more health so that you can spend more time unscrambling words. Slow down the monster spawn rate so that you won't be overwhelmed. Start with more items. There are many paths to go down, but only so many points to spend. Don't worry, you can change your mind at any time! Unlock Achievements Can you hit max level? Can you attain a frankly unhealthy amount of points? Did you forget to use your items again? All of these are achievable metrics that you can show off to your friends. Post to Leaderboards This game supports Steam Leaderboards and there are a number of leaderboards to compete on.

rows.name: Treekeepers
rows.short_description: Coordinate, fly, and blast your way through an oversized cartoon world in this 1-4 player co-op adventure!
rows.description_html: Treekeepers is about a giant tree that needs saving and a hot air balloon at the disposal of you and your 4-person crew. Along the way, encounter oversized obstacles and pests that are out to stop you. One player flies, one player defends the aircraft, and the others kill the bad guys. Don't like who's flying? Then take the flight stick from them! But you'd better learn to work together quickly, because it's your team vs. the world. Join us on the Discord to give suggestions and report bugs! Collect and strategize on which parts of your ship to upgrade Full multiplayer support, online or local, and cross-play with standalone VR users on Quest 2 Take full advantage of PCVR graphical power with lighting and other effects only enabled on the PC version Keep coming back for high scores with a continuous scale difficulty system Features: Ship-based combat where 4 players can navigate challenges together while controlling 4 turrets and giant energy shield. Play remotely online OR in-person with multiple crewmates in one large playspace! 3 upgrades that can be applied to the hot air balloon's turrets or shield. One full playable level with 20 objectives in in a garden setting, with more coming soon! A dynamic difficulty system that allows for players to earn higher and higher scores in each level, and stats to show off to your friends! All VR headsets supported via OpenXR, and you can cross-play with friends on the Oculus Quest 2!
