rows.name: Shanubis
rows.short_description: You find yourself trapped alone in a pyramid, being hunted by an Egyptian God. Break containers to find what you need to survive and escape but stay quiet, Shanubis doesn't like trespassers. Just ask the rest of the research team...
rows.description_html: Delve into a pyramid to catch up with the other researchers but don't get caught when you find yourself locked inside being hunted by an Egyptian God. Break containers to find what you need to survive and escape but stay quiet, Shanubis doesn't like trespassers. Just ask the rest of the research team... Break open containers to find explosives, ancient healing herbs, and rocks... Features Stealth : Throw rocks to create distractions, break containers from afar, and knock gems loose. Survival : Use herbs to restore health. Exploration : Blow up walls to create new routes and open secret rooms. Shanubis has acute hearing, breaking containers and blowing up walls may entice him to investigate the noise so be careful what you break. Difficulty Progression As you find the artifacts you need to escape, the game becomes naturally more difficult... you'll see. Likewise, you can choose to seek out the 4 Lucky Charms that randomly generate on each play-through. Each one you collect increases your luck which affects your chances of finding herbs and bombs.

rows.name: Around Us
rows.short_description: Around Us is a 2d prop hunt party game. Prop hunt is similar to hide and seek where you can play among your friends up to 8 players, players are randomly selected to be a hunter or a hider. Hiders can switch into Props and finish tasks, and hunters have to hunt them down.
rows.description_html: Around Us is a 2d prop hunt party game centered around the childhood game “Hide And Seek/Prophunt”. Originally designed for 5-8 players you can play anywhere from 2-8! There are over 100+ props to choose from and hide as, that are randomized each time you play, 8+ engaging tasks to complete , including memory games, puzzles, and more! Everyone is included! while playing, you will never have a dull moment, it is enjoyable no matter what role you get! You can play among or around your friends! players are randomly selected to be a hunter or a hider, Hunters main objective is to find the hiders or props and eliminate them, And the hiders main objective is to finish their tasks without being caught with switching between props and hiding. You can select how many hunters you would like, and how many tasks the hiders need to complete. And If you do not have any friends, you can join random lobbys, meet new people, and make more friends. Get ready to cure your boredom and party with around us , and Wishlist the game today!

rows.name: Wheel of Innocence
rows.short_description: Wheel of Innocence is a lesbian visual novel where you peer into the life of a disabled high schooler named Reina.
rows.description_html: Wheel of Innocence is a linear visual novel where you occasionally help Reina open up to herself and those around her by picking choices throughout the story. Learn more about the dark past of not just Reina but another close to her as well. Reina is currently in her last year of high school; but had recently changed schools due to severe ableist bullying, and hopes to finish it with a clean slate. After a few days in the new year she is introduced to her volunteer assistant, a kind and upstanding classmate named Mizuki. During the rest of the first semester they bond over the hardships of school life and become close friends with something more sprouting underneath, but not without conflict brewing in the horizon. Will they face their problems hand-in-hand, or lose their grasp on that which binds them together?

rows.name: Legacy's Allure
rows.short_description: Legacy's Allure is a customizable, card-based wargame with no randomness. Command warriors, beasts, and mages on the battlefield to outplay your opponent in this chess-inspired fantasy battle.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the digital client of the acclaimed tabletop board game, Legacy's Allure. Legacy's Allure is a customizable, card-based wargame with no randomness. Imagine chess but with customization, deeper mechanics, and a high-fantasy theme. Legacy's Allure has been called a 'streamlined wargame' due to its elegance and accessibility. This digital client includes tutorials, puzzles, lore, ranked and casual play modes, and online shop. Most cards in the first three factions, as well as all items, can be unlocked by completing missions (stated in the store). All remaining contain is available for purchase at fixed prices in the store. Future factions will be sold separately. We have a vibrant discord community. Please join our discord to find opponents, discuss strategy, and keep up to date with the release of new content.

rows.name: Wheels of WAR
rows.short_description: The Wheels of WAR is a Warfare Game. The unique way of war Fight between multiple vehicles. Players explore the world and survive with their team. Plenty of game modes are available to play with cross-platform.
rows.description_html: The Wheels of WAR is an online multiplayer Game. The game is a fight between cars for survival in the world. There are different game modes Free for all, team match, death race, Survivor, and stun race. The Wheels of WAR give you new warfare that involves driving skills and shooting skills. Winning each game will increase the ranking and XP. With it, you can upgrade weapons and cars. With the upgrade participate in the tournament to win the prize. The competition will start in mid of 2023. Because still we are in development we continue our work in bug solving upgrading the game physics and much more.

rows.name: Dead on Arrival: Remastered
rows.short_description: Dead On Arrival: Remastered is an atmospheric horror-puzzle game. Uncover the true consequences of one’s actions. A remastered version of the original classic!
rows.description_html: Dead On Arrival: Remastered is a first person escape room horror full of interesting puzzles, settings and an exciting story. Game story While on the train home from work, Sean receives a cryptic warning before a freak accident causes his train to derail. Waking up after the crash, seemingly unharmed, Sean dismisses the crash as a nightmare. But as things turn out not to be what they seem, Sean’s past returns to haunt him, and the absolute nightmare has only just begun. Early Access story After witnessing a horrifying memory, Sean stumbles into another living nightmare. Stuck in an eerie hotel complex. His dark past starts to unravel as he begins to investigate a seemingly unknown environment. Features The remastered version brings new features and improves on gameplay from the original classic. Immersive narrative: Told through both items in-game and cutscenes this will be a story to remember Complex puzzles: Original puzzles that can't be solved easily, better keep an eye out for clues Great atmosphere: Lighting, VFX, sound design and level design have been used to lovingly craft the atmosphere throughout the entire game Scary Horror: Using suspenseful horror elements it uses the great atmosphere to its advantage to deliver a genuinely terrifying experience A first-person adventure: Featuring 4 detailed and content-full levels This game is a continuation of a previously released university project developed by a small, passionate team involved with the original production.

rows.name: Heartwood Online
rows.short_description: Heartwood Online is a cross-platform free-to-play MMO. Explore a vast world filled with adventure where you choose your own path. Immerse yourself in crafting, trade, PvP & PvE battles, guilds, politics, and a thriving player economy.
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game GAME FEATURES Heartwood Online is a true cross-platform free-to-play MMO currently available on Steam , Apple , and Android . We plan to bring it to all major consoles as development progresses. Explore a vast and immersive world filled with adventure and exploration. Join forces with other players to battle fearsome raid bosses, uncover hidden treasures, and unlock new abilities and powers. Choose your path through crafting, PvP and PvE battles, guilds, politics, and a thriving player economy. CURRENT PLATFORMS DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP MOUNTS: Collect rare and legendary mounts so you can move faster in style. CLASSES: Pick from Warrior, Rogue, Mage, or Priest. Each class has unique gear, abilities, and talents to help you fill a crucial role in a hunting party. SKILLS: Current crafting and gathering skills include mining, blacksmithing, woodcutting, carpentry, tailoring, leather-working. But many more are in the works! EQUIPMENT: Wear gear that suits your attitude and build path; fight with melee, magic, and ranged weapons. GUILDS: The current Guild management UI lets you fully customize aspects of your guild. Create guild tags and ranks. Promote, invite, and kick members. Coming soon: Guild bank, guild cosmetics, guild house. PETS: Collect pets to help you in battle and crafting, or just use them as a status symbol. LEADER BOARDS: Compete with others for the top position on a variety of monthly leader boards such as crafting, PvP, item collections, and more. Monthly leaders will be rewarded with prizes and specialty cosmetics. PVP EVENTS: Sharpen your blades for epic large scale player battles and other PvP events. Gain rewards for collecting bounties from wanted players. PLAYER HOUSING: Not just a place to store belongings, but an opportunity to showcase your creativity and style. As you walk through towns and forests, you'll see homes adorned with exotic furniture and intricate gardens. Showcase your achievements and trophies earned in battles, displaying them prominently in your home. Our housing system will truly set us apart from other MMOs, and we can't wait for you to experience the joy of owning and decorating your own space. ?????: This isn't the end of the road though. We have plans far beyond this list, along with any amazing suggestions from our community.

rows.name: ABI-DOS
rows.short_description: Build the most advanced operating system ever created! Can you master the fictional simulation language of this mind-bending machine? Design circuits, automate UBITS (coloured mobile data blocks), and optimize your system. The Admin is always watching, and he’s not what he seems.
rows.description_html: Join us on DISCORD About the Game Recover damaged images: Fix corrupted files: Design the logic: Simulate the program: ABI-DOS: The Ultimate Automation Puzzle Challenge. In ABI-DOS , you build circuits to manipulate and guide UBITS (colored digital blocks) toward specific goals based on the given documentation. By strategically placing wires and instruction blocks on a microchip , you manipulate inputs to achieve desired outputs—whether it’s fixing corrupted files, recovering damaged .png images, or simulating particle trajectories. ABI-DOS challenges you to meet strict specifications through inventive problem-solving. No programming experience is required , as everything is explained in-game. The focus is on assembling logical solutions within space and operational constraints rather than on real-world programming concepts. The puzzles are challenging and offer no predetermined solutions , allowing for multiple approaches. Each level starts with a blank canvas, giving you the freedom to create your own unique solution from scratch. You are encouraged to optimize your algorithms , fostering creative exploration and friendly competition as you compare solutions with friends and on global leaderboards . With over 50 puzzles and more than 50 hours of gameplay , ABI-DOS offers extensive content for players to delve into. The work is overseen by the system's Admin, a mysterious figure who is not what he seems. Set in a retro-punk world, this enigmatic presence adds an extra layer of intrigue as you uncover the deeper mysteries of the system. Drawing inspiration from Zach-like games , ABI-DOS pays homage to its predecessors while offering a fresh perspective on the assembly puzzle genre.

rows.name: Hope's End
rows.short_description: Hope's End is a free virtual arcade experience where you can add game cabinets to your collection as DLC or begin playing our wave defense game, The Psions, for free immediately. New games will continue to be added as we create them.
rows.description_html: Arcades as they once existed are all but dead. Personally, we thought that sucked. The Hope's End Arcade is our attempt to revive the feel and spirit classic arcade games for the modern era. We want to deliver fast, chaotic experiences that don't require committing to investing an hour or longer to play a single session of a game. We want to provide games that deliver the arcade experience you remember (but with the benefit of more modern game design mechanics and concepts). So we invite take a walk with us into our (virtual) arcade. See if there's a game (or several) that strike your fancy. You can purchase each game individually as DLC for Hope's End, like adding a new arcade cabinet to your collection. We're not out to charge you quarter by quarter like the arcades of old, once the game's yours, it's yours for good. You can play two of the ability sets in our first game, The Psions, for free to take the concept for a spin. So why not take a break and enjoy a game or two? Soak in the atmosphere of a bygone era. Enjoy the havoc and the freedom that a bit of classic arcade chaos can bring, unconstrained by levels, progression, daily missions, or other nonsense that just distracts from the pure fun where it's just you and the game.

rows.name: Monster Knockout
rows.short_description: An ever present threat has emerged from the darkness, it is up to you to travel through monster filled galaxies and defeat every single foe in your path. Choose from a range of super upgradeable bird nodes that allow you to unleash multiple attacks on any enemy
rows.description_html: You are a brave Hero Bird who can't wait for his village to be properly fortified. When evil monsters attacked and stole all the hard work your people had put into their newly - built town walls, you jumped at the chance to save them. Now you're an everyday hero exploring towering castles and bright cities filled with Monster Knockout's wildest baddies! Collect powerful weapons, armour and trickery to take on every challenge; even if it means turning foes into allies… or enemies. The world is yours to protect and loot in Monster Knockout. Explore vibrant 2D landscapes as you save the day. Equip your heroic bird with powerful weaponry. An ever present threat has emerged from the darkness, it is up to you to travel through monster filled galaxies and defeat every single foe in your path. Choose from a range of super upgradeable bird nodes that allow you to unleash multiple attacks on any enemy, upgrade your ship and gain new weapons as you progress all the way to beating the Monster Knockout tournament for a share of $50,000! You are a hero, Knockout (upright Bird), and you will save the planet by defeating Monsters everywhere. Use the mouse to control the bird in the air Release the left click button to shoot the bird into the monsters you fight Continue until all monsters are gone then you will automatically be moved to the next level 100+ Unique levels with different enemy types to fight. Upgrade your characters by purchasing new armour, weapons and more. Help save the little town you come from even if it kills you. Easy to play, hard to master. Mini Games Interactive Main Menu Can you save the town from collapse only you can save them now.

rows.name: Illumina Girls
rows.short_description: Illumina Girls is an exhilarating 3D block breaking game with a new sensation.
rows.description_html: Illumina Girls is an exhilarating 3D block breaking game with a new sensation. The controls are very simple. press right cursor key to move the player to the right, press left cursor key to move the player to the left, and that's it! The level is cleared when all the blocks are broken by hitting back the bouncing ball! If the ball reaches the bottom of the stage, the player will be damaged. Calculate the player's position and fine-tune the angle at which the ball is hit back.

rows.name: Just Dodge, LOL
rows.short_description: When you have no weapon, no magic and no help - just dodge. Complete a set of trials to prove that you are a Dodge Grandmaster!
rows.description_html: Disclamer This game brings a lot of anger due to nearly inadequate challenges and an unbalanced difficulty curve. Most people who tested the game dropped it around level 5. Think twice before purchasing. Description Just Dodge, LOL is a top-down action game that brings a set of trials to the player, while requiring mastering of just one skill: dodging. Earn money, purchase upgrades, and beat challenges to prove that you deserve to be called a Dodge Grandmaster. The game is designed to be hard: no pain - no gain. Game Feartures No lives or game-overs, repeat each trial as long as you want. Multiple upgrades allow for building different completion strategies. Secrets. Secrets everywhere... Various level designs. Catchy soundtrack!

rows.name: Follow The Crown
rows.short_description: Join a thrilling adventure with an Ambassador of the United States & a Hungarian Crown Guard to keep the Hungarian Holy Crown from Nazis and return it to Hungary during the Cold War. You can't trust anyone on this journey; only your wits.
rows.description_html: Story Save and return the Hungarian Holy Crown by using your stealth and diplomacy skills as a Crown Guard and an American Diplomat. Follow the Crown is a third-person historical adventure game set in Hungary that takes place in two different historical eras – the end of WWII and the Cold War. Key Features Sneak across military areas, underground bunkers & other devastated sites from Budapest, Hungary. Discuss matters of state between the US & the USSR with diplomats & other historical figures. Experience history from two different viewpoints but fight for the same goal- the guard & return the Holy Crown to its rightful place in Hungary. Gameplay Explore historical areas in Hungary (in 3rd person) Use stealth to evade soldiers in hostile areas Divert enemies to avoid being detected Take down enemies as you progress through the maps Choose between dialog options during conversation pieces Follow the Crown is developed by Phantom Pixels, a small team from Hungary. The game was funded by the American Embassy Budapest in the framework of the thematic grant proposal of Celebrating 100 Years of Diplomatic Relations between the United States and Hungary under the grant number SHU20021GR3026-M0001.

rows.name: CivIdle
rows.short_description: CivIdle is an idle/incremental game that allows you to lead your own civilization through thousands of years from ancient times to the modern era. Expand your territory, explore a vast tech tree, build various wonders, and trade with global players: empire must grow and numbers must go up!
rows.description_html: Empire Must Grow Expand your empire's territory, production and influence, advance your population's science and culture, and make your people happy - the empire must grow, and numbers must go up! Every Run is Different Explore a procedurally generated map, scouting for resources and natural wonders. Expand your empire and take advantage of different terrains. As technology advances, you can even reshape the terrain. A Vast Tech Tree Research and unlock a vast tech tree with 100+ technologies: from hunting and gathering, through writing and math, all the way to virtual reality and artificial intelligence. As technology advances, you will unlock more game systems and mechanisms that greatly expand the game play. Trade and Diplomacy Trade resources and engage in diplomacy with other players via a global market. Exchanging resources, forming alliances and fighting for influence - can your culture stand in the end? Wonder-full Empire Throughout different eras, construct different world wonders that provide unique bonuses, unlock new game mechanism and make your map look pretty. Reborn with Great People When you prestige, you will be able to collect great people - historical great figures, each with unique bonuses and abilities that will help your next run reach new height. 90s Retro UI A 90's retro UI, that is a love letter to the golden age of desktop computing, will surely bring back some nostalgia. There's a 1-1 replicated mode which brings maximum authenticity and a 'eye protection mode' that captures the essence but is easier on your eye on modern displays. A Game For the People If your computer can run paint, you can probably run CivIdle. Similar to Industry Idle, the game will NOT include any micro transactions. Instead, the base game will be free of charge and you can optionally get more content, support the game's development and help cover the server expense by purchasing paid expansion packs.

rows.name: Ranger Danger
rows.short_description: A park ranger's life is changed forever as they discover what really lurks in their national park. A first-person horror, exploration, and stealth-based game.
rows.description_html: As a park ranger at Mountain View National Park, your job can be pretty mundane -- except for tonight. Something is lurking among the trees and bushes, and now a camper has disappeared. People have reported strange noises, loud stomping, and odd track prints, but no one has spotted any large animals in the area. Is it just another bear, or something.... worse? Play as the park ranger to discover the true reason why campers have been going missing in this first-person, stealth-based horror game. Use your evasiveness skills and tools around you to explore the park for signs of what may have happened to the missing camper. Your flashlight battery is limited so remember to conserve power!

rows.description_html: Introduction to the game: 1. A simple third person survival shooting game 2. In the game, players need to use their only weapon resources to fight against unknown mutant creatures and finally escape successfully 3. There is only one map in the game, and other maps will be updated in the future 4. This game has no archiving system, so be careful at all times. Once you fail, you have to start again 5. Don't have too high expectations about this game 6. In terms of plot, yes! But only one thing Author's words: This game is only made by me. All models and animations are made by myself and the sound effects of monsters are dubbed by myself Therefore, if you feel that the model is not good, or that you feel unhappy in other aspects, please forgive me. I'm a beginner of UE4, and I can't make a great effect. Finally, I hope you can have a good time QQ group of players: 704743708

rows.name: Piranha
rows.short_description: Trotting through deserts, snow and forests to enter a portal by killing the Piranhas using abilities, combat and pickups
rows.description_html: In the sands of time, a lone warrior battles with mammoth giants called Piranhas, collects power as he walks through the blizzards of the desert, snow fields and perilous forests, killing Piranhas with his sword, his goal is to takeover the castle in each level and enter the magical portal to reach the next level. Use abilities which are unlocked by obtaining pickups scattered throughout the level to kill the monsters called 'Piranhas' in the level, or use basic combat for the same. Explore the level to find the portal in the scene to reach the next level. As you kill more Piranhas, you receive more XP and reach higher progression levels.

rows.name: Fallen Arena
rows.short_description: This is a leisure competitive game, fighting for crystals in the arena, getting bigger, defeating opponents. New heroes, new skills and new weapons, call your friends to fight together~
rows.description_html: Background: In 2100, the temperatures have risen by 4 ℃, and as a result, a doomsday disaster formed on the earth. So the survivors were on the road to self-redemption. One day, in a meteorite crater, the survivors found many Mayan monuments and crystals with mysterious power. Afterward, the battle for the crystal began… Main Gameplay: Kill your opponent in the arena, and grab the dropped crystals to gain points. Players with the highest points will win the game. The more points players get, the bigger they will become, and the attack range will become bigger. However, be careful, the movement speed will also decrease at the same time… Map Mechanics: The competitive map is full of crises, highly toxic contaminated liquid, hidden grass, weak and slow poisonous fog, and inaccessible tornadoes, making the battle more tense and exciting. Game Mode: '1P' is the individual battle mode for a single player; '3P' is the team battle mode for 3 players. There is also a custom open room mode to invite friends to play against each other. Heroic Characters: Many heroes with different skills make the battle process more strategic and interesting. Special Weapons: Distinctive weapons with different appearances make you the shining star on the battlefield.

Throughout their journeys, they will face political and societal conflicts throughout the world of Caelum. ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ Lie of Caelum is a JRPG that focuses on engaging combat and a rich story. rows.name: Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heroes (GOLD Edition)
rows.short_description: - World first to achieve a successful serverless online gaming feature by utilizing Locus Chain Blockchain technology - RPG game mode with multi-play capability - Unique RTS/RPG Hybrid
rows.description_html: Kingdom Under Fire : War of Heros Gold Edition Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heores is the world's first Online multiplayer game to utilize Locus Chain Blockchain technology to achieve serverless online gaming experience. We're thrilled to announce a brand-new player dashboard feature (User Game Record System) that's now available for all players of Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heroes, a serverless online multiplayer game. We're about to dive into the world of detailed match data, and it's all thanks to the groundbreaking technology of the Locus Chain blockchain, the rock-solid foundation of KUF: A War of Heroes. With this innovative feature, you're not just playing; you're witnessing the evolution of your gaming prowess. Dive into the numbers, and you'll find everything from your win rate and unit score to your building score and total playtime. Each match's distinctive characteristics are securely recorded on the Locus Chain blockchain. It's like having a treasure trove of your past battles right at your fingertips! What sets this apart is the way we're presenting your achievements. Every game result now leaves a footprint on the blockchain, carrying all the crucial metadata you could ever desire. Our blockchain-based leaderboard offers a tamper-proof view of your journey up the gaming ranks. It's the ultimate proof of your progression along the steep learning curve of Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heroes. We firmly believe that introducing this blockchain-powered leaderboard is a crucial leap forward for esports, where individual player stats are the key to entering the realm of high-stakes battles. The application of blockchain to KUF involves implementing the blockchain as a distributed database, with no manipulation of NFTs or digital assets, including cryptocurrency. Kingdom Under Fire is a real-time strategy game created for the loyal fans of the original Diablo and Starcraft games. The current version is in Early Access with solid plans to release the full game with enhanced graphics preserving the spirit of the original KUF! In Bersia, the land of Helimo’s blessing, the god of light, there were many species living together, including a large number of humans, elves, dwarves, orcs, and ogre monsters, vampires, and lycanthropes. The humans of Bersia flourished, forming a state, serving the gods, and fighting monsters. The harmony of Bersia, which had been maintained according to its own laws throughout its long history, was broken by the war waged by Khilliani, a black wizard who learned to command monsters and dark forces with powerful magic. The dark forces systematically and meticulously invaded human territory, turning even the largest and most powerful of the countries that humans founded into ruins…Now it’s your turn to fight evil! Features: –Intense RTS action: build structures, manage resources, conquer your enemies! –Two factions to choose from: orcs and humans. –The game blends RPG and RTS elements. –Isometric perspective, high fantasy setting. –Looks and feels like Starcraft (the graphics will be overhauled in the full version) –Two modes: single player and multiplayer. –Play and explore 13 missions in single player mode, following along the story and fighting the AI. –Up to 8 players can play the game in multiplayer mode –Upgrade buildings, weapons, and armors to defeat the monsters. Alone or with friends!

rows.name: South Pole Bebop
rows.short_description: A multiplayer turn-based strategy game inspired by Into The Breach, set on a 9x9 board, where you control characters and protect bases. Create a unique deck of ability cards and characters. Eliminate the opponent while fending off a zombie horde. Become a savior of The South Pole!
rows.description_html: Features in-game purchases About the Game A turn-based multiplayer strategy game inspired by Into The Breach. Take down your opponent’s bases or characters to win. Strategize, position your squad, and battle both rivals and zombies. Customize your deck to boost your bases and characters. Pick 3 unique heroes, each with special abilities, and show off your strategic skills! Synopsis A tranquil village in the South Pole has been overrun by mysterious invaders. But where did they come from? A conspiracy surrounds an AI organization that recently expanded in Antarctica. Could they be behind this? rows.name: Of Moons and Mania
rows.short_description: Of Moons and Mania is an interactive psychotic break, based on lived experience. It uses elements of its design to explain the struggles of psychosis, and tells a personal story about mental illness.
rows.description_html: Of Moons and Mania is my account of experiencing a psychotic break, in game form. Inhabit my mind as I lose my grasp on reason. Attempt to piece together cogent responses to questions from doctors, friends, and family as psychosis takes over, and ultimately try to get back to stability. Key Features Inhabit the developer's mind and build your own responses to dialogue. Experience an Autobiographical story detailing the experience of a psychotic break. An hour of gameplay. Developer Statement I started making this game several years after being hospitalized for a manic episode. I was fixated on the experience for the whole time. Trying to piece together what was real and what was dreamt, trying to even remember the sequence of events in chronological order, and every so often when I thought I had shaken the grip of obsessing about the hospitalization, I would have flashbacks that opened up my freshly healed wounds. As a game developer, I was fascinated by some of the systems of thought that were going on in my head, and that gave me the idea for this game. I designed game mechanics and systems to tell the story of my psychosis in a different way than I have seen it expressed before. Making the game really helped me with my flashbacks and organized the way I thought about my illness, and the experience of my hospitalization. I hope that it gives other people some insight into my brain and also into the nature of psychosis and manic depression.

rows.name: Football Club Management 2023
rows.short_description: Take control of a Real Football Club or create your own club, in Football Club Manager 2023 a fast-paced Football Club Management Game. Download Football Club Manager 2023 now for FREE & start your Football management journey.
rows.description_html: Football Club Management 23, is a football club management game written and developed by real football coaches and managers to give players a realistic day-to-day club management experience, that's full of depth yet quick to play. This is the only game available that allows you to become a director of a football club or for you to take over and manage a club as the chairman. Start your career as a Director of Football, either by creating your own club from scratch or by taking on a role at a real football club. Manage all aspects of the club from finances, sponsorships, staff, and player recruitment as you set out your philosophy and vision for the club and look to deliver success to the board and fans. Improve your reputation and move to bigger and better jobs as you earn reputation and build coins to one day being able to mount a takeover and own your very own club and become the chairman! No other game gives you a full club management experience and real day-to-day challenges that Football Club Management 2023 delivers, all with super quick gameplay and TV-style presentation. Can you manage difficult managers, and deal with the demanding sports media? Can you build a title-winning squad, and keep the harmony in the group whilst dealing with high-paid demanding players? Can you build success off the pitch and generate revenues and profits to develop the club? Do you have what it takes to deliver success? Be more than just a manager in Football Club Management 23 From the Makers of the successful Club Soccer Director Game! CHOOSE FROM HUNDREDS OF FOOTBALL CLUBS Choose from 820 Football clubs in 38 leagues from 14 different countries across the world. Create your legacy and build your own team from scratch including home country, club, stadium name, and kit design and take them to the top! UNRIVALLED CLUB-LEVEL FOOTBALL MANAGEMENT Manage every aspect of your Football club’s development and how you invest funds. Develop & upgrade your club's facilities, inc the stadium, fitness centre, medical, training ground, & youth Academy. Increase revenues by negotiating sponsorships. Hire & fire your management team and build your dream squad by negotiating transfers & offers with player agents as well as handling contract negotiations with players and staff alike. EVERY DECISION COUNTS Just like in real life, your decisions affect the attitude of the board, team morale, & even the fans. How you engage with press and media, ticket prices, the quality of your squad & the potential of your Academy prospects all have a bearing. LIFELIKE STATS ENGINE Comprehensive live-action stats engine mirrors real-life player behaviour and match outcomes, processing over 1000 decisions per game & generates real-time statistics for both individual players and teams. DEVELOP THE CLUB Create your own area for the club & develop your stadium, training ground, academy, facilities, fitness centre & medical facilities. MATCH HIGHLIGHTS FCM23 shows key match highlights during the game so you can see those key goals and misses! TACTICAL FREEDOM Leave key decisions to the Football manager or overrule him by implementing your own play style and deciding on team line-up, formation, in and out-of-possession tactics, substitutes and more. COMPREHENSIVE PLAYER DATABASE Buy or loan players from a database of over 30,000 players, each with their own unique play styles, stats, personalities and behaviours. FCM23 continuously generates new players on a regular basis, ensuring you have plenty of talent to choose from whether you’ve been in the hot seat for 1 season or 10! Player cycles continue beyond the pitch as some retiring players go into staff roles just as they do in real life! FULL EDITOR FCM23 has a Full in-game editor that allows you to edit Football team names, ground, kits, players avatars, staff avatars and share them with other players

rows.name: Deluge: Sermon for the Dead
rows.short_description: High school girls have been disappearing from Abbotsford. Unravel the mystery before all things wash away in a tidal wave of deep despair. An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.
rows.description_html: From the depths I call to thee— —Lord, hear my cries for mercy. Abbotsford is struck by a string of abduction cases targeting high school girls. When Ina enlists Abe to help with her investigation, they become ensnared in a web of conspiracy and horror that pulls them into the deepest depths of the ocean. In the meantime, campaigning has begun for the town council elections. While political infighting rises to an all time high, Marisa — the new girl in town — takes center stage. She promises stability, but an appetite for uncontested power glistens in her eyes. Deluge: Sermon for the Dead is an interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones. FEATURES Carefully crafted mystery visual novel where choices matter. Three different ending routes to explore, leading to a total of eight different endings. (3 good, 5 bad endings.) Immersive game world with fleshed out characters and countless settings. Intuitive user interface. Non-repetitive, atmospheric soundtrack spanning multiple hours.

rows.description_html: This is a tower defense type of casual game, suitable for you to pass the time when bored. In the game, enemies stream out of the portal, and you can destroy them by building defense towers. For each enemy killed, you get a certain amount of gold. Since enemies get stronger as the game progresses, you'll need to build new towers with the gold you earn. When the total number of enemies exceeds a certain number, the game is over. Of course, you can also buy items in the store, and with the items you buy in the store, you can kill a certain number of enemies in an instant.

rows.name: Blackout Football Manager
rows.short_description: Take your place as head coach and club manager in this Online Multiplayer Football Manager game. Your knowledge will be tested as you take your club to new heights and square up against other real users world-wide. Do you have what it takes to be the greatest Football Manager?
rows.description_html: Build your dream football team from the ground up and manage their way to fame and glory with one of the most robust sports management sim systems available, designed from the ground up by passionate sports fans, the same team behind Blackout Rugby. Blackout Football Manager puts you in charge of your team’s most critical functions, from deciding the best training regimes to installing the perfect club facilities and even managing your team’s finances – but only the fun parts. Your club’s board handles the mundane things like actually keeping track of money so you can just make and spend it. Blackout Football Manager features a card system that helps you organize your day and rewards you with boosts for certain actions. Whether you prioritize training or strategizing for an upcoming match is up to you, but every action has consequences on how your team performs. Think carefully before deciding who to bench and how best to build your club. Every potential team member has a unique set of mental and physical traits that distinguishes their performance on the field and helps inform your match-day plans. Scout the opposition and create a strategy that plays to your team’s unique strengths,and if you have a gap that needs filling, head to the in-game market or scout the competition to sign some new talent with Blackout Football Manager’s streamlined negotiation system. Key Features: ● Deep, yet easy to learn team and club management ● Unique player attributes to help build strong and varied teams ● Customizable lineups and team formations! ● Extensive tech trees for customizing your club and infrastructure ● Robust in-game market for easy player trading ● Streamlined money and contract managing ● A innovative, unique card system, allowing you to prioritize performance! ● Deep and highly customizable training regimes. ● Extensive customizable tactics, allowing you to show off your football knowledge. ● And much more!

rows.name: Ninza
rows.short_description: Ninza is a free multiplayer game like no other! Instead of directly attacking your opponents, you crush them by pushing pieces of the level. Embrace chaos and dive into an entirely new level of frenzied and creative gameplay, where the environment itself becomes both your weapon and your enemy.
rows.description_html: The level is both your weapon AND your enemy! Every single part of the level can be pushed around by your attacks. Anticipate your opponents movements to squash them between blocks or to throw them out of the screen. Intuitive, intense, and delightfully brutal! Up to 4 players, local and online, solo training modes Online, you can fight against random opponents or host your own casual games to play with your friends. Enjoy a smooth brawling experience thanks to rollback technology (lag compensation system). If you'd rather fancy a delightful evening of friendship ruining chaos, just gather up to 4 players to fight on the same screen. Pick your character, master their powers Choose between a diverse cast of vibrant and original characters, who each got their own moveset and abilities. Learn to master their strengths and weakenesses to shine on the battlefield! Enter the competitive scene and become a legend Participate in the competitive scene through ranked matchs. Level up your ranks and grind your way to the top of our leaderboards! Every new season is filled with unique rewards and a new playable character. Easy to play, fun to master Ninza is easy to play, but don't be fooled, there's a lot of spectacular and creative moves you can pull out if you're up to the task. The game offers plenty of options to help you improve in solo mode and to become a pro in no time: videos, tutorials, practice mode, or even trials. Your journey to the top is already laid out! A big collection of unlockable cosmetics Take on the challenges of the Mo0n to unlock more than 200 unique cosmetics to show off your style and skill. Choose from a wide selection of wacky in-game taunts and express yourself with a profile customisation system that offers a ton of possibilities. A Free to play game but with a no bullshit strict policy No pay-to-win. DLCs are cheap and limited to new characters and access to some very specific cosmetics only. Basically, it's a no to annoying and intrusive microtransactions because, we all hate that. The Mo0n. Floating up in the sky, observing every one of your moves, and offering highly judgmental commentary on them. Also, it's essential to know that the Mo0n is everything.

rows.name: Blindsight: War of the Wardens
rows.short_description: 'Blindsight: War of the Wardens' is a story-driven brawler where you play as Iggy, a blind martial arts master with echolocation abilities, as he retrieves a stolen family heirloom that may bring unintended consequences to the universe.
rows.description_html: JOIN THE BLINDSIGHT: WAR OF THE WARDENS DISCORD About the Game Blindsight: War of the Wardens is a story-driven brawler where you play as Iggy Yin, a martial arts master with echolocation abilities, as he retrieves a stolen family heirloom that may bring unintended consequences to the universe. Throw punches and swing kicks at hordes of enemies, chaining them together to unleash epic combos! With the power of your amulet, nothing can stand in your way. String together attacks, counters, dodges, and finishers with the beat-em up combat system Harness your amulet to sense surrounding environments, heal between fights, and blind enemies with explosions of light Face bosses on their own turf in your journey to recover the relic In a world balanced by 5 powerful relics, there are great mysteries around every corner. On your journey to reclaim Iggy's family relic, you will travel from shrines to cities, down racing rivers, and even through portals! Explore 3 distinctly themed areas, inspired by the likes of 80s kung-fu movies and EDM venues Bash your way through gangs of enemies as you make your way towards boss fights Use your sense of sound to 'see' your way through each level Play as Iggy, a blind martial artist who is on a quest to recover a stolen family relic. He was born into a family of wardens who protect the Relic of Life, one of five mystical relics scattered across the world. But because of his blindness, his mom wouldn't let him be a warden. When his dad goes missing and the Relic of Life is stolen by another warden family, Iggy finally gets the chance to prove himself--and find out what happened to his dad in the process.

rows.name: Maruja Mallo
rows.short_description: Enjoy this visual novel about Maruja Mallo's life! Help her recovering her artistic souls. Fix her paintings using your mouse to relocate pieces of the painting, interact and explore paintings using your mouse.
rows.description_html: Enjoy this visual novel about Maruja Mallo's life! Help her recovering her artistic souls. You will find them in her most iconic paintings and events of her artistic life. To recover them you will have to solve puzzles and other games that will teach you more about her. You will meet the emblematic people of the Generation of ‘27 who were part of her life! Fix her paintings using your mouse to relocate pieces of the painting, interact and explore paintings using your mouse. You will learn details about Maruja Mallo's work and create your own painting using a base and the pieces you have been recollecting through your journey, creating a great collage! Maruja Mallo, between Verbena and Scarecrow, all the beauty of the world fits within the eye. Her pictures are the ones I have seen painted with most imagination, emotion and sensuality.

rows.name: Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator: PROLOGUE
rows.short_description: Evergreen is a simulation game about leaving the stress of the city behind and starting a new life in a mountain valley.
rows.description_html: Evergreen is a simulation game about leaving the stress of the city behind and starting a new life in a mountain valley. This simulation game is meant to be a relaxing and calming experience. Forget about stressful hunger, health or temperature meters. Build your house with your own hands, collect the resources that nature provides, travel to a small village to sell what you don't need, buy supplies in stores and admire the wonders of nature. In the Evergreen prologue, you will be able to experience your first day in the valley. The map size is limited, but the main mechanics are all there and polished. Chop down trees, mine stone and start building your new home in this beautiful world. Take your car and travel to a nearby town to buy some supplies or furniture to decorate your place. Don't forget to add the full game to your wishlist and visit the store page to see what is included in the complete game!

rows.name: Mean Beans
rows.short_description: Mean Beans is a FREE Battle Royale FPS where being the last bean alive isn't the only way to win! Play multiple rounds and collect points by not only being the last player standing, but killing other players as well! The bean with the most points at the end wins!
rows.description_html: Mean Beans is a fast-paced, FREE, battle royale FPS where you can fight to the death online or with your friends! Kill your friends in style with unique weapons and over 100+ hats! Become the last legume standing in this ridiculous action-packed shooter! ONLINE MULTIPLAYER - KILL RANDOMS OR FRIENDS Mean Beans lets 2-10 players to engage in quick, intense, and crazy bean battles. Whether it's killing your friends, or foes online, it's every bean's dream to be the last legume standing. WACKY WEAPONS From crazy Rocket Launchers to ridiculous Pong Guns, Mean Beans lets you juice those other beans with dozens of unique weapons. Make your own refried beans with the Flamethrower or be a little more extreme with the Grenade Launcher, all is fair in beans and war! BECOME THE LAST LEGUME STANDING! This fast-paced battle royale beananza lets you prove yourself in other ways than just being the last player alive. Kill other beans and collect wins to increase your score, and ultimately the player with the highest score wins!

rows.name: Welcome to Levy
rows.short_description: All the women in Levy have disappeared. Why did they leave in bare feet? Discover their story along with 680 CGs and 11 unique endings in this apocalyptic visual novel.
rows.description_html: Levy was a sleepy one stop town before the Cataclysm turned the nearby city of Savannah into a wasteland. Now the survivors are trapped between the alien world that has replaced the city and the constant war and famine of the collapsing society outside. This is the story of the few who still remain in the town of Levy. Features 11 unique endings Over 680 adult CGs Branching story line Grim apocalyptic setting HD Art pack available with all CGs

rows.name: Mech vs. Bugs
rows.short_description: In Mech vs Bugs, you'll pilot a mech to fend off alien insects on remote planets. Combining intense top-down combat with strategic looting and crafting, your goal is to liberate the galaxy, one insect-infested planet at a time. Ready for your thrilling, third-person adventure?
rows.description_html: In Mech vs Bugs, your role as a solo mech pilot will see you defending against relentless alien invasions on remote planets. This game is an exciting merge of top-down, third-person action reminiscent of titles like Vampire Survivors and Brotato. Brimming with intense battles, strategic loot collection, and in-depth crafting, you'll continuously improve your mech to combat waves of insectoid foes. With each planet you liberate, the stakes increase in this thrilling journey from one alien world to the next. Mech vs Bugs places you at the helm of an advanced mechanized unit, the last line of defense against an alien invasion. As a solo pilot, you will traverse various planets, combating swarms of insectoid enemies in adrenaline-fueled, close-quarter combat scenarios. The game's third-person top-down perspective puts you right in the center of the action. Insectoid enemies will relentlessly rush you in melee waves, each one tougher than the last. With your piloting skills and strategic mindset, you'll maneuver your mech, hold your ground, and collect precious loot from your defeated enemies. Beyond the battlefield, engage with the game's comprehensive market and crafting systems. Use your loot to trade on the market, negotiate for valuable goods, and purchase upgrades for your mech. Craft advanced weapons and shields from your resources, reinforcing your mech to face the next wave of alien onslaught. As you liberate each planet from the insectoid menace, the challenges grow fiercer, the alien hordes more intense. Adapt and thrive or fall under the alien wave. Your mech stands as the only barrier between these invaders and total galactic domination. Key Features Frenzied Solo Mech Combat: Hold back hordes of melee-rushing insectoid aliens with your high-tech mech. Experience the thrill of top-down bullet heaven gameplay. Strategic Looting and Trading: Gather valuable loot from defeated enemies. Trade at the market, and utilize your resources to bolster your mech's defenses. In-depth Crafting System: Combine your loot and purchased goods to craft potent mech upgrades, enhancing your combat performance against the ever-escalating alien threat. Dynamic Progression: Every liberated planet increases the intensity of your battles, pushing your skills and strategy to the limit. Immersive Visuals: Delve into stunning, Unreal Engine-powered alien landscapes that set the stage for your epic defense of the galaxy. In Mech vs Bugs, fast-paced mech combat, tactical gameplay, and a deep progression system combine to create an electrifying gaming experience. Can you withstand the insectoid onslaught and save the galaxy?

rows.name: AMBER Battle Royale
rows.short_description: Play AMBER - the next generation of free-to-play Battle Royale. Jump from a plane to Misfit Island and land with a Jetpack. Collect weapons and destroy enemies in three PvP modes: Battle Royale, Elimination, Deathmatch. Collect first aid kits, shield, and fuel. Up to 200 players in one match!
rows.description_html: Play AMBER - the next generation of free-to-play Battle Royale. Jump from a plane to Misfit Island and land with a Jetpack. Collect weapons and destroy enemies in three PvP modes: Battle Royale, Elimination, Deathmatch. Collect first aid kits, shield, and fuel. Up to 200 players in one match! Battle Royale: Take on the next generation of Battle Royale with a drop by plane to an island! Land with the Jetpack and use it during battle to fly across the map. Avoid the zone, which constantly shrinks, building up tension during the game. Collect all the weapons, stock up on ammo and shields. Kill all enemies and score a royal victory Elimination: It's the same as in Battle Royale but this time you don't have to drop from the plane, instead you spawn on the map with 4 lives and your task is to survive and kill all the players. You and your enemies will be brought closer together by a constantly shrinking area. The bravest and toughest player will win Deathmatch: traditional combat mode where you fight against all other players. To win you need to accumulate 25 kills, Use a variety of weapons, grenades, and Jetpack to find your style of play and defeat all enemies. Features - Up to 200 players in one match - Modern multiplayer servers with lag compensation - Fly across the map with Jetpack - A variety of weapons, from pistols to assault and sniper rifles - A fantasy world where modernity and antiquity meet

rows.name: Exhibitors
rows.short_description: Deep within the clouds of a gas giant, supermassive creatures occupy the sky, each exhibiting an ecosystem. Exhibitors is a Factory building game with elements of farming and exploration.
rows.description_html: Deep within the clouds of a gas giant, supermassive creatures occupy the sky, each exhibiting an ecosystem. Exhibitors is a Factory building game with elements of farming and exploration. Exploring deep within a gas giant, you did not expect to find life beneath the clouds. Upon closer inspection super massive floating creatures called exhibitors can be observed, each holding an ecosystem upon their backs. These ecosystems range widely depending upon the exhibitors' size, material composition and temperature. You decide to explore each of these biomes, learning about the ecosystem and the organisms that inhabit them. As you learn more about them, you decide to begin ranching and farming. Eventually you begin to increase production and efficiency as you continue to research the organisms. This increased production slowly harms the parent creature and its ecosystem. Good thing you can always jump between newer and bigger ecosystems as you find them. Features: Explore the different worlds. Each biome has over 10+ plants and animals for you to observe. Each biome/ecosystem is unique in their own way where the plants and animals within them have evolved in their into their own biological niches. Learn about these organisms and understand their behaviors by observing and researching them. Be a part of the world. As you run around and observe these organisms, you stop to take notes and create quick sketches of these plants and animals. The further you observe the organisms, the more detailed these drawings become. The more you get to know these plants and animals, the more you learn about how to utilize them. Make the exhibitor your own Work towards terraforming and controlling the exhibitors. Start with small outposts and slowly move towards megafactories. As you learn and discover new exotic recipes, the production possibilities increase. But be careful, each exhibitor only has a finite amount of resources and a delicate ecosystem. When an ecosystem falls out of balance, the exhibitor may begin to sink into the depths of the planet. Venture deep into the planet. When you venture deeper into the planet, the sizes of the exhibitors increase by the magnitudes. The larger these ecosystems become, the more biodiversity there is. These larger ecosystems provide the energy needed for larger and more niche species to thrive. Possibly increasing the production possibility and unlocking more exotic recipes. Make the planet your own Once you reach a certain level, everything becomes possible. These exhibitors become your world, allowing you to control where they move and how they behave. Create meta-structures to control the temperature, humidity, air composition and more. Eventually you may even be able to create your own exhibitors.

rows.name: VED: Purification
rows.short_description: VED is a story-driven RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and rogue-lite elements. The free version 'Purification' lets you explore the very beginning of VED's narrative and see if its world, art style and music draw you in - and continue where you left off in the full game!
rows.description_html: VED is a story-driven RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and rogue-lite elements. Embark on a magical adventure set in a vivid world in stunning, hand-painted graphics. Explore mysterious islands, defeat monsters, and master the magic of the Veds!  The free version 'Purification' serves as a prologue to the main game so you can sample its combat system, narrative style and teleportation between the magical and human worlds, but not spoil the full story for yourself!  Its events are set 30 years prior to the narrative of VED, following a different character, a Vedic warrior by the name of Dook, who fell in love with a magical being. But as the Vedic order is sworn to keep the magical and the mundane worlds separate, eliminating any semblance of magic from the human world, theirs is certainly a complicated love story; and it’s up to you to decide how it will end…

rows.name: ALLON3
rows.short_description: A phychological horror experience of voices and screams.
rows.description_html: Awakening in a dark, seemingly abandoned city, the sky obscured by dripping concrete, you hear a voice. 'Help!' it cries. A sound of fearful desperation amidst threatening halls. Do you follow the voice, or look for a way out? Enter the city, and make your choice. Some voices cry for help, someone's whispering, shouting, talking to you, waiting, pushing you to find what's hidden in this empty town. Explore the back alleys and corridors of abandoned and trashed streets, buildings and stairs, leading you closer to the cry for help that's screaming for you to come. ALLON3 is a surreal and atmospheric horror experience, that features 3D sound driven story. So many voices are guiding you, yet you are completely alone and abandoned. Find your way out, find out who's calling for help, who's whispering into your ears and what kind of place did you end up in in the first place.

Returning from another sea adventure, Captain Sam's pirate ship gets caught in a mystical storm. Waking up on the shores of one of the islands of a mysterious archipelago, Sam finds none of his crew. Armed with his trusty saber, the captain is ready to set off on a new adventure and treasure, but first he must learn the fate of his crew members. Sam does not yet realize how many trials and secrets the mystical evil sealed in this mysterious land has prepared for him. Solve puzzles Buy upgrades for your equipment and new items Participate in sea battles Choose various ways to complete the levels ! Play as a possessed Fast-paced action gameplay Use new features to quickly move around the level Combine hurricane-fighting and special skills to defeat your enemies Try to escape from the bosses chasing Sam and find a way to defeat them! As Captain Sam, you will explore five different islands and mystical temples. Each location has its own mechanics. Use the skills and items you learn to progress through the story ! Meet your enemies : Shy sand monsters and Bloodthirsty slow zombies Crazed birds and Armored green goos Mystical stalkers lurking in the depths of mysterious temples And many other !

While clinging to your axe and the fragile glow of your lantern, the only thing keeping you from madness. Utilize the light from your lantern to blind enemies and the oil inside to burn away corrupted vines blocking your path. Break down wooden boards and cut down enemies with your axe. Lastly use light pedestals and mirrors to reflect light beams to burn away corrupted vines you can't reach yourself. Keep the light alive, preserve your sanity, and confront your deepest fears in Lantern Light. This game was made as a Senior Capstone project for RPI's Games and Simulation Arts and Sciences program.

rows.name: Age of Pyramids
rows.short_description: Age of Pyramids is a sandbox city builder and simulator set in Ancient Egypt. You take on the city governor and architect’s mantle to build the most incredible city on Earth. You will have to gather dozens of resources to maintain happiness of your people and prosperity.
rows.description_html: Age of Pyramids is a sandbox city builder and simulator set in Ancient Egypt. You take on the city governor and architect’s mantle to build the most incredible city on Earth. On your journey to please Gods and Pharaons alike, you will relive the authentic life in one of the most epic civilizations that ever existed on Earth. Experience the simulation of this world like never before and build unseen monuments. You will discover and learn how much time and what resources it takes to build monuments and landmarks that defy the hand of time. In the Age of Pyramids, the only limitation to achieving your dreams is your own imagination. This game is for players who love relaxing games where you are not punished for your mistakes. As a player, you will build a city and generate enough resources to build one or more ancient great pyramids. To achieve this high goal you have to build road infrastructure, water canals, residences, temples, food gatherers and other buildings. Also, you need to supply your people with various kinds of food and water. Most important of all is keeping your people happy. People's happiness brings you enough manpower to build ancient wonders. The Nile is a great river with flood cycles, and you must use it well. Each building has to be built in the right terrain spot because resources are located in few places in their amount is limited. The growing city brings new challenges regarding resource management and new opportunities to unlock more buildings.

rows.name: Krusenstern: A Stellar Sail
rows.short_description: This is a monumental immersive project that tells the story of Russia’s first circumnavigation by captains Krusenshtern and Lisyansky on board Nadezhda and Neva. Walk in captain’s shoes, recruit a ship crew, secure the Emperor’s backing and sail out on a history-altering journey.
rows.description_html: Thundering cannons, sails flapping in the wind, and the ship’s deck creaking – one of the most dangerous sea voyages of the 19th century lies ahead. Walk in Captain Ivan Kruzenshtern’s shoes, recruit a ship crew, secure the Emperor’s backing and sail out on Russia’s first, history-making circumnavigation. Kronstadt, Nuku Hiva’s indigenous cannibal tribes, snowy Alaska, unapproachable Japan, and China with its perils, and all this against the backdrop of violent storms, major sea battles, geographic discoveries, overcoming the challenges of maritime navigation, and a delicate interplay between onboard diplomacy and international relations. Kruzenshtern. A Stellar Sail is a monumental immersive project that tells the story of Russia’s first circumnavigation, undertaken by captains Kruzenshtern and Lisyansky on board Nadezhda and Neva. We re-enacted the chronicle of this historic voyage by relying on the protagonists’ diaries and hundreds of historical documents. The two ships spent over three years at sea, sailed through six seas and three oceans to accomplish a legendary feat. It is now your turn to become part of Russian naval history.

rows.short_description: Are you ready to conquer and plunder the seas with your fleet?
rows.description_html: Upgrade your ship, level up and make sure you're strong enough to send your enemies overboard. Equip your ship with advanced cannons, elite cannonballs, a qualified crew and skilled pirates. And don't miss out on the many special materials that will help you on your way to becoming a glorious pirate. Build your own mighty army and strike fear into your enemies by building or joining a fleet in Naval Battle Online. Together you can conquer the islands and become a very strong wedding ring. Be the ruler of the great seas. By taking daily quests, you can gain more experience points and speed up your development. Reinforce your friendships and show that you are a great team player by participating in regular events. If your ship is stronger than other players, you can see your ship name in the game ranking.

rows.name: Don't Remember
rows.short_description: In Don’t Remember, some things are better left forgotten. Fight your amnesia in this atmospheric, first person psychological horror game. Solve the mystery of the old mansion in 1900’s England through the use of your lantern’s various colors and face its hidden grotesque visage.
rows.description_html: Horror made anew Don't Remember aims to rethink how both players and developers approach horror games, and bring a new and fresh experience to the table. Immerse yourself in this dark and atmospheric environment with dynamic audio which adapts to the way you play and makes each playthrough slightly unique. Uncover the story of William, a once renowned alchemist, now lost to his own schizophrenic mind. Dig up the remnants of Williams forgotten past and the reason for his amnesia through the power of colors, which allow you to solve many puzzles scattered throughout this inconspicuously twisted mansion. Features: Power of colors: A lightsource has been a staple in nearly all horror games, use it to your advantage! Find and unlock new colors to your lantern which allow you to explore the mansion further and progress the story in this semi-open, metroidvania-style mansion. Procedural experience: Experience procedurally generated events and scares in the game, making each gameplay feel just a little different. Tense narrative: Experience a thrilling story told through professional voice actors and award-winning writers

An new take on action roguelike platformers drawing inspiration from the 2D souls-like combat from Dead Cells, the scale of Shadow of the Colossus and the enchanting world of Princess Mononoke. Master challenging combat, befriend woodland creatures and restore balance to the ancient ecosystem. Features A short and sweet experience with 20 minute runs Difficult combat requires skillful movement and positioning Unlock weapons and animal abilities to customize your build each run Many accessibility and gameplay options Plant your own garden in between battles Full controller support Koboo: The Tree Spirit wouldn't be possible without the incredible support of our amazing Kickstarter community. You can follow our development and talk to us live on Discord anytime, we will respond as soon as possible. Thank you! ❤ - Jerome and Simon

rows.name: Ferromon Together
rows.short_description: Journey with your friends in the free to play world of Ferromon Together and take on the 10 towers with over 140 Ferromon to save the world's inhabitants from the Tainted!
rows.description_html: Journey with your friends in the world of Ferromon Together and take on the 10 towers with over 140 Ferromon to save the world's inhabitants from the Tainted. The entire game is free to play, with a cosmetic pass DLC available to those who want to support development. Work together with your friends to build, craft, and train to progress in this fun to play RPG. Now arguably most importantly, what exactly can you do with your friends? The answer is everything! Every non pvp battle that occurs in the world can be joined by 9 players! This is done through the Link System. When you are linked in a battle, all damage, jamming, and healing to the enemy is replicated, as well as half the damage to your monsters and half of friendly healing. This allows you to strategically work with your friends to take down strong enemies. Work together to clear the 10 Towers that are spread out across the map, and the final boss that comes after that!

rows.name: The Keyless: Awakening
rows.short_description: The Keyless: Awakening is a journey through a dreamlike and surreal world, witnessing bizarre, metaphorical and surreal scenes as you overcome simple challenges.
rows.description_html: The Keyless: Awakening is a journey through a dreamlike, surreal world where the lines between reality and fantasy blur. In this first-person 3D experience, you play as a protagonist trapped in a mysterious, endless place. Explore endless corridors and fields of red roses, face simple metaphorical challenges, and encounter bizarre creatures. Those who have found themselves in this strange place before you have left a note for you to read with their last thoughts. The game has many interpretations and the gameplay consists of walking and running, alternating simple challenges with bizarre, metaphorical and surreal scenes, each fork in the road will slightly modify the environment and the paths. It's about going through metaphorical situations, watching the environment transform as you choose a path, and interpreting what you see through the lens of dreams, life and death. Developed by a single person with Unreal Engine.

rows.name: Hallowed Pumpkins
rows.short_description: Hallowed Pumpkins is a simple survival light-horror with shooting and hiding mechanics. For the best experience this game is recommended to be played in multiplayer mode with your friends to fight with or against each other.
rows.description_html: The game sets on a pumpkin farm where two teams are fighting against. There's the Farmers whose main objective is to water a given amount of pumpkins and the other team called Lurkers are trying to prevent that by catching them. The lurkers have the ability to transform themselves into a pumpkin to blend into the environment and emerge as soon as they feel ready to go. The farmers are carrying a shotgun with limited ammo along with a watering can that can run out of water. These can be recharged at one of the two barns located on the map. There are three main adjustable parameters that determines one game: How many pumpkins to spawn, How many pumpkins to water, How many Lurker AIs to spawn (set it up if you wish to play in coop with your friends). A game will end if the number of pumpkins to water are met or all farmers or lurkers are dead. The game only supports friend based matchmaking through Steam overlay.

rows.name: Darkenstein 3D
rows.short_description: A retro shooter inspired by classics like Wolfenstein and Doom. Think of it as a tribute, a love letter to the games that defined a generation, with a few modern touches of my own. It’s tough, fast, and demands skill, just the way those old-school shooters did.
rows.description_html: Step into the chaos of Darkenstein 3D, a bullet-dodging retro FPS set deep behind enemy lines. Inspired by the brutal pace of Return to Castle Wolfenstein and the glory days of late 90s shooters, this game blends secrets, explosive physics, and a story driven by desperation… and a dog. You play as the Hobo Guy: a furious American drifter lost in enemy territory, armed with nothing but a shotgun and pure vengeance. It’s 1940s Germany, and though you’re outnumbered and outgunned, you won’t back down. This isn’t about justice, it’s personal! Gunther, your loyal companion, was taken during a Nazi raid. Now he’s locked away deep inside enemy fortresses. To get him back, you’ll need to push your limits through an uphill battle against the Axis forces. Along the way, you’ll uncover alien secrets, strange powers, and hidden horrors in a world crumbling under war. Fast, brutal, skill-based. Darkenstein 3D doesn’t hold your hand. Enemy projectiles can be dodged, but survival requires sharp movement, precise aim, and quick thinking. Every battle is a deadly dance of strafes and corners. No cover mechanics, no aim assist, just raw gunplay. Take on 13 handcrafted levels that steadily raise the stakes. Explore castles, caves, valleys, and desert towns. Unlock doors with hidden keys, discover secrets, hunt for treasure, and push your score higher and higher. You won’t fight alone. A vicious rat companion joins the bloodbath, lunging at enemies and sowing chaos in close quarters. Combine him with grenades and mines for maximum destruction. He’s small, angry, and always hungry. Explosive gore, ragdoll physics, and debris-filled firefights: every shot feels heavy, and every kill looks painful. Enemies fly, gib, and collapse in glorious carnage as the battlefield crumbles around you. No microtransactions. No battle passes. No currencies. Just one complete, standalone retro FPS the way it used to be. Built over four years by a single developer, Darkenstein 3D is a passion project turned full campaign. It’s hard, it’s funny, it’s handcrafted, and it’s packed with hours of replayable carnage.

rows.name: Orbit
rows.short_description: Orbit is a Multiplayer Platformer game. Customise your own character and battle other Players and/or AI controlled Bots across a variety of randomly generated planets. Gain the advantage by earning XP and looting each Planet before your opponents do!
rows.description_html: Orbit is a Multiplayer Platformer game. Battle against other Players and/or AI controlled Bots across a variety of different planets. Gain the advantage by earning XP and looting each Planet before your opponents do! Features: - Gravity Mechanic - Players can travel around all 4 sides of a Planet, adding new ways to explore the map. - Full Multiplayer/Online Support - Players can easily host and join other games at the click of a button. - Random Procedural Generation - Planets are randomly generated meaning levels/maps are different each round. - Customisation - Characters can be customised with a variety of different Armours and Colours. - XP/Leveling System - Earn XP by looting and fighting. This can then be used to gain new abilities and upgrade stats of your choice, depending on your own playstyle. - Weapons - From a 'Giant Battery' to a 'Snake-Whip', there's many weapons to find to defeat your enemies with. - Abilities/Finishers - Each weapon has a 'Special' attack linked with it. rows.name: KABENAGURI
rows.short_description: This is a game of punching walls.
rows.description_html: I like to watch live fighting game videos. However, I dislike playing fighting games. Because the stress of losing in a fighting game drives me crazy. I made this fighting game 【KABENAGURI】 to escape from that stress. 【KABENAGURI】 is a game in which you punch a wall for one minute. You can attack the wall as much as you want. You can attack as much as you want. Take all the stress you usually accumulate and throw it against the wall. The damage on the wall will be your score, and you can aim for the top ranking! In order to bring you closer to the feel of a fighting game, you can use a single attack button for both weak and strong attacks, and there are also command moves that are familiar to players of fighting games. Let`s KABENAGURI !!

rows.name: Engine Evolution 2023
rows.short_description: Your favorite racing MMO is back with amazing tracks, more entertaining physics, and much more! Enjoy multiplayer racing action more intensely than ever before!
rows.description_html: I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated terrains into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game. Engine Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to World of Tanks - with each race against 11 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines of 1906. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery? Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion for riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics and you need to keep that in mind. - 100 historic vehicles from 7 nations - 40 real and custom tracks - 1000+ of various vehicle setups - 100+ vehicle patterns - 10 different biomes Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. You can paint your vehicles with any combination of colors or hundreds of available patterns. The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers! CONQUER THE RESEARCH TREE!

rows.name: Big Survivor
rows.short_description: Survive, with a smile on your face! Fight your way through the scribbles, as you power up and become stronger. Vibe with the tornadoes and get a useless pet. Increase your sucking and suck away!!!!!!?
rows.description_html: Big Survivor is a game all about surviving, bigly. More specifically it's a roguelike survivor game, original ik. You might be thinking, 'It has to be unique in some aspects right?'... yeah, well, you know... there's some stuff... I drew the enemies myself that's a big one. This description was written by multiple people so prepare for a mood shift. There are lots of powerups to try out and have fun with, discover what they do and figure out which ones you like the most! Some of the key features are... Being able to move Choose power ups Levelling High score comparing No Menu Timed gameplay Bearing no resemblance to Vampire Survivor I don't know what it will take for this description to get approved, so here's a step by step instruction how to play the game: 1. Open file 2. Press big play button 3. Move with WASD or mouse 4. Manoeuvre around enemies, attacking is automatic 5. Level-up by collecting orbs/killing enemies 6. Choose a good power-up 7. Die -> 2. 8. Press big exit button. You can't get here, I couldn't be bothered making one. It's a free game, with great replay value so try it out now; It's free so why not?! Did I mention it's free? Thanks for playing!! Music by Karl Sandegren
