rows.name: Castle Of Secrets: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Castle of Secrets — a game with a deep and mysterious storyline, beautiful 3D graphics, unique gameplay and mechanics, will immerse you in a fairy tale of reality and mystery. How will this fairy tale end? It's your call.
rows.description_html: Special Offer About the Game The curse of the ancient Trantons family forces young Miss Susan leave for a deadly journey, where she is about to face many inhabitants of the world of the dead, find both friends and enemies, and get answers to the most important questions on who is the true killer of her entire family. 'Castle of Secrets is a beautiful and enthralling visual novel featuring many interesting quests, mechanics and puzzles, such as crafting items, inventory, camera control and character control in 3d space. Puzzles can be regular, where you have to connect the right items to each other, or these can be mini-games, where you have to think a little differently. As you progress through the game, the complexity of puzzles and quests increases and solving them will not be as easy as at the beginning. The game offers a tutorial level that will guide the player through all the its mechanics. Enjoy beautiful graphics and nice animation. Use all the tools that the game offers you to solve the most difficult puzzles and mini-games.' The prologue includes: - Tutorial level - 2 full levels - Additional mini-game - 5 characters - 10 cut scenes - 25 quests

Battle against the monstrous Mu and his army of fruits, as you mix and match to create delicious fruit cocktails that pack a punch. But be warned, these fruits are not your average ones. They're explosive and ready to knock you off your game. It's up to you to stay on your toes and use your lightning-fast reflexes to dodge and strike back. With Frupu VR Fruit Punch, you'll have access to an array of combat moves, from left and right jabs to swift dodges, all designed to help you fight off Mu's minions and become the ultimate fruit punch master. As you progress, the challenges get tougher and the stakes higher, but don't worry, the rewards are even sweeter! So, if you're ready to put your VR skills to the test, head to download Frupu VR Fruit Punch now. It's time to mix, match, and punch your way to the top!

rows.name: Echo of the Last Light
rows.short_description: The worlds of light and dark are in danger. Will the creatures of the light be the key to saving your homeland in the dark? Journey with your new companion to discover how you can save the world while fending off those who would harm you and your companion.
rows.description_html: Student Collaboration With the University of Utah: The Fat Bear Society, a studio consisting of 2 producers, 5 artists, 5 engineers, 4 designers, and 2 musicians, worked for 10 months to deliver Echo of the Last Light. This 3D action-adventure puzzle game was created in a simulated-studio environment at the Graduate Games Lab at the University of Utah, but the project is 100% student-run and student-owned. Prepare to be blown away by our incredible non-profit project! Overview: In a world where The Echoes used to light up the sky, the last light is your only hope. Together with the Echo, a creature of light, you embark on a mission to rescue the world from the encroaching darkness. Will you save the world or become consumed by the Abyss? In Echo of the Last Light, you will explore a beautiful yet perilous world, team up with a mysterious creature, and engage in combat against the enemies of The Royal Eclipse. With a captivating story, puzzles, and thrilling action, this game seamlessly blends exploration, combat, and adventure. Collaborate with your companion to unlock new abilities and uncover hidden secrets in the world. Play as Tamasis, Humble Light Follower In Echo of the Last Light, you play as Tamasis, a follower of The Humble Light, a group of moths dedicated to preserving the world's light. Your mission is to find the only remaining source of light, a creature that becomes your companion. You must bring the last light to The Tree of Humble Light to save the world from The Royal Eclipse, who seeks its destruction. Along the way, you will team up with The Last Light, fight the enemies of The Royal Eclipse, and uncover secrets that will alter the world's fate. Fight Enemies With Your Companion Join forces with your trusty companion to overcome challenging puzzles and take down the enemies of The Royal Eclipse in Echo of the Last Light. With the Echo ability, you'll be able to uncover hidden secrets and see what others cannot. Collaborate with your companion to use your enhanced abilities to your advantage, and work together to fight your way through hordes of enemies. Uncover Secrets in The World, What Cannot Be Seen Your companion possesses a powerful Echo ability that reveals hidden elements in the world. As you journey through the world, you will learn how to command the companion and take advantage of this ability, allowing you to uncover hidden parts of the world and enemy weaknesses. By using this ability to your advantage, you'll be able to navigate complex puzzles, overcome The Royal Eclipse, and ultimately determine the fate of the world. Whether you're exploring the mysterious landscapes or engaging in fast-paced combat, Echo of the Last Light offers a unique and immersive experience that will keep you engaged from start to finish and leave you with lingering questions…what are you willing to give up to save the world? Whose freedom is truly at risk? And what beliefs are worth fighting for, even when they may hurt some beings?

rows.name: Velocity Rift
rows.short_description: Velocity Rift is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you shoot orbs to defeat enemies and save the world. The number of orbs is limited and shooting enemies at their weak spots return the orbs faster. Also, the faster you move, the slower the world becomes, so always be on the move!
rows.description_html: Velocity Rift is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you shoot orbs to defeat enemies and save the world. The number of orbs is limited and take time to return once fired. Shooting enemies' weak spots returns the orbs faster! Also, the faster you move, the slower the world becomes, so always be on the move! Key Features 4 Levels, 4 Worlds Each level is a different dimension, filled with its own thrills and dangers. Speed through and pass through the rift at the end to reach the next dimension! Time Dilation Speed is the name of the game! The faster you move, the slower the world becomes! Keep up the pace and everything will slow to a crawl... and you’ll be glad they did. Combat Ammunition is limited! Orbs you fire take time to travel back, longer if they go wild. Improve your accuracy and make every shot count! Additionally, different ways to eliminate your pursuers are learnt as you pass from dimension to dimension. Using each in the right situation is key to swift victory! 3 Movement Abilities Your movement is augmented over the course of your journey. Combine these abilities to speed your way through each dimension to get the best time possible. Steam Leaderboard Login to Steam before launching the game to access the Steam leaderboards. Compete with others to reach the top and strive for better clear times on all levels! Boss Fights Each dimension has its own guardian, blocking your path to the next... If you can keep up with life on the fast lane, we’ll see you through the rifts!

rows.name: Fingerbang: All Bullets Pointin'
rows.short_description: Fingerbang: All Bullets Pointin' is a fast-paced FPS inspired by both retro and modern FPS games. Fingerbang combines elements from each in order to create a mix of its own, with a scoring system added on top to gauge your performance through the different levels.
rows.description_html: FingerBang: All Bullets Pointin' is a first person shooter game taking inspiration from the “boomer shooter” games of old. It combines elements from games both old and new, and includes a ranking system based on player performance. You play as a former police officer taking justice in your own hands (literally), as you tear your way through the criminal element of the city, trying to put an end to the manufacturing and spreading of a dangerous new drug known as Strutusol. Fast-paced gameplay with several different powers to help you overcome your enemies Master your tools to improve your ranking Test your mettle throughout multiple levels, each requiring different approaches Discover hidden secrets throughout each level Special thanks to Janne Mustakallio and Eerik Annola for producing the original music in this game. *This game is a student project originally created in a period of 9 weeks, this version of the game being available as the demo version. Current release version has already surpassed the original release and will continue to receive updates for the foreseeable future.

rows.name: My Little Miniatures
rows.short_description: My Little Miniatures is a strategy game combining entertaining auto-battler gameplay with competitive tactics. Fighting in an battle, ration your golds and items sensibly, ponder on the features of various formations, activate powerful synergies with unique builds!
rows.description_html: My Little Miniatures will be available in November 22nd,2022 Do you hear the roar of battle? Yes,it's time! Let's head into the World of Miniatures! Assemble your team of little miniatures, and take part in the epic battle! It is an absolute honor to have you playing My Little Miniatures. Since the game is still being polished, it would be great if any kind of comments, suggestions, or criticism can be provided. Please, let us know! About this game My Little Miniatures is a strategy game combining entertaining auto-battler gameplay with competitive tactics. Fighting in an battle, ration your golds and items sensibly, ponder on the features of various formations, activate powerful synergies with unique builds! About the Game Assembling cute miniatures with different skills, forming your crew and destroy your rivals. At the beginning of each game, you can summon your favored miniatures from several random choices. In addition to the different numbers of attack, defense and health, miniatures have their own unique skills. Fully thinking about matching different miniatures will make your crews more powerful! All miniatures are available for level-up. With the level-up of miniatures, the crew can be upgraded with both attack, defense, health and more powerful skills! Opponent crews would be stronger in every next round, are you ready for more challenging lineups?

rows.short_description: Embark on an adventure, driven by vengeance, to hunt down your former god and put an end to his reign to restore balance to the world!

rows.short_description: Ok I Pull Up is a rage platformer, in which you, a capybara, ascend a tree tower only by jumping. This punishing, yet fair game requires extreme patience to complete.
rows.description_html: Pull up as a baby capybara in this 3D rage platformer! You, a capybara, must use your jumping skills to escape the quarantined tree tower. Explore a seamless world, split into three unique levels. Reach the end of the tower and claim unimaginable rewards. Challenging, skill-based gameplay Climb the tower only by jumping Miss a jump, fall, and lose all your progress Start all over again Cute theme with memorable side characters Several fun platforms and challenging obstacles This game will test your patience to the extreme. Good luck. *This game is a student project created over a period of 9 weeks

rows.name: Rootless: Memories Of Green - Chapter 1
rows.short_description: The story follows a robot girl named Zoe in a futuristic world. She wakes up in a laboratory, alone with no memory. Zoe goes on a journey to discover her past and protect the last hope for the planet. The adventure explores philosophical themes of self-discovery, and a tree.
rows.description_html: 'Why was I built?' 'What is the value of life?' 'To survive in this rootless world, you have to fit into the mold.' 'What if I am different?' 'Then you must change the world.' FEATURES Classic 2D adventure game set in a futuristic cyberpunk world Play though first chapter of the story and get introduced to the colorful cast of quirky characters Interact with the world and solve intriguing puzzles that challenge your problem-solving skills Original art and sci-fi vibe soundtrack This game is a student project created over the period of 9 weeks.

rows.name: IN CELL
rows.short_description: IN CELL is a kinetic visual novel (linear, no choices) about the epidemic of sexless, nationless, and friendless men. Gender dynamics are currently not functional, sustainable, or beneficial to either men or women. IN CELL is uncensored conversation between the sexes.
rows.description_html: IN CELL is a kinetic visual novel (linear, no choices) about the epidemic of sexless, nationless, and friendless men. Gender dynamics are currently not functional, sustainable, or beneficial to either men or women. IN CELL is an uncensored conversation between the sexes. Not that such a conversation will solve anything. There are no specific characters, just mostly nameless men, and women. It is better to think of men and women as the characters rather than specific people. There are themes of racism, violence, sex, porn, and pretty much anything you could think of that may bother you. There's a healthy dose of memes too as the subject matter necessitates it. You'll enjoy the hot new dating app 'Let's **** Chad!' You'll consider violence a reasonable solution. You'll hate, you'll love, and you'll be numb. IN CELL while primarily written by me does include direct quotes of men from youtube, 4chan, reddit, and other corners of the internet. IN CELL does not come from a place of wanting to solve the problem. It is merely a talking point in the form of a visual novel. I wanted to write about the modern male experience. I was inspired by innumerable sources that I won't name as they may not want to be associated with this work. I've read books, watched hundreds of thousands of hours of youtube videos, browsed forums, and have gone outside. I, like many other men, do not like this world. IN CELL is about our experience as men.

rows.name: Distributor Simulator
rows.short_description: Distributor simulator is open world, third person game. Here you have to buy goods al lowest possible price and sell and deliver it to shops for higher price. Price is changing so buy and sell carefully, otherwise you will bankrupt.
rows.description_html: Distributor simulator is open world, third person game. You are company owner and here you have to buy goods al lowest possible price, load it to your car and deliver it to shops. Increase your level and unlock more contracts with other shops and Companys for different cargos. Buy trailers or bigger vehicles to increase load capacity and earn bigger profit. Plan routes to lower fuel costs. Simulator running in cycles. You will get different prices in every cycle. After some time you will notice what price is high, what price is low so you can buy more goods on cheap and store it in your warehouse for next delivery. Eventually became successful merchant and earn your first million. Features: -Physics based vehicles -Attachable trailers -Day night cycles -Dynamic weather -Dynamic economy *More content will be added with future updates.

rows.short_description: This is a VR tour game based on the real picture, which can not only allows players to immerse themselves in the majesty of the Forbidden City, but also to understand the culture and history of the Forbidden City through a mini-game.
rows.description_html: What is Forbidden City Journey? This is a VR panoramic tour of the Forbidden City of China. Players can tour the Forbidden City and learn about its history through the game The game has a kitten NPC, which will act as a guide to introduce players to various scenes in the Forbidden City. The Forbidden City is full of fun to visit through the real picture, so that players can feel the solemnity and majesty of the Forbidden City without leaving home. There are also some mini games designed based on cultural and historical events, through which players can have a better understanding of the cultural knowledge of the Forbidden City. This will increase players' interest in the Forbidden City and even Chinese culture.

Train different types of animals, and give them a lot of attention and they will surely become calmer with their owners.

Create the perfect space to make your pupils feel safe and happy. DEVELOP YOUR TRAINING CENTER Develop your training center with new attractions and amenities - jumping ramps, obstacle courses, slalom poles, tunnels and much more. Manage and expand the entire area, create a hall, add chairs, paint walls, build waiting rooms, and create a play area for animals. You have to remember that in your animal training center, there will be different species of animals - and therefore you have to think about the different spaces where they will stay. After all, each pet has its own unique needs. TAKE CARE OF THEM Exercise and training are not everything - your task in the game also will be to take care of the animals. Pet, brush, wash them and don't forget to give treats! Thanks to this, each pet will feel at home in your training center. TRAIN AND IMPROVE THE SKILLS OF THE ANIMALS One of your main tasks in the game will be to train animals, teach them commands, and tricks. Much will depend on you and your approach to teaching animals, it requires a lot of work and commitment, but animals are able to repay with love and fidelity. Some of the animals will not be so eager to train and learn new habits, you have to find the right way to deal with them. PARTICIPATE IN DIFFERENT COMPETITION Open a stud and a paddock, train them, and maybe one of your horses will win in the world championship! Hard training pays off, make your Training Center the best and known all over the world!

rows.name: Stories From the Cores
rows.short_description: In this entertaining and educational game, players analyze evidence from under the ocean floor to unlock dramatic stories.
rows.description_html: Deep beneath the ocean floor, what discoveries are possible? Join science bot Rovee on 3 expeditions with the International Ocean Discovery Project. Drill core samples from below the ocean floor, compare the layers, investigate hypotheses, and piece together dramatic stories of life on Earth. Stores from the Cores is a suite of 3 single-player mini games about deep ocean core science. The games feature multiple choice questions, exploring 3D environments with science bot Rovee via point and click controls. Collecting mineral samples for scientific research, and matching games that all teach players about deep ocean core science. “It’s like a fun game and you can learn from it.” Age 12 The mini games are the following: Mysteries of the Core Why are bits of land plants found in cores drilled from under the sea floor far from shore? “It's a colorful, interesting story, connected to what science is finding out.” Age 40 Deep Dark Life How are microbes able to live inside rocks hundreds of feet below the sea floor? Find out what the Center for Dark Energy Biosphere Investigations has discovered. “I never thought of microbes at the bottom of the sea. I thought it was a dark place with nothing going on.” Age 40s Die-no-saur What do dinosaurs and plankton have in common? What happened on Earth when dinosaurs, plankton and lots of other life went extinct? “Ocean drilling means…getting samples from the ground to play back history to find out what happened.” Age 14 Accuracy These games are based on current scientific data. HOWEVER, we did add googley eyes to the microbes. Funding from This project is funded through National Science Foundation Award #1515856 and the Center for Dark Energy Biosphere Investigations.

rows.name: ISO
rows.short_description: Join the robot Nem0-1 to collect photos of the animals inhabiting a post-human planet Earth filled with breathtaking sights and mysterious habitats. Complete your compendium by taking better photos, outsmart dangerous predators and explore the ruins of humanity.
rows.description_html: Welcome, exploration unit Nem0-1. Join Nem0-1, a robot tasked with the mission of collecting photos of the life forms of a beautiful, but abandoned and mysterious, post-human planet Earth. Explore the environment, find hidden areas, discover all the animals and make sure to take photos of them in different situations to fill your Compendium and unveil the planet's secret. But be careful, not everything is as you know it, and some creatures might be dangerous... On your journey you'll stumble upon contamination areas, home to the mysterious V-Creatures. You can't stay long in these areas , so you'll have to be quick to snap a pictures of all the V-Creatures and avoid the threats hiding within. What you will find in this game Free exploration with walking, running, crouching, crawling and climbing. A complex camera and photo system with zoom, roll, filters, depth of field and more! A Pro Mode where you can manually set the ISO, Aperture and Shutter Speed of the camera with realistic responses. Lots of animal s to find, each with multiple behaviours to photograph, unlocking a different description that sheds light on the mysteries of the world. A score system based on composition rules . A beautiful world that slightly changes on each play , full of opportunities to get beautiful photos. Please note that ISO is a short experience that lacks a traditional ending.

rows.name: Athenian Rhapsody: Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon
rows.short_description: Athenian Rhapsody: Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is a FREE dangerously goofy RPG with fast paced, unique combat and zany secrets and adventures. Your goal is to build your own rhapsody, the story of you - the player - an experience which cannot be replicated by others.
rows.description_html: Athenian Rhapsody: Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is a FREE standalone experience from the world of Athenian Rhapsody which is to serve as a demo for the full game. Athenian Rhapsody is a fresh comedic RPG game in which you'll explore the World of Athens! Your goal is to build your very own Rhapsody, the story of you (the player) and your epic tale in this world. Your story will unfold based on your decisions , to the degree of which cannot be replicated by any other player. As you may have taken note, this is NOT Athenian Rhapsody ... This is Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon ! Start off your adventure with a personality quiz and be paired up with a mandatory friendship to complete the dungeon crawl with! Your mission is to maneuver your way through Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon in whatever way you deem fit . You could choose to defeat a massive amount of enemies and collect heaps of EXP, or make friends and complete puzzles that include cute little farm animals! You'll be pursuing a Token in this game as opposed to a Rhapsody, a smaller and more simple version of what your Rhapsody may look like one day. ARhap:TGPD is a turn based RPG which includes intense and fast paced real-time-dodging . You'll be faced with many challenges , and you'll have to brawl your way through the dungeon by either fighting, or finding a way to make friends with your opponents through real estate sales, sharing cream cheese, hiring a plumber, and other strange and wacky interactions. Adventure with one of 12 different companions! - Your time in the dungeon will be drastically affected by the follower you're assigned during your personality test! This partner of yours may be super useful in battle, funny and charming, or maybe just a bit weird ! There's a lot to discover in each potential party member, and a deep friendship to be found within each one. Tons of enemies for you to FIGHT or BEFRIEND! - Thunder Goober has compiled a group of suspicious fellows with which you'll have the choice of engaging in intense battles with! Choose your path carefully , you may end up coming face to face with quite the challenge. Varying battle mechanics to always keep the action fresh! - Many characters will switch up the tactics of battle, you'll be faced with various minigames based on the scenario you find yourself in. Absolutely hilarious. - This game is fast paced, action packed, and full of zany and ironic humor that anyone can have a nice laugh at. Choose your own adventure! - Nothing substantial in this game is up to RNG. You choose your pathway from start to finish, creating an extremely specific pathway which will then be recorded into your playthrough's Rhapsody! Vigorous mental challenges, and intense puzzles! - You may face mind-bendingly difficult challenges such as a 3x3 Slide Puzzle (trust me this is near impossible) and 'Farm Animal Sound Matching' throughout your Token's adventure. Lots of different Tokens to collect! - Based on your actions in TGPD, the Token you receive to commemorate your playthrough will appear differently . You'll also be able to crack it open and see a massive amount of stats and details about your adventure! It's basically a warm-up to your Rhapsody. I wonder if certain hidden challenges will unlock secret types of Tokens , too... Your Token will be redeemable in Athenian Rhapsody's full game! - In the future, you'll be able to redeem your Tokens for rewards in ARhap's full game. This may come in the form of exclusive armors or other in-game items , or maybe even special marks on your Rhapsodies ! Only time will tell... Thunder Freaking Goober, baby! - This game is all about Thunder Goober... You'll see many different sides of this wacky wizard throughout your experience, and maybe you clever players will discover a bit of wizard lore ! Regardless, you'll have to piece everything together in Athenian Rhapsody later on. The common goal of Athenian Rhapsody and Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is to provide a real, impactful experience for everyone who plays it. There's something for everyone and I hope that every player can relate to their story somehow, and maybe even reflect on their own lives. Remember to have fun, it's a game! Similar to a Rhapsody, every decision, action, and event that takes place during a playthrough is recorded into your Token ! Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon may be small, (wizard budget cuts) but there's absolutely no shortage of individuality between two player's tokens. The information contained in a Token ranges from your battle stats as well as the status on any stomach issues your character has . As much as we may pray and hope, Thunder Goober is NOT real and DOES NOT exist in real life. He is definitely not filling out the description for this game, either! Regardless, you most likely should still be afraid of him to a reasonable degree . While your real name might truly be (Insert Name) , and your character in Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is also named (Insert Name) , often Thunder Goober will refer to you as Cornball . This is simply due to the fact that Thunder Goober's wizard brain is completely fried and he sees reality in a different way than you or I might. This is nothing to be concerned about! I believe somewhere, sometime long ago a human named Cornball may have made an impact on Athens, or... Maybe you're Cornball? Who knows! Just keep in mind that he means well.

rows.name: Dragonheir: Silent Gods
rows.short_description: The Reborn update brings massive improvements after months offline: log in now to claim 650 FREE summons, enjoy 70% discount on pulls, and participate in the 'Summon More, Get More' event to build your ultimate team.
rows.description_html: The classic dark fantasy strategy RPG Dragonheir: Silent Gods returns with its Reborn update! Experience the official Dungeons & Dragons collaboration event, back for a limited time. The Reborn update brings massive improvements after months offline: log in now to claim 650 FREE summons, enjoy 70% discount on pulls, and participate in the 'Summon More, Get More' event to build your ultimate team. Discover completely revamped strategic gameplay and unprecedented exploration freedom in this thoroughly reworked adventure—join the rebirth now! ◉New Version Highlights◉ S3: Snarls of Lava brings a revolutionary experience, igniting passion once again! Explore the fresh sandbox map, Jannat al-Harr Desert, and dive into the newly added Familiar system. With Familiars by your side, enjoy stable battle support and cross-season inheritance — your adventure is never lonely! The hero roster has been fully upgraded: 34 new heroes make a stunning debut, including 19 Legendary powerhouses to skyrocket your Battle Capacity! Three new schools — Shadow, Aura, and Corrosion — are set to break tradition with unique bonds and roles for ultimate dominance! Discover even more fun with modes like the Blade Colosseum and Great River God - Dahwan. The equipment and Artifact systems have also been expanded: six sets of Mythic and Legendary equipment, along with school- and element-exclusive Artifacts to effortlessly elevate your team's potential. Don't miss out on boosted rewards in the first week and first month; free resources and heroes are up for grabs! S3 will redefine what is possible. Embark now and experience an adventure like never before! 〓Boundless Freedom in Exploration〓 The sandbox open world features diverse landscapes, from shadowy forests to scorching deserts, mysterious underground realms to vast archipelagos—each hiding surprises waiting to be discovered. Create your protagonist freely, with your attribute choices influencing story directions. Roll dice to trigger random events and interact with NPCs to unlock hidden quests, experiencing an adventure journey filled with unknowns and extraordinary encounters! 〓Epic Benefit Discounts〓 Join the 'Prophecy Summons' and 'Account Appraisal' events now to get massive amounts of free summons and abundant resource packs! The summoning system gets a complete overhaul in the Reborn version—single summons now only cost 100 Wyrmarrow, with 70% off summon privileges available immediately upon launch! You can also get additional Summon Dice and selectable Legendary heroes through the concurrent 'Summon More, Get More' celebration event—building your desired lineup has never been easier. Command an army of champions! 〓Strategies Renewed and Upgraded〓 The brand-new Hero Talent system revolutionizes traditional progression! 300+ heroes each boasts 12 unique Talent effects, with no talent trees limiting your mixes and matches! Unlock exclusive battle abilities for your heroes and customize in-depth tactical styles! Make every battle your strategic masterpiece! 〓A Burden-Free Experience〓 Embracing the philosophy of returning to strategic gameplay, we've created the innovative 'Resonance Level' system. Level up once, shared across your entire team! Gone are the days of individually leveling each character—now your entire roster benefits from shared progression, letting you focus on what truly matters: tactics and discovery!

rows.name: Inheritance: Ladeina's Path
rows.short_description: An adult action adventure with exploration and a rich story.
rows.description_html: HERE IS INHERITANCE: LADEINA’S PATH ACTION ADVENTURE WITH ADULT CONTENT Join the adventure of Astarte, promising warrior, and protector of the power of Ladeina! Customize your character and play with your style! Beat your enemies, find your way, discover your destiny. Besides the action elements, this game will bring you exciting adult content, full of sex and erotic scenes. As Astarte, you will have a chance to solve conflicts and encounters not only with strength but also with her beauty and love. THE IDEA When we played Witcher 3, we loved the emotional storytelling and the relationships between characters. When we played Skyrim, we loved the open worlds and the hidden gems on the map. ARPG has caught our eye for a long time, and we want to draw inspiration from these games in an adult genre. We imagine having much deeper and uncensored scenes with Geralt. We want to tell a compelling story, make players have an adventure in a rich and expansive world, and have experiences with outstanding erotic feelings! And that's how Inheritance: Ladeina's Path was born. We will release our game for PC, season per season, adding new features, lands, characters, and improvements with each season. It's an amazing journey that we want you to be a part of! AN ANCIENT CONTINENT, EZOS Enter Ezos, a grim and divided piece of land with complex dilemmas. You will find beautiful landscapes, interesting places and small villages inbetween this chaos. Astarte will travel to the different locations of Ezos during her journey to find the missing artifacts of Ladeina. You will start the journey at her village and from there, you will decide where the path will take you. The Clan has been blessed by the Goddess, Ladeina, for thousands of generations in order to protect their power. Now with her clan on the verge of extinction, Astarte must take her first steps into an unknown world. THE MYTHOLOGY OF EZOS Every clan has different beliefs but most agree that there was a time when the Gods were walking on the earth! They gave power to humankind and watched as the clans fought each other to capture the power of the others. The Gods decided to separate this power into 2 parts. That is how the powers of Love and War were born. Goddess Ladeina and God Khain were assigned to protect these powers . One day the Gods started to fight each other. This war took a long time and after this fight, the Gods decided to separate into many pieces and create artifacts made of these powers. Those artifacts were then hidden, although a small amount of them had been given to humankind. Nobody knows how to use these artifacts except for the Clan of Immortals. THERE IS NO LIMIT TO OUR IMAGINATION, JOIN NOW! With our “season per season” release approach, we are going to create a dynamic game design. We won’t have a limit. With every new season we offer new lands, new characters, new features. We are making this game with our community in mind! Come and join, give ideas and experience being a real part of the game!

Customize your character and play with your style! Beat your enemies, find your way, discover your destiny. Besides the action elements, this game will bring you exciting adult content, full of sex and erotic scenes. As Astarte, you will have a chance to solve conflicts and encounters not only with strength but also with her beauty and love. THE IDEA When we played Witcher 3, we loved the emotional storytelling and the relationships between characters. When we played Skyrim, we loved the open worlds and the hidden gems on the map. ARPG has caught our eye for a long time, and we want to draw inspiration from these games in an adult genre. We imagine having much deeper and uncensored scenes with Geralt. We want to tell a compelling story, make players have an adventure in a rich and expansive world, and have experiences with outstanding erotic feelings! And that's how Inheritance: Ladeina's Path was born. We will release our game for PC, season per season, adding new features, lands, characters, and improvements with each season. It's an amazing journey that we want you to be a part of! AN ANCIENT CONTINENT, EZOS Enter Ezos, a grim and divided piece of land with complex dilemmas. You will find beautiful landscapes, interesting places and small villages inbetween this chaos. Astarte will travel to the different locations of Ezos during her journey to find the missing artifacts of Ladeina. You will start the journey at her village and from there, you will decide where the path will take you. The Clan has been blessed by the Goddess, Ladeina, for thousands of generations in order to protect their power. Now with her clan on the verge of extinction, Astarte must take her first steps into an unknown world. THE MYTHOLOGY OF EZOS Every clan has different beliefs but most agree that there was a time when the Gods were walking on the earth! They gave power to humankind and watched as the clans fought each other to capture the power of the others. The Gods decided to separate this power into 2 parts. That is how the powers of Love and War were born. Goddess Ladeina and God Khain were assigned to protect these powers . One day the Gods started to fight each other. This war took a long time and after this fight, the Gods decided to separate into many pieces and create artifacts made of these powers. Those artifacts were then hidden, although a small amount of them had been given to humankind. Nobody knows how to use these artifacts except for the Clan of Immortals. THERE IS NO LIMIT TO OUR IMAGINATION, JOIN NOW! With our “season per season” release approach, we are going to create a dynamic game design. We won’t have a limit. With every new season we offer new lands, new characters, new features. We are making this game with our community in mind! Come and join, give ideas and experience being a real part of the game!

rows.name: Rake Remastered
rows.short_description: Survive the pursuit of a monstrous predator in 'Rake Remastered,' a tribute to the 2015 original. Uncover mysteries armed with traps and cameras. Outsmart the Rake, survive the nightmare.
rows.description_html: Enter the unknown with Rake Remastered, a spiritual successor to the haunting 2015 classic. Dive into the heart of an unforgiving wilderness where danger lurks in every shadow. As an investigator, you're drawn to a forest shrouded in mystery, tasked with uncovering the truth behind a string of chilling disappearances. Armed with only a handful of tools, you must navigate the eerie landscape, piece together unsettling clues, and face a predator unlike anything you've encountered. The forest holds its secrets close, and the line between hunter and hunted grows thinner with every passing moment. Will you survive the night, or will the Rake claim you as its next victim? The answers are out there. But at what cost?

rows.name: How long can you survive
rows.short_description: How long can you survive is a survival game that the more time you spend in the same game, the harder it will be to kill the enemies.Try to reach the top of the leaderboards by getting the longest time possible in infinite mode.
rows.description_html: Game in development, many functions are not implemented. How long can you survive is a survival game in which the more time you spend in the same game, the more difficult it will be to kill the enemies. You control robots made by people who want to find a world to inhabit, since theirs was destroyed. In these worlds live monsters that have already fought against other robots and you will have the opportunity to get 'pieces' by destroying these enemies. The pieces will help you to improve your character and achieve a higher score. Try to reach the top of the leaderboards by achieving the fastest time possible in infinite mode. Gameplay select a character and choose the game mode, campaign mode or infinite mode. campaign: complete the list of missions and get the necessary coins to escape with the ship, if you die you will lose many pieces that will help you to improve your character. infinite: play as long as you want, the more time you spend, the more difficult it will be and the more loot you can get, when you see it too difficult, run away with the ship to avoid loot loss!

rows.name: Ragnarök TD
rows.short_description: Ragnarök TD is a 2D top-down tower defense game created as a case study of Ninja Kiwi's Bloons TD 6 by the University of Michigan's WolverineSoft Studio. Follow the story of a small village in the North as they fend off the beasts of Ragnarök in this revamped Steam iteration of the original project.
rows.description_html: RAGNARÖK TD Ragnarök TD is a 2D top-down tower defense game created as a case study of Ninja Kiwi's Bloons TD 6. Follow the story of a small village in the North as they fend off the beasts of Ragnarök. WOLVERINESOFT STUDIO Ragnarök TD was originally created by a 13-person team at the University of Michigan's WolverineSoft Studio, a semester-long voluntary student games studio. This project was in development from September 19th, to December 10th, 2021. Additionally, a 10-person team added on to this project to be a true multiplayer game from September 19th, to December 10th, 2022. RAGNARÖK TD UPDATES (STEAM VERSION) *Play with Friends: You can now invite your friends to play together through Steam in a new multiplayer co-op mode. *Control Your Territory: Place towers in your section of the map and collaborate with your friend to strategically defeat enemies. *Send & Receive Currency: Share resources with your partner to buy towers and make upgrades. *Chat with Friends: Communicate with your friends in-game to make decisions. *Earn Achievements: Earn Steam badges for completing accomplishments and show them off to your friends.

rows.name: Inner Abyss
rows.short_description: The world is riddled with monsters beyond our understanding, from horrors unknown. It is now your task to find out why they are here, and how to get rid of them before it is too late.
rows.description_html: You play as Damian; a disgraced Knight Templar forcefully bound to a powerful entity. Together you hunt underground, demon-worshipping cults in a grimdark city. To defeat the cultists you will have to use your combat skills and supernatural abilities to stop them before they summon terrible creatures into our world. A challenging third-person combat game. Strong enemies and low health and resources can make it feel like the odds are against you. However, by utilizing various combos and using timing and the strategy you can swiftly disperse anything or anyone in your way. Explore a dark gothic environment to uncover Red Haven's secrets, and find hidden paths along the way. Keep in mind; those who enter the abyss, may never escape. Engaging Flow The combat is structured around rewarding those risk takers with good timing. Don't be shy! Find your opening and introduce them to your demon infested sword. There are very few defensive moves you can make, aside from dodging, so your best bet is trying to enter what we like to call, the flow. Chain your attacks, string them from one enemy to the other and position yourself up close and personal. You'll become a cultist slayer in no time. Close the Distance Malia is out for blood, be best not to keep her waiting. Activate your warp attack and blink towards a cultist to land a quick strike with style. This consumes ones of your two tokens. If your left with no tokens, you can no longer perform this move. Luckily, defeating a cultist will instantly recharge a token. In other words, be sure to finish the fights you start. Need a boost? Dodging will be your best bet at avoiding an attack. However, did you know that by timing your dodge right before the attack lands you can activate a perfect dodge? Doing so will light up your sword. Aside from making you look like a badass, during a limited amount of time any attacks you land on an enemy will gradually give you health. The best defense, has always been good offense. Enter the Abyss Inner Abyss explores a unique blend of dark gothic fantasy and the early industrial revolution. Clouds of soot dulls the city in a constant dark fog, and the streets are dotted with both oil and electric lamps desperately trying to light up the moldy brick streets. Few are the people who wander the streets, especially at night. For not only is the very air poisonous, but a brooding evil has taken hold. A dreading sense of unease taints the atmosphere - a pressure about to pop. Something is coming, and whatever it is, it’s malevolent. An Entry-Level Soulslike We at Paradice Entertainment are huge fans of the soulsborne genre and we believe we have captured the essence while giving it an interesting twist. Condensing all the epic highs into one blast of an experience. Contrary to the more lengthy and practice heavy playthroughs of the genre, we give a soulsborne experience to those who may not have much spare-time.

rows.name: Witchpunk
rows.short_description: Play as a skateboarding witch who battles against a tyrannical corporation seeking to destroy Halloween. Gain speed on your skateboard and use your hammer to deliver devastating melee attacks!
rows.description_html: Do you like Halloween? Do you like skeletons, pumpkins, and witches on skateboards? And most importantly, do you like bashing robots with giant, magic hammers? If you do, then get out your magic wands and your spraypaint, because we know a game that you'll love! Witchpunk is a third-person melee arena combat game where you play as Mollie, a skateboarding witch who battles against a tyrannical corporation seeking to destroy Halloween. Skate around the city and the subway, gaining speed in order to deal devastating blows to robots of all shapes and sizes. Skate faster to slam harder, and use your spells to leave enemies stunned and reeling! Backed with a signature funky beat and comic-inspired visuals, you'll have a blast as you take down wave after wave of these no-good robots. Once you've made your mark on the city, you might even get a chance to show a supremely evil businesswoman what you think about her lousy plans! High-speed hammer-bashing skateboard combat. An array of Halloween-themed robots to demolish. Bright, comic-like visuals. Spooky, funky beats! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Cloud House - Virtual Arts Space
rows.short_description: Cloud House is a revival of a physical location of a performing arts space, Centre 42 within the digital realm, featuring a single-player experience titled 'Love Letters to 42'.
rows.description_html: In the midst of the 2020 pandemic, when performing arts spaces were forced shut, a team of creative and tech collaborators began a mammoth task to document Centre 42's beloved blue house as its own virtual world. Through the process of photogrammetry, we captured a digital rendering of the building. The desire stemmed from preserving memories, but it led to the curiosity in exploring and expanding opportunities to create theatre and build community beyond physical spaces. The Cloud House journey brings the player to a futuristic rendering of Centre 42. It is an invitation to explore its new imagining within a virtual world. You will encounter our very first experience titled 'Love Letters to 42', a single-player filmic story shot in 2020 that captures the history of pre-pandemic C42 at 42 Waterloo Street. In Cloud House, audiences can encounter arts performances, experiences, workshops and interact with artists and other audiences. It is also an invitation and opportunity for digital artists, theatre-makers to imagine their works to be presented in this space. The content, programmes, interactivity functions are being imagined and built as ‘modules’ and updates along the way after this initial launch. The digital possibilities are endless! Please note: the game environment features bright neon lights and special effects, discretion is advised.

rows.name: Yōkaimaki
rows.short_description: The blood moon has risen once again, meaning the yōkai (cryptids) have emerged from the murky depths of the sea. As the heir to the family restaurant, use your fishing and cooking skills to serve up some delicious yōkai sushi!
rows.description_html: Test your skills and courage in Yōkaimaki, a 2D horror fishing and cooking simulation game from USC’s Open Alpha! In 19th century Japan, you’re a humble fisherman who has finally taken over your family’s sushi business. Cooking by day and fishing by night, you strive to uphold your family’s legacy. But once a year, during the blood moon, the fish that swim the sea give way to fearsome cryptids from the deep—the yōkai. Over the course of four nights, use your cursor to explore the ocean depths and hook the most fabled of monsters. Then, drag and drop in quick succession as you transform these strange creatures into the most delectable sushi in the land. And make sure to read your journal entries to discover the lore of the fascinatingly frightening world around you! The fate of the restaurant is in your hands! Can you keep your creatures and your customers reeling in?

rows.name: Fallen Stars
rows.short_description: Fallen Stars is the story of a astronaut called Thomas Jackson who travel to I.C.E.S 1 space station to perform several duties along side with his crewmates. They worked together to perform several duties on the space station. During their journey back earth, unexpected things happen to them.
rows.description_html: Gameplay This game is a puzzle-based VR space themed game. Player need to complete several puzzles in order to progress throughout the game. Several cutscenes are available between scenes. Player need to complete the puzzles accordingly since all the puzzles are gated among each other. In-game voice line will guide player to progress. In-game tutorial is also available for player to practice moving in a Zero-gravity environment using VR. Description Fallen Stars is a immersive First Person VR game that tells the story of a team of astronaut crew performing several duties on the space station. The story started by the user, Thomas Jackson, an astronaut from the present, searching the net for an article about the astronauts during a space mission in January 1975. But some white light flashed through and Thomas fainted. He woke up to be an astronaut from the past, Thomas William at the I.C.E.S 1 (International Centre Energy Space Station). Upon entering the station, Thomas William performed several duties including adjusting the radio frequency, fixing the power supplies and restore the wire connections. After that, three cosmonauts return to their spacecraft and re-enter earth. During their return to earth, unexpected things happen to them. This game challenges player to finish all the puzzles as soon as possible. Features Zero Gravity Movement which provide a very unique way to move in VR Immersive Space Station Environment in VR Easy to understand puzzles for player to play Tutorial option for those who want to experience Zero Gravity Movement before entering the main game Storytelling Cutscenes Voice acting between characters Immersive In-Game Music Fallen Stars is a game developed by FlyStar. We are a team of university students participating a program called 'DICE' which challenges teams to develop a full-functioning VR Application in 3 months period. We do not have any background in game development and due to time constraints, several bugs are expected and the game is not fully optimized. However, we do appreciate all the supports! :)

rows.name: Pages of Time: Prologue
rows.short_description: Pages of Time: Prologue is a 2D platformer puzzle game. Play as the witch who controls the magic of time, in a beautiful and magnificent magic academy, utilize the skills of recording and rewinding time, solve all kinds of puzzles, and look forward to the adventure of the future.
rows.description_html: Solution of Display Problems For players who use Intel core graphics card, or encounter problems such as white screen, black screen, double image of main character, low frame rate, etc., please enter the following launch options in the 'Properties' menu of the Steam library page of this game: -screen-quality Low -screen-fullscreen 0 -screen-height 720 -screen-width 1280 About the Game Witches protect the order of the world in their floating castle, and it has been like this since the creation of the world. However, our little witch, Loretta travels through time, bringing an oracle that disturbs the witches and forces her to embark on a fateful adventure (again). Will she succeed this time? This is the story of the first-ever witch of time and her friends. Gameplay Pages of Time: Prologue is a 2D platformer puzzle game. Playing as the lovely witch Loretta, in the Magic Academy, use skills such as moving, jumping, recording and rewinding time, and launching magic orbs to solve various puzzles. Visual Experience Pages of Time: Prologue has elaborately drawn scenes and character art performance. When the protagonist activates time magic, the visual performance of the scene will undergo surprising changes. Check it out in the beautiful and spectacular Magic Academy. Story Content Experience the rich story presented in AVG and other forms, and feel the friendship of the witches. Each character has beautiful portraits. Game Process In the game process of about 60~90 minutes, accompanied by wonderful music, you will visit the game scenes with different atmospheres and challenge 13 ingeniously conceived puzzle levels.

rows.name: Super Beast Hunt
rows.short_description: A crazy platformer about a hungry demon girl who wants to eat lots of meat!
rows.description_html: Super Beast Hunt is a silly little 2D platformer about a Demon who wants to eat Meat! STORY The land of Isle Historia is facing a strange crisis! A Meat shortage plagues the island, and without the help of its guardian, no-one can hunt the dangerous Beasts and retrieve the Meat everyone deserves. Luckily, a Demon known as Merry turns up. She's an excellent Beast Hunter, and she's also very hungry. FEATURES -20 Stages + 4 Secret stages, spread across 5 vastly different worlds. They can get quite tricky, watch out! -5 difficult challenges for Super players, hosted by a Bunny of course. -A simple yet versatile moveset to traverse the many stages with. -Different spells to shoot at Beasts. -3 funny female protagonists! -A crazy variety of Beasts to jump on, attack, defeat and get attacked by. -A wild story with a twist or two. -A silly cast of characters including a Moth-person, a girl who lives inside a TV and even a Skeleton! -Room customisation. It serves no purpose but it's there anyway.

rows.name: Extreme Tag!
rows.short_description: Extreme Tag! is a casual party game for all! Run from tagged players to stay alive. Last one standing wins!
rows.description_html: Extreme Tag! is a fun, fast-paced platformer party game. Tag is the main gamemode of Extreme Tag!. One player is selected to be IT and will explode after 30 seconds; however, if they run into another player, they pass the bomb on to them, and some extra seconds are added. The last player remaining wins! In Infection, one player is selected to be IT; they must tag other players to convert them into other Infected before the time runs out. If time runs out, everyone not Infected wins! In Hide and Seek, one player is selected to be the Seeker; this player must single-handedly find ALL other players and tag them before time runs out to win. If time runs out, all the other players win! Laser Tag is a free-for-all gamemode where all players must eliminate each other with their Laser Gun to earn points. At certain intervals, one player is selected to be IT; they will then be worth 3 points per kill instead of 1, but they will stay IT until they are eliminated. The first player to score 15 points wins! Create your own maps with our very own map creator! Import an existing .fbx file as a base, then you can add music and change colors on the objects. Customize your player’s shirt, pants, and shoes to be whatever color you desire! Hats are available in the store for purchase, and a few free ones are given to all players. Additionally, as you level up, you can obtain even more hats for free! We encourage players to try out different clothing color themes to best represent themselves in this fun game for all!

rows.name: Ranger Quest: The Adventure Begins
rows.short_description: The adventure begins by navigating your way through the Sanctuary of the Orbs. A mysterious quest, the elemental orbs lying in wait for the ranger to claim and an ancient map to be remade. The Sanctuary of the Orbs is no ordinary building as the corridors twist and turn like a maze.
rows.description_html: A fantasy story full of magic and intrigue that will transport you to a different time and place. Ranger Quest is a 2D top down adventure game that combines exploration with the puzzle aspects of a maze. A modern game that incorporates pixel art to create the nostalgia of an 80’s era top down adventure game. No adventure would be complete without doors to open and rooms to explore. Navigate through the maze to find the elemental orbs and the pieces of the magic map. With each orb you find, more of the maze will open up for you to search. Activate shrines and be transported between floors. Only by moving back and forth between floors will you be able to find the correct path and solve the puzzle. The Minotaur Maze Engine takes a classic 2D Maze and reinvents it by having the walls move. A game designed to be enjoyable and challenging for players of all ages. For anyone who has enjoyed the simple pleasure of completing a maze at some point in their lives. The Minotaur Maze Engine brings the classic maze into the 21st century. Developed with the Godot game engine. Music and sound effects obtained from ZapSplat. The Minotaur Maze Engine. The maze where the walls move.

You can enjoy many adventures in an alchemy world with the support of your partner character 'YOME'! ◆Design your character freely!◆ Create the character you really want! Adjust your character's hairstyle, height, body structure, eyebrow length, eye color and more! ◆You are not alone, explore with YOME◆ Explore with the help of 'YOME'! YOME will quide you to your destination, support you in battles and help with synthesizing items! Customize your YOME like your character, and create your ideal partner! ◆Solo-Player Mode◆ Use the Solo Player Mode feature to play by yourself! If you feel you wouldn't fit in with MMORPG community, it's okay! rows.name: Above Snakes: Prologue
rows.short_description: In the prologue of Above Snakes, you awake in a destroyed settlement and help the survivors rebuild it. After that, expand the world with world pieces, craft, farm, hunt, build a base, and fight to find out more about what happened.
rows.description_html: About the Prologue In Above Snakes: Prologue you play the beginning of Above Snakes and get a feel for what the game plays like. Survival with a Twist In contrast to other survival games, the world is not generated procedurally. Instead, generate it yourself by placing isometric tile world pieces! Start your journey in the small lumberjack settlement of Hunter's Rest and begin crafting the world around you! Create and Survive Determine the landscape of this world inspired by the Wild West and dictate how it will unfold before you. You have the power to decide what’s next. Craft, Cook, Hunt, and Fish To help the people of Hunter's Rest, you can craft necessary tools from newly discovered resources. Advance in leather working, cloth weaving, and more professions to create the best survival supplies for your adventure! Base Building Invest your resources into your very own cabin and establish a base for defense and shelter. Key Features An immersive prologue about an apocalyptic event in a fictional version of the Wild West An isometric world made of world pieces, created by the player throughout their journey Craft, farm, hunt, fish, build bases, and fight in order to stay alive Deep base building system with extensive outdoor and indoor assets Complete quests at your own pace and unravel the secrets of Above Snakes Accessibility Full controller support, key and button rebinding, disable camera shake, disable smooth camera movements, photosensitive mode, custom volume controls for sfx, music, eating noises, and footsteps.

rows.name: The Princess of the Tower Wants a Hero
rows.short_description: A sweet winter themed Otome Visual Novel about a princess of a tower who just wants a hero. … Except she ends up with a tone-deaf bard for a roommate, a sassy demon for a butler and no hero. Still stuck in a tower though.
rows.description_html: Princess Lumi has been held captive in the demon lord’s castle situated in a land of everlasting winter. She hates it. It’s cold, it’s lonely, the food is bad, and there’s literally nothing to do!  The only good thing about this place is the tea and snacks. Princess:  'I know I said I’d help you out, but I am exhausted. I'd be willing to do something else though.' Hero(?): 'Of course! As long as you don’t kick me out of here.' … These are the days of winter they spent together. -20k+ Words -1 Romance Route -1 Good Ending + a couple of bad ends -5 Unique CGs -Partial Voice Acting -Bad Singing -Bonus POV Side Stories

rows.description_html: Don't let the enemy bomber destroy the city. Do whatever it takes to stop it! You are an ordinary farmer who enjoys a peaceful life not far from civilization. One morning you see a plane moving over you, heading towards the town. And all's well and good, but it's military and... enemy... It's time to roll your old single-engine plane out of the barn and remember everything you learned in flight school... All you have to look forward to: 2 maps... 2 bombers Several different types of shells Opportunity to attack the enemy Dozens of difficulty levels And it will all be accompanied by an awesome soundtrack!

rows.name: Siren Head: The Horror Experience
rows.short_description: Some teenagers have gone camping in the woods far out of town after hearing an old folks tale about a monster lurking within the woods. The monster surrounds its habitat with horrifying and distorted siren noises.
rows.description_html: Siren Head - The Horror Experience While working the late shift at the Police Department, you receive a report about some teenagers that went missing in Windermere Woods. Old folk tales mention these woods, and of a monster that is said to lurk there, but those are just stories... right? It is your job to find these teens, but you did not imagine the horrors you would face. The old folks tale states that the mythical monster surrounds its habitat with siren noises of all kinds, luring unsuspecting victims. You must navigate Windermere Woods with torch in hand, leaving the bright lights of the road and venture into the darkness. Find the teens, or their belongings and try get back to your car unharmed. But will your mind let you rest while you sleep? Features Atmospheric and Immersive Environment First Person Perspective Scary Atmosphere Amazing Sound Design Slender Man-Esque Game Play Jump Scares

rows.name: VR Archeology: Secrets of Kulikovo Field
rows.short_description: What mysteries and keys to historical secrets are hidden underground? In this interactive VR game, you will explore the roles of modern archaeologists, restoration experts and re-enactors. Discover dozens of unique artifacts dating back to the Battle of Kulikovo on this thrilling expedition.
rows.description_html: Fought on September 8, 1380, the Battle of Kulikovo is considered one of the biggest events of the 14th century that united Rus peoples. Scientists continue searching for traces of the battle. Now you can also join an archaeological expedition, find and restore artifacts to re-enact those historical events. Swords and spears, armor and arrows, coins and bullets. Dig into the artifacts from different eras with the opportunities offered by a field laboratory. Game developers spent time in the Kulikovo Field Museum depository to recreate accurate copies of real archaeological finds collected over decades. Learn about Russian warriors’ full armor and its actual weight, and archers’ medieval multitool. You can witness scenes from across the ages that the Kulikovo Field remembers. Reconstruct a combat bow and test it at a shooting range. Pick an arrowhead to hit different types of armor. Practice your aiming skills and get promoted to the next military rank.

rows.name: Of Frost and Flowers
rows.short_description: An otome-fantasy visual novel. Play as Alto, a fearless knight, and enter a world of magic and myths with secrets waiting for you to unveil.
rows.description_html: In the early world of Gaia, the capability to use magic is determined by birth, creating a rift between magic and non-magic users. Yet despite the rift, an organization stepped up with a purpose of making magic accessible to everyone: The Crysmalia Project. The story starts with Alto, a craftswoman who joined Zethania's Knights to search for her missing childhood friend. Upon joining them, however, Alto stumbled upon a secret she should not have known, and now her life is on the line... Features: 70,000 words 14 CGs Kisha and Sol's route + 1 mystery route (unlocked after you play the two routes) Team Project Leader: Elseth Sprite & Main Menu Artist: Apririnn Original BG Artists: Kat, Yana OST Composer: Iestyn CG Colorist: tashaj4de Writers: Elseth, Tetora, Llem GUI Artist: tatapb Logo Artist: Kat Proofreaders: lethologicalee, KuroKairin, Selene, WholesomeWraith, Zelan Free BGs: k-after.at.webry, 7b.biglobe.ne.jp, pexels, Izuru Tadafuji Free music / SFX: ontama-m, freesound, freesfx

rows.name: Roller Champions™
rows.short_description: Skate and roll your way up to glory in Roller Champions™. Discover a free-to-play, team PvP sports game like no other!
rows.description_html: Skate, tackle, and roll your way up to glory in Roller Champions™. Discover a free-to-play, team PvP sports game like no other! Welcome to 2032. Arenas are built all over the world and fans rush to the stands to admire their modern-day heroes, the Roller Champions. They roll up to 100 miles an hour, tackle opponents, wall-skate, and dunk while thousands of fans scream their names. As a Roller Champion, compete in a team of three against three. The rules are simple: take the ball, make a lap while maintaining team possession, dodge opponents, and score. Go for more points by completing additional laps before attempting a goal. After each match, gain fans to compete in bigger arenas. Customize characters and create a unique destiny. GATHER YOUR TEAM AND COMPETE Team up with two players and dive into Roller Champions’ gameplay, which combines fun competitive action and collaborative team play. Go head-to-head against the opposing team through speed, wit, crushing tackles, and daring dodges to lap around the arena and be the first team to reach 5 points by throwing the ball through the hoop. Feel the thrill of riding up and down the wall of the arena as you gain speed, quickly stop, pivot, and re-position as your teammates race towards the goal, just one pass away from winning or one interception away from having to start all over again. FROM ZERO TO HERO – BUILD A LIFE OF A WORLD-RENOWNED ATHLETE Write your own legend. Start your sports career as the underdog and roll up to glory as you win matches. Obtain more fans in arena bleachers as you complete spectacular actions and progress to bigger stadiums. Write your name in Roller Champions’ history books as you climb up the leaderboards. Progress through Roller Champions’ ranked mode from Garage league all the way to the Elite Champions’ league. Compete in thrilling time-limited special game mode to gain fans or special lootballs. CREATE AND FULLY CUSTOMIZE YOUR SPORT LEGEND Create your own character and customize your outfit as you progress. Unlock new items, including skates, helmets, fresh attires, gloves, goal effects, emotes, air poses, player titles and banners. Progress through the Roller Pass to gain season-exclusive items, spectacular goal FX and emotes, lootballs and in-game currency (wheels). COME HANG IN THE SKATEPARK Roller Champions’ social hub is THE place to be to meet up and learn the ropes with your friends! Roll around, practice scoring and learn new tricks. Participate to time-limited minigames.

rows.name: SnekMP
rows.short_description: Did you ever have a dispute with a friend? Finally there is a way to sort out whos Snek is BIGGER!However, in SnekMP bigger does not necessarily mean better! Having a huge C... khm... Snek definitely helps, but you will also need to be quite agile to win!
rows.description_html: Compete with your friends in the most brutal(no) snek fight in the history of mankind! Show who has the largest Snek from your company! Grow your snek by eating food pellets ! The first Snek to reach a size of 15 blocks wins! Don't know how to handle a big, fat snek? No worries, if you can't win, make your opponent lose! Ez Pz

rows.name: Bounty
rows.short_description: A sci-fi first-person shooter with a dynamic deployable cover system. A demo level from our game Bounty.
rows.description_html: A student project made in Unreal Engine 4 at SAE Expression College. A demo level from our game Bounty. Bounty is a first-person shooter bounty-hunting game. The player lands on a space station overrun with robotic bounty hunters. The player must locate and kill the bounty. The player is equipped with a six-shooter that shoots explosive rounds. The player fights through the robot bounty hunters to claim the ultimate prize, his reward. The game is a tactical first-person game. The robots are just as deadly as the six shooters the character wields. The player uses a cover system to avoid being shot. The cover system allows the player to return fire in a deadly firefight a little more safely. The game's plot is to create a mix of wild west gunslingers in a future period. The story behind this bounty hunter is that his father owes money to an intergalactic crime syndicate. This bounty is the “last” job for the crime family before he can free his father from his debt or so he thinks.

rows.name: HOSPICE Vol. 1
rows.short_description: Hospice is a kinetic visual novel game about pure brother without his little sister, a men with no hope, a place with no home.
rows.description_html: ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ♡ﮩ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ Next Stop, Happy Life! Deli truly believes that life is a merry-go-round. When we get married, we're going to ride on the bus that we call life. Living like there's no tomorrow.⠀ But there is NO tomorrow. And life is a lie. And ride we're looking for going down the road. He believes that he can stop. But no one can stop the time. Nobody can stop the bus. We're just waiting, we're sitting. - Why? Because, we're not going - we're lea-living. ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ♡ﮩ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ Dead End Club Ends up here... Here is the place for everyone. Place for misfortune , shame and regret . And the club's authority is asking you to take your sit at the table. Hospice is the play of light and shadows. Now is your time to turn the tables. Now is your time to turn on the light. DEVI: - No, isn't yours, silly. It's mine. - Your time will be next time. AKI: - Was it the last time? And if you thought that these inner demons were your biggest issue. Outside is MUCH many demons. ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ♡ﮩ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ My Little Sister Can't Be Life goes on. And so we're going for another story, another people, and another day... No, not another time, not any time. He made today-me. Today. I made this game to pay him back. This game is a tribute to Tsukasa Fushimi . The visual novel created with salt and gold. The soulless creature made with soul. ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ♡ﮩ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ Features: ✙ Not a siscon, but a story about siscon living like one and losing. ✙ Different look at characters, and MORE characters... looking back at you. ✙ With numerous color illustrations of society and unsociable. ✙ Not the 'ruining', but creating life experience. ✙ Nothing and one femboy . There may be no next time.

rows.name: Mindworks: The Great Division
rows.short_description: A choice-based visual novel game about science, division, and the false ideology of knowledge. Each and every one of your choices will determine whether the disciplines will end in unity or complete division. The key to eternal knowledge is in your hands.
rows.description_html: A visual novel based on science and art, real life events and how humans tend to spread a false ideology of knowledge. Welcome to the Mindworks universe! In a universe vastly different from our own, humankind is ruled by science and art. These disciplines lived in partial unity, enough for the universe to function, prosper and evolve. Until a new discipline emerges, challenging their ability to stay together under severe circumstances and harsh pasts. Each and every one of your choices will determine whether humankind will fall or rise again, since their fate is closely intertwined with the disciplines' unity or complete division. The key to eternal knowledge is in your hands. Choose wisely. Multiple Outcomes: Three outcomes that are based on your choices which will decide whether the disciplines will end up being united, divided, or partially united Different types of choices: From major choices, to timed choices, to split choices, all will affect your plotline Webcomic Meets Visual Novel: Sprites containing fully drawn scenes and animations that mimic that style of modern webcomics Music room: A special page in-game containing official Mindworks soundtracks to be unlocked and enjoyed Extra content: Unlock concept art, character info, and music in the music room

rows.name: Leaf Blower Man: This Game Blows!
rows.short_description: Blow leaves at 6am on a Sunday and earn points by annoying all the neighbors. But beware - unexpected challenges await on your journey to rid the world of leaves!
rows.description_html: Buzz About the Game Leaf Blower Man is a arcade-action game. Not only will you pointlessly blow leaves from one end of the driveway to the other, you will also earn points by annoying the heck out of your neighbors! A dramatic story will lead you through a variety of environments and challenges; perhaps you might even save humanity? Replay the short campaign to get MORE points and beat it FASTER! Will you be the bestest Leaf Blower Person? Aside from the main campaing, enjoy a Horde Mode and fight against an ever-increasing number of militant leaves. Destroy thousands of enemies, strategically gain experience, choose new power-ups / weapons, and try to survive long enough to get to the final Leaf King. Will you topple the tyranny of autumn? Leaf Blower Man provides a fantastic experience without any pay-to-win microtransactions. Any additional packages available for purchase are completely optional and do not provide any gameplay advantages. We are committed to committing towards this commitment.

rows.name: Zako Slayer
rows.short_description: You are a female super soldier trying to escape from the invaded base by unknown intruders. (A 2D Sci-fi Platformer, Megaman-like style, but with hack and slash.)
rows.description_html: Story A female super soldier, sleeping in a base, was released by accident during an attack by unknown intruders. Her memory is lost; she doesn't know who she is. The objective is to break through the enemies and escape from the base. Genre 2D Platformer, shooting in bullet hell style with hack and slash. Game play Close and range combat - Close combat with a sword like a warrior. - Shooting in Bullet hell style. Take cover behind an object, even the bodies of enemies and friends. - Sneak behind the enemies and attack them from behind or above. - Complex enemies' behavior. About 10-20 minute of gameplay.

rows.name: Wind Up
rows.short_description: Wind Up is a multiplayer game focusing on social deduction, cooperation, and betrayal. In a complex haunted castle, the clockwork dolls outsmart imposters hiding among them. Who can escape the castle? Who will be banished? Who will be killed by imposters when night falls...
rows.description_html: Let's enter the wonderful world of Wind Up! In this haunted castle, you will get suspicious of each other as clockwork dolls. Here you will experience—— ※Day-Night Cycle The day is clockwork dolls' home field, while the night is the stage of the imposters. Judge the situation to gain advantages for your team. ※Cooperation and Escape Work together to complete the tasks, find the exit, and race against time to escape from the castle. Enjoy the sense of accomplishment brought by the teamwork! ※Hunt and Survival Imposters will show their true appearances and kill clockwork dolls when night falls. Clockwork dolls need to use all means to survive. An exciting chase will happen at night! ※Hotly Debate During the day, clockwork dolls have the right to hold a meeting to accuse someone. You can argue fiercely, and persuade others to vote for your rivals and expel them.

rows.name: Death Swap: End As One
rows.short_description: Death Swap is a first person online co-op horror game where you are stuck in a secret science facility with a horrific monster! Work as a team to save each other by swapping positions with the creature. Communicate with one another to solve tasks in order to survive and escape the science facility!
rows.description_html: FRIENDS WHO STAY TOGETHER, DIE TOGETHER Death Swap is a first person online co-op horror game where you are stuck in a secret science facility with a horrific monster! Work as a team to save each other by swapping positions with the creature. Communicate with one another to solve tasks in order to survive and escape the science facility! Features Escape together - The players have to escape together from a secret science facility where a gory monster has broken free. Avoid being caught by the monster and being killed in a gory way. Communicate and discuss with your friend to develop a strong strategy to escape together! Swap - Do you want to save your dear beloved friend from a horrible death? Help him by swapping positions with the monster! Or do you wanna give him a scare to swap with him at the last second? Complete tasks - You have to repair the broken elevator to escape from the science facility! But you don’t know how? Complete tasks with your friend to find items to repair the elevator. Chasing monster - The monster is faster than you! Create a strategy to avoid the monster and not get caught by him. WARNING: PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES - READ THIS NOTICE BEFORE PLAYING A very small percentage of people may experience epileptic seizures or blackouts when exposed to certain kinds of flashing lights or light patterns. These persons, or even people who have no history of seizures or epilepsy, may experience epileptic symptoms or seizures while playing video games. If you or any of your relatives has an epileptic condition or has had seizures of any kind, consult your physician before playing any video game. IMMEDIATELY DISCONTINUE use and consult a physician if you or your child experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions. Parents should watch for or ask their children about the above symptoms. You may reduce risk of photosensitive epileptic seizures by taking the following precautions: sit farther from the screen, use a smaller screen, play in a well-lit room, do not play when you are drowsy or fatigued. MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION The developers describe the content like this: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
