rows.name: MopGarden's Veggie Cart
rows.short_description: MopGarden’s Veggie Cart is a fast-paced, simulation game where you feed hungry bunnies lots of healthy vegetables! Can you feed them all in time?
rows.description_html: MopGarden’s Veggie Cart is a fast-paced, simulation game where you feed hungry bunnies lots of healthy vegetables! Can you feed them all in time? MopGarden, a variety Twitch streamer, has decided to feed all the local bunnies in her town. As business begins to boom, she moves her veggie cart to other surrounding areas, where the vegetable orders get faster, and faster , and FASTER . Features Play through 4+ different worlds, each with varying difficulties. Bunnies are hungrier and more demanding at different times of day! Test your visual skills and reaction time. As you progress through the game, it gets harder and harder to determine what the bunnies are ordering Look out for other pesky animals! Other animals will drop in to throw a wrench into the vegetable orders. No bad stuff! This game is completely free to play. No advertisements, in-app purchases, or anything of the sort. No animals were harmed in the making of this game!

rows.name: My Last 20
rows.short_description: A brutal Bullet Hell arcade experience where 20 SECONDS is all you get to WIN. Dodge cows, tentacles & asteroids while grabbing space tokens in pure chaos. Are you ready to complete the most intense space mission ever??
rows.description_html: EMBARK THE 'MY LAST 20' MISSION THE COMPANY urgently seeks brave astronauts to enlist on the 'My Last 20' mission. Your objective: extract as many Space Tokens as possible from the Chaos Zone and survive for a ONLY 20 seconds. This mission posses life insurace in case of death.  Are you that brave astronaut? GAMEMODES 🌀 Chaos Zone In My Last 20’s Missions, you’ll face 20 seconds of pure arcade madness. Asteroids? Cows? Tentacles? Each chaos zone is different with it's own difficulty and only the fastest astronauts will make it out alive. ♾️ Endless Arcade Mode Unlimited survival time with power-ups and 3 shields to keep you going. Beat your best run and climb the leaderboards. 🏆 Hardcore Challenges Complete absurd challenges like 'Cook 100 cows with a bomb!' and win extra free rewards. 🎨 Unique Skins Unlock weird and increible skins, you can play as a Double Cheese burger, as a Avocado and even as a Rubber Duck!! WHO ARE YOU? The identity of the person behind the helmet remains a mystery but one thing is certain: sanity is not a quality of you. You are the only one who enlisted willingly to this mission and survived at least twice. KEY FEATURES INCREDIBLY HARD : Being able to complete the My Last 20 mission is not a easy task. 20 seconds sounds like a short time but have to avoid even cows makes it challenging. QUICK GAMEPLAY:  Perfect for those who like to test their reflexes and having to react in matter of seconds to avoid being killed by a Space Tentacle . CRAZY LOOKING GRAPHICS:  A combination of modern and retro pixel art graphics with unique and weird characters make a perfect combination for a real trip.  MULTIPLE CHALLENGES: Play the main missions, complete hard challenges or play endlessly without time limitations and score your best time. AMAZING MUSIC : A perfect blend of nostalgia and space feel all thanks to  Lukasz (X-Ray) Sychowicz to his song Zizibum

AMAZING MUSIC : A perfect blend of nostalgia and space feel all thanks to  Lukasz (X-Ray) Sychowicz to his song Zizibum
rows.reviews_html: “Think you have the reflexes to survive in deep space while dodging asteroids at lightning speed? In My Last 20 by @DroidGamestd , every second counts. The goal? Stay alive for 20. The reality? Good luck 💀” GX.Games

rows.name: Slime Evolution
rows.short_description: A survival roguelike where you play a slime wandering a forest. As you eat resources and fight monsters, you evolve and get ever stronger! But as you unbalance the forest and draw attention of stronger opponents, how long can you survive?
rows.description_html: You are a slime. Eat resources to determine your starting element then fight monsters and evolve to get stronger. The stronger you become, the more monsters will be drawn to you. Can you survive their ever increasing amounts and new monsters joining in to hunt you down? But those that unsettle the balance of the forest might draw unwanted attention. You play a slime that eats resources and monsters to grow stronger. Move around the map to attack them, but don't get too close or they might overwhelm you. Survive for as long as you can, because once you die it is all over. No progress carries over and you will start over from scratch. Go down 7 different elemental paths to defeat your enemies and consume their drops to evolve even further to fight the onslaught of new enemies that appear the stronger you get.

rows.name: Wyoming Winter
rows.short_description: A group of employees find themselves snowed in to the Wyoming department of defence building as a blizzard covers the state. You'll soon find out your group is not the only thing trapped in the building.
rows.description_html: In Wyoming Winter you and a group of fellow employees find yourselves snowed in to the Wyoming department of defence building as a blizzard covers the state. You'll soon find out your group is not the only thing trapped in the building. Find unique hiding spots, help your fellow employees, complete risky lockdown tasks and find a weapon to fight back. Hide in. Hold out. Don't be found. Wyoming Winter is a multiplayer game where one person in the lobby is chosen at random to be the Blight, an almost invincible, fast moving, dark creature that escaped from the lower levels of the Wyoming facility. The rest of the players are employees who's job it is to stop the Blight from escaping the facility. Employees need to kill the Blight before the 10 minutes timer is over or the director of the department will have no choice but to detonate the on site nuclear bomb, killing everyone. Wyoming Winter is best played with 3-8 players. Servers are available in Europe, America & Asia. Employee's start with a notepad of tasks and a watch. The notebook contains a list of tasks to be completed before the employee is given a final task to locate a weapon. The watch shows how much time is lef t until the on-site nuclear bomb detonates, killing everyone, the employees must kill the Blight before this timer ends or face nuclear destruction. The Blight has heightened vision and can see well in dark places along with incredible strength that allows it to snap the neck of any employee in an instant. Both the Blight & employees can climb and crouch into unique and crafty hiding places using the climbing system.

rows.name: Falsepine
rows.short_description: Join a long lineage of Hunters as you run and gun through the Wild West in this action rogue-like. Take on Bounties, Unlock powerful weapons, and come face-to-face with a gallery of terrifying monsters. Developed by Voyager Softworks, as a part of our final year at University.
rows.description_html: Falsepine is a fast-paced action roguelike focusing on difficult combat and exploration. Developed by Voyager Softworks, as a part of our final year at University, Falsepine is a labor of love, pulling all the passion and drive from the team into a brutal and rewarding action roguelike. Hunt Legendary Creatures Falsepine places you in the role of a lineage of monster hunters tasked with tracking down and defeating 5 legendary creatures across the untamed West. Use all your wits and skill to combat these dangerous foes and emerge victorious. Explore a Brutal World Explore a variety of unique locales from the snowy Grizzly Peaks to the dusty Arid Badlands . Track down and collect clues and journals detailing the rich history of each monster. Each clue found may be the key to your success or defeat in the grand showdown against these legendary creatures. Plan Ahead Prepare for the journey ahead in the town of Falsepine, purchase weapons and equipment at Gold and Irons, buy drinks and clues at the Crossroads Saloon, store valuable items at Falsepine Bank, and finally equip gear and take on unique bounties at the Hunters Camp. Once you leave for your hunt there is no turning back. Create a Hunter Unique to You Falsepine offers a variety of playstyles to suit all types of hunters. Do you want to be an unstoppable pickaxe-wielding barbarian or perhaps an agile high-damage sniper? Utilize 35 different weapons and tools, pairing them with a variety of Talismans and Artifacts to create different builds for every new adventure. Complete a Variety of Bounties Take on a variety of bounty missions, each affecting how you will approach an expedition. Hunters that complete the most challenging bounties will be rewarded with unique and powerful Legendary weapons ranging from rapid-fire crossbows to double-action hand cannons.

rows.short_description: Virago herstory is about a little girl called Willow who after running away from her home becomes a victim of stalking
rows.description_html: After running away from home, a little girl called Willow finds herself to be a victim of stalking Play as Willow in our widely known Virago game, an indie adventure game that tells a story about a girl who after escaping her abusive mother after her divorce, becomes a victim of notorious stalking that affects her psychologically and emotionally. Virago herstory is a 2d adventure platformer with black and white graphics. It has been critically acclaimed for original art, soundtrack and story.

rows.name: NanoWar: Cells VS Virus
rows.short_description: Fight against the viruses and cure the entire body! A fast-paced real-time strategy game of cell conquest. Lot of players already got the bug... ready to defend your cells?
rows.description_html: Fight against the viruses and cure the entire body! A fast-paced real-time strategy game of cell conquest. The Nano War series has already been played by millions of people on the web since 2008. In Nano War you have to conquer infected territories. Send your units to capture the other cells and increase your power to defeat the enemies. It's an intuitive game, user friendly/easy to play, highly addictive and for everyone! STORY Once upon a time in a human body. Thousands of nanoscopic cells lived peacefully for many generations. Among these cells, there is the mother cell, the very first cell and the one that gave birth to all. Three of the most destructive group of viruses had managed to infect the mother cell. The mother cell was forced to produce countless infected cells. But local cells didn't yield and prepared to fight back. We need to defeat all evil and quickly restore balance!!! The Nano War has begun!

rows.name: Retail Wars
rows.short_description: Retail Wars is a friendship-ruining 4 player couch competitive party game. Pickup and throw anything in the store to serve customers and knock out your friends in the fight to become the coveted employee of the month!
rows.description_html: The most realistic retail experience ever created is here! Retail Wars is a friendship-ruining competitive party game where you can pickup and throw any item in the store to either serve customers and gain commission or to sabotage and knock-out your friends. Compete on a range of hazardous work environments, deal with aggressive customers, and out-sell each other in the vicious fight to become employee of the month! Key Features: Throw ANY item in the store to serve customers or knock-out other players! Take advantage of unique map hazards to turn the tide of the match! Up to 4 players can get into the action quickly with simple control schemes! Customise your character from a range of quirky options! Dozens of items available, each with different traits and properties! Jump into 2 wacky maps! Want to play online with your friends? Use Steam Remote Play! Simply get one player to launch the game and then invite everyone else in! Each player will require a controller. Ready to clock in and become employee of the month? Your shift starts now!

rows.name: MetaBall - Multiplayer Basketball
rows.short_description: Experience the thrill of Hoverboard Basketball! Team up or challenge players worldwide in fast-paced crossplay PvP matches. Master the ball, dribble, and outwit your opponents to score impressive goals— with no aim assist. Only skill and creativity matter. Grab your Hoverboard and dominate now!
rows.description_html: Metaball is a free-to-play, crossplay-enabled online multiplayer sports game that combines fast-paced movements, thrilling PvP matches, and advanced team play. You play as a Rider, trying to bring fame and wealth to his name by winning merciless Metaball League games with his teammates and collecting Metanium and MVP points. Hop on your hoverboard, grab the ball with your chain, and use its swinging power to perform diverse actions. Dunk, shoot, block, and steal the ball while using the nitro to boost your speed or perform double or triple jumps! Use your Perk Points in different Perk Trees to customize your play style! Compete against other riders in various PvP game modes, including 2v2 and 3v3 Quick Matches, or hone your skills in Academy, Champion Road, Free Play, or Custom Match modes! After each match, you will receive MVP points depending on the result. So make sure to win and to be the best Rider to receive a bonus! The more you have MVP points, the more you will unlock rewards! With your hard-earned Metanium and M VP points, progress in the Metapass, and try to collect your favorite equipment and items to use in the game! Items shown may require separate purchases from the in-game store and are subject to availability. Contains in-game purchases.

rows.short_description: Dig into the truth hidden in the artist's strange paintings through the puzzle.
rows.description_html: Visit the home of an artist you admire and talk to the paintings, and uncover the secrets he is hiding. It's a first-person thriller room escape game made in 3D. Click the arrow to look around the room. You will be a girl who visits the home of an artist you respect and solve various puzzles. 1. You can learn various things that an artist has at home. 2. You can disassemble, combine, or use acquired items. Items in use are displayed in the lower right ui. 3. The various paintings hanging in the artist's house can talk to you and interact with the objects you have acquired. 4. If you do the painting's favor, they will reward you. Solve the puzzle with their reward. 5. The more you solve the puzzle, the more you will learn the secrets of the artist.

rows.name: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE
rows.short_description: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE is an award winning, hour long melancholy, point-and-click narrative mystery set in the bible belt of Sweden.
rows.description_html: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE is an award winning, hour long melancholy, point-and-click narrative mystery set in the bible belt of Sweden. FROM SWEDEN WITH LOVE Welcome to Härunga – a small industrial town in the bible belt of the mid–north of Sweden. You play as Sara, an aspiring writer who, after having been away for 10 years, returns home in order to investigate the tragic fate of her estranged best friend. The days grow short quickly this far up north – and the rain never seems to let up... HÄRUNGA FOREVER Lovingly crafted and richly animated, explore the melancholy atmosphere of a small town that time seemingly forgot. Meet old friends and enemies and piece together the mystery of what happened after your friendship tragically fell apart. As in life, what you say will impact things in hidden ways and not everything may be as it seems. Who is telling whose truth and can you know the difference?

rows.name: ZaBaTa!
rows.short_description: ZaBaTa! is an online multiplayer game where you must find human players hidden among AI NPCs. Blend in, complete missions, and most importantly - don't get caught! Play ZaBaTa! with friends for even more fun.
rows.description_html: ■ ABOUT THIS GAME ZaBaTa! is an online multiplayer game that you can enjoy with friends. Keep an eye out to find real players hidden among AI NPCs, and become the last human player standing! Watch out though! Blend in so YOU don't get caught either. Which ones are human? All NPCs appearing in ZaBaTa! use Deep Learning to implement their movements. The character that just passed by, was that a human player or an AI? Find the 'real' players hidden among many AIs! Complete missions faster than everyone else! Certain missions are only for the human players. Complete the missions quickly but remember to act natural and blend in to avoid getting caught! Pretend you're an AI NPC Give your best performance and trick other players. Feel the adrenaline rush of deceiving other humans to win! If you spot a 'real' player, approach them... and attack! Think you found a real player? Approach them - but be careful, they might catch you first! ZaBaTa! is even more fun when you play it with friends! Play Now! ■ Game Features Solo or team modes available. ZaBaTa! can be played in two maps for solo/team battles. Compete with your friends in many different ways! We will keep updating and adding new game modes. Special missions add suspense to the guessing game! Blend in to complete missions without being caught by other human players. You have to keep up the acting until you are the last human standing! Charming characters and unique costumes Tons of cosmetics available for character customization! Make one-of-a-kind avatar and enjoy ZaBaTa!

Defeat your enemy, upgrade your stats, go to the next boss and repeat ! use your remaining life points (materialized by little glowing fireflies) to deal damage. rows.name: Keeper Of The Valley
rows.short_description: Jump, glide and dash your way to the top of the mountain in this 3D adventure platformer set in an open and enchanting valley!
rows.description_html: Jump, glide and dash your way to the top of the mountain in this 3D adventure platformer set in an open and enchanting valley! You play as Sky, the Keeper's apprentice, who must venture into the Valley to save her master from succumbing to a deadly illness by finding a unique flower of healing that only grows on top of the mountain. Overcome the platforming trials of the Valley, seek out the Spirits for their blessings along the way, and unlock movement abilities that take you all the way from the low grasslands to the floating islands up high. Find your way and secure the future of the Valley. Keeper of the Valley features a satisfying movement-based design with interesting open-map platforming, original music score, motion captured animations, and a rich and striking visual design. We have developed our own motion matching technology for the animations as well. The game is best experienced with a controller and is open to mouse and keyboard as well.

rows.name: Clay Soldiers
rows.short_description: The war rages on, choose to side with the Mercenaries, the Undead, the Angels, and more! Play through the single-player campaign, unifying the factions. Fight against other players and AI in the battleground's mode! Or strive for a conquest that takes you through the ages in war mode.
rows.description_html: Free to play simple strategy Game! Play against people all around the world, in the same room as you, or the computer! A war rages between multiple factions. Take your side of multiple different alliances each with their own special ways to play, with the choice of different bonuses and castles that change the way each faction can play. Play through the campaign, a conquest of your enemies and the lands around them, unifying the tribes and creating a Mitch match army using the strongest characters that each faction has to offer! Spice up with different game modes, like the zombie apocalypse event, that change the playing field in different ways. Or play a more traditional game type with the War mode, advance from the stone age to the future age all while balancing the usage of recourses found around the map! Choose your alliance! The Angels: Servants of religion, they use their collective faith to summon powerful beings into existence. Convert enemy units into your religion. Stall the game long enough to summon gods! or slay the non-believers with faithful knights and crusaders! The Undead: Marching even after death, the undying use the corpses on the battlefield to snowball into an unstoppable force! Infect your opponents with disease and poison, swarm the board with zombies and liches, or drain the lifeforce of your opponent's using vampires! The Mercenaries: Gold is king, this alliance is proud of its stable and reliable income. Build castles and walls to defend key spots of the map, strike quick and hard with calvary, catapults and archers, protect your healers and merchants to keep your units alive and leveling up. And many more will be added later on! As well as new units, bonuses and Castles.
rows.about_html: Free to play simple strategy Game! Play against people all around the world, in the same room as you, or the computer! A war rages between multiple factions. Take your side of multiple different alliances each with their own special ways to play, with the choice of different bonuses and castles that change the way each faction can play. Play through the campaign, a conquest of your enemies and the lands around them, unifying the tribes and creating a Mitch match army using the strongest characters that each faction has to offer! Spice up with different game modes, like the zombie apocalypse event, that change the playing field in different ways. Or play a more traditional game type with the War mode, advance from the stone age to the future age all while balancing the usage of recourses found around the map! Choose your alliance! The Angels: Servants of religion, they use their collective faith to summon powerful beings into existence. Convert enemy units into your religion. Stall the game long enough to summon gods! or slay the non-believers with faithful knights and crusaders! The Undead: Marching even after death, the undying use the corpses on the battlefield to snowball into an unstoppable force! Infect your opponents with disease and poison, swarm the board with zombies and liches, or drain the lifeforce of your opponent's using vampires! The Mercenaries: Gold is king, this alliance is proud of its stable and reliable income. Build castles and walls to defend key spots of the map, strike quick and hard with calvary, catapults and archers, protect your healers and merchants to keep your units alive and leveling up. And many more will be added later on! As well as new units, bonuses and Castles.

rows.name: LIFTOPIA one more!
rows.short_description: The big adventure of a square creature!It is a somewhat nostalgic action game drawn with dots.
rows.description_html: The big adventure of a square creature! It is a somewhat nostalgic action game drawn with dots. The main character, Lifton, doesn't say anything, but he seems to be heading somewhere. Lifton will capture a variety of stages with the help of the enemies around him (while using them). The feature of this game is to 'lift' the enemy. Enemies picked up by Lifton can be thrown, thrown away, or whatever. By the way, some enemies have some effect while increasing or decreasing.

rows.name: Wizard's Wheel 2
rows.short_description: An idle and incremental rpg, inspired by retro, turned based role playing games, Wizard's Wheel 2 comes packed with heroes to collect, loot to acquire, equipment to upgrade, and a ton of ways to progress. Recruit, equip, upgrade, and spin the Wizard's Wheel in this deep, retro idle RPG.
rows.description_html: The Dimension is in peril in this idle RPG, inspired by retro, turned based role playing games. Wizard's Wheel 2 is an epic, retro, pixel-art game, with idle/incremental mechanics and progression. With roughly 80 heroes to recruit, 150 base item types with randomly generated additional modifiers to seek, upgradable wizard powers to grant additional support, item crafting, mini-games and more, Wizard's Wheel 2 offers you limitless ways to play and customization for your chosen adventuring party. Play actively by selecting hero commands, boosting game speed with the wizard's wheel, and playing the unlockable dimensional deck mini-game, or play idly by enabling auto-battle, and letting your heroes do what they do best. As the powerful Wizard of Time, you'll salvage Time Mana from bosses slain, and use it to build statues in the Temple of TIme, granting powerful, permanent upgrades. Progress farther during each attempt at defeating a particular map level by collecting and upgrading equipment, recruiting new heroes or leveling up existing ones, upgrading temple statues and unlocking wizard powers, until you're finally able to conquer and save your dimension Features Include: Idle or Active Game-play - Gain various additional boosts and buffs by participating more often, or let your heroes battle until defeated using Auto-Battle. Incremental Numbers - Grow in power, exponentially, using any of the various systems in place, to deal damage-numbers with more 0's than ever. Tons of Heroes - Customize your 4-hero party by unlocking and recruiting from roughly 80 base hero types, each with an upgraded version, unique active and passive skill, stat growth rate, equipment options and more. Choose from characters such as knights, skeletons, mechs, or, as rumor would have it, dragons. Tons of Loot - As you gain strength and slay increasing numbers of monsters, you'll gain tens, hundreds, even thousands of chests on a game run, with randomly generated items. And don't worry! Wizard's Wheel 2 has a built-in... Loot Filter - Don't want to sit and sell dozens of items after every run? You can configure which items are auto-sold using various customizable toggles, once too much loot drops for your liking. Upgradable Village - Unlock crafters, recruitment areas, item shops, training facilities and more by building and upgrading buildings in your village. Item Crafting - Upgrade your Massive Broadsword of Quick Strikes by improving its bonus level at the blacksmith, its item tier at the manasmith, or its quality with whetstones at the alchemist. Is it socketed? Place an upgradable gem in it for extra elemental damage. Oh, and don't forget to imbue it with an Ascension Token, so that it becomes eternal, no matter what dimension you're in! Altered Gameplay with Timelines - Discover more than 20 alternate timelines, each with game-changing modifications to characters, enemies, items and more. Each timeline has unique items and/or item modifiers only available while adventuring in them. Daily Dungeon - Fight in the Inter-dimensional (or Daily) Dungeon, which lets you take your strongest party as far as they can reach, with its own set of unique loot to claim based on progress each day. Pantheon - Challenge a series of increasingly difficult boss enemies, granting additional permanent buffs and obtainable equipment. Dimensional Deck - Unlock and play a solitaire mini-game using the dimensional deck while on a run with your heroes, granting bonus multipliers to gold, time mana and loot, as well as granting other unique, immediate effects. Unlock and upgrade cards in your dimensional deck by conquering zones with various heroes. Capture Hero Skills with Skill Gems - Create countless hero configurations by capturing the skills of previously unlocked heroes in Skill Gems, granting those skills to any hero which equips them. Pets - Acquire eggs from slain enemies and place them into your hatchery, in order to obtain pets. Pets gain levels while incubating at the hatchery, and each grant up to 3 buffs to help your party advance while active. Breed pets of opposite genders to increasingly powerful buffs. Seasonal Timelines - Participate in seasonal events in order to battle unique enemies and unlock additional characters and loot. And more secrets to uncover... Note: This game requires an internet connection in order for offline progress to be enabled. Wizard's Wheel 2 is free to play. Some permanent boosts are available for a one-time cost. However, gems, the premium currency, can be found in game. There are NO characters, items, or any other areas of game content which require in app purchasing. (Note: A hero acquired with gems is then permanently unlocked.)

rows.name: theBlu
rows.short_description: Experience the wonder and majesty of the ocean through a series of habitats and come face to face with some of the most awe inspiring species on the planet.
rows.description_html: theBlu: is a deeply immersive VR series that allows audiences to experience the wonder and majesty of the ocean through different habitats and come face to face with some of the most awe inspiring species on the planet. The series, which is directed by Jake Rowell (Call of Duty, Final Fantasy, Superman Returns), has been designed as beautiful moments in passing or a collection of memories that powerfully tap into the vast potential of VR. The debut episode, featuring an incredible close encounter with an 80 foot whale, is already recognized as one the most iconic room scale VR experiences to date (a Sundance Film Festival 2016 selection). Dive into more DLC experiences: Reef Migration Witness the magnificence of an undersea migration on the edge of a coral reef. Luminous Abyss Venture into the deepest region of the ocean to discover the iridescent abyss. Hammerhead Cove Sun lit Caribbean waters welcome you to a realm where one creature reigns supreme.

rows.name: For Goodness Sake
rows.short_description: In a final attempt to guarantee your place on the nice list, you decide to try and do some chores before midnight. Will Krampus take you? Take the test and find out.
rows.description_html: THE NIGHT IS FINALLY HERE Every early December another kid from your school goes missing, and rumors on the playground have circulated that it's related to Krampusnacht- the night that a half-goat half-demon named Krampus comes and steals away naughty children and spares the good. But what is it that determines if people are taken by Krampus? For Goodness Sake is a very short horror text heavy game , focusing on several trolley problem situations. While completing the chores around the house, you find yourself reflecting on situations involving the neighborhood kids that have gone missing & ultimately deciding what you think might have been the right thing to do. Will you be taken by Krampus at the end of the night like the others, or will you be spared? Playtime: 15-20 minutes. 3D first person navigation Ending depends on your answers given Rich audio design and unsettling atmosphere Created in one month, for the HauntedPS1 community's Madvent [3] Calendar project. This was created as a small mental break from DEAD LETTER DEPT , a psychological horror typing game also available on Steam.

rows.name: Ecosphere - Prologue
rows.short_description: The Pirate Princess must infiltrate a memorial to steal an orb with the power to control nature: Ecosphere. Will you manage to steal the precious loot?
rows.description_html: In this visual novel, you play as Leily Stirner, the Pirate Princess! Mandated by a mysterious mission's sponsor, she must infiltrate a memorial to steal an orb capable of controlling nature: the Ecosphere! But beware: each decision will impact the progress of your mission... Will you manage to steal the precious loot? This free prologue (about twenty minutes of gameplay) will be the opportunity to lay the foundations of a much bigger universe! An atypical universe Enter a universe mixing Fantasy, Steampunk, and Pirates! A planet where magical powers meet technology. A world where humans are born with an Affinity: the mark that gives the ability to master one of the four natural elements! Interactive Fiction During the adventure, you will regularly have choices to decide the best way to enter the Memorial and influence the story. Two ends and several tactics to achieve them. Point & click Explore and interact with your environment using a drag-and-drop system: dragging items from your inventory and dropping them in-game to unlock contents. Battle mode Based on Quick Time Event, a battle mode is integrated for casting spells. Press the button before it's too late: if you click the attack button, you trigger the magic. If you miss it, the opponent attacks, and you suffer damage! Turbomedia It is a comic book designed for digital devices and exploits its technical possibilities, such as animations and interactions. An action sequence is available in this prologue. In-game rewards A gallery of 9 unlockable CGs. Riocamy (Production director, writer, programmer) - Zelyphia (Character artist) - DSittaro (Background artist) - VFX and sound design are licensed from asset stores.

rows.name: Derision
rows.short_description: A first-person horror mystery adventure game. Find a way to avoid your captors and escape a nightmarish dungeon in an original world, and first video game, created by Anatolio, an independent developer.
rows.description_html: Just Updated * 5/28/2024 UPDATE * Due to negative feedback I have sent the request to Steam to make this game free (instead of $1, the lowest you can make it). If you are looking to purchase Derision now for $1, please wait until the FREE update has gone into effect. Derision was really just a learning experience for me as a Unreal Engine developer and a test run for the Steam SDK. Thanks to everyone who played and gave me constructive feedback. Please look forward to my next game which is already much higher quality. About the Game Derision You awake to the bars of your prison cell sliding open. You apprehensively peak outside and the dark, towering form of a Lich patrolling in the distance is the reason why. Can you find a way to escape this nightmarish dungeon? Use your discernment to navigate your way past Liches, disguise yourself, and find the key to your escape. You will receive aid on your journey, will you aid others after you? Help those imprisoned with you, and those that come after you. Or not... Even if you make it out, will anyone believe you? Or will your stories be met with Derision? These are questions you can provide the answers to with multiple endings based on your decisions. Gameplay Features: - First-person adventure set in an underground prison full of Liches. Try to escape. - Immerse yourself in an original and dark world created by Anatolio. - Independently developed by Anatolio. First UE5 game. - Avoid patrolling AI - Disguise yourself as a Lich to sneak by and get the key to your escape! - Multiple interactions with NPCs and Notes for additional lore. - 1 final cinematic cutscene. - 3 gameplay ratings based on objectives completed. - 3 endings based on rating. Save yourself or help others? - 1 Steam Achievement for escaping. - Options menu for graphics settings. * MATURE WARNING * - 1 scene with humans hanging from chains as they await to be transformed... * DISCLAIMER * This is the first production video game I have made in Unreal Engine 5. Please set your expectations low.

rows.name: Balance 97.261/100
rows.short_description: A patient person, who uses his hands to adjust the world.
rows.description_html: A patient man uses his hands to adjust the world as he sees it. Balance 97.261/100 is a game of precise placement of objects using both hands, a bit difficult, but with calmness and patience, you can reach the end. You can. Rotate the floor tiles to the correct angle. Stack the messy books vertically. Put the paintings in the art gallery in the right position. Turn the lid of the hand sanitizer in one direction. Even get the earth back to where she should be. This game also supports multiplayer mode with one person controlling one hand, so hopefully you and your partner can achieve a 100% synchronization rate. About the Developer I'm Liujiajun , this is my sixth game on Steam, I hope you like my work and thanks for playing.

rows.name: KIRO II: The Wizards Guild
rows.short_description: KIRO II: The Wizards Guild is a fantasy based multiplayer dungeon crawler in which up to six players can join online together to navigate through semi-procedurally generated dungeons using a classic text command system to slay monsters, collect loot, and defeat dungeon bosses.
rows.description_html: Enter the world of KIRO II: The Wizards Guild, an immersive multiplayer dungeon crawler that combines fantasy and adventure! Gather up to six players online and embark on an epic journey through semi-procedurally generated dungeons. Using a classic text command system, you'll battle ferocious monsters, collect rare loot, and take on mighty dungeon bosses to prove your might. Are you ready to join the Guild and become a true wizard? Randomly Generated Dungeons... Navigate through semi-randomly generated dungeons that each contain a special dungeon boss. Online Multiplayer Up to 6 Players... Join with up to 6 players to adventure through multiple dungeons, each with their own dungeon boss. Work together to find loot chests and defeat enemies in semi-randomly generated worlds. Save Items Between Dungeon Runs... With a rich leveling system similar to classic tabletop games and MMORPG's of the past, players can specialize their playstyle to how they want. With the use of Steam's inventory system, loot collected by players can be traded from player to player and persist from game to game. Real-time Text Commands...

rows.name: Spaceflight Factory : Prologue
rows.short_description: Spaceflight: Prologue is an Automation and Base Building game with some survival game mechanics.During this prologue, You will lead a small colony of human remnants. Help them to survive, expand and gather enough resources to leave Earth for their new home planet.
rows.description_html: Spaceflight Factory : Prologue: is an Automation and (moving) Base Building inspired by Factorio and Stardeus. During this Prologue, you will focus only on crafting rockets and try to launch them correctly to Earth. On a post-apocalyptic Earth, all cities and settlements have been ravaged by pollution and a hostile biosphere. In a last hope to salvage Earth, a crew of the best astronauts have been sent to a remote planet to collect a mysterious ore capable of turning Earth's destiny. You will have to build an assembly line with conveyor belts, factory(s), foundry(s), insertor(s)... while defending your base from nearby swarms of Zorglings and rebuild an industry capable of launching spacecrafts and sending the supplies back to Earth. With this new hope, you will lead a colony of human remnants. Help them to survive, and expand/gather enough resources to leave Earth. . The game also includes some incremental/idle game mechanics.

rows.short_description: Become the king of Edemn, take part in the battles of the skeletons that have risen thanks to ancient magic. Dynamic Online 3D Shooter that will drag you out for a long time!
rows.description_html: Edemn is a fun and dynamic shooter about skeletons who have risen through ancient magic and now fight among themselves. The game is done in the style of games from the early 2000s, which creates a cool atmosphere to play You will have to fight with other players, for the victory with different types of weapons. rows.name: Dominator Idle
rows.short_description: Dominator Idle is the ultimate idle game for world domination. Train troops and purchase magical upgrades in order to takeover the entirety of earth. With a powerful prestige system you can grow your power to unfathomable standards allowing you to conquer stronger versions of Earth.
rows.description_html: Gameplay Dominator Idle mixes clicker games with strategy. The controls are very simple just using your left mouse button to click! Train troops and unlock magical upgrades in the associated panels. Troops are your main battle strength and should be the forefront of gaining more battle power. Magical upgrades will enhance your units in battle. Troops first, magic second. Engage in world conquest to take over all of Earth through these battles. Once you have taken all of the territories of earth on the attack page, prestige in order to increase your overall strength! This will reset upgrades but give you a permanent boost to your account! The enemies you face will be more challenging but with your newfound prestige they will be no match for you! Developer Notes I am a solo developer of the game and will be keeping it free forever. More content releases are planned in the future such as cutscenes and more upgrades. Currently in early access as there is a lot that needs improving such as a balance pass, sound, art, ui etc. I hope you all enjoy playing the game and I appreciate your feedback! Discord Server:

rows.name: Ricky's Rockin' Arcade
rows.short_description: Ricky’s Rockin’ Arcade allows in person hangouts to gain a digital dimension giving you a virtual arcade to hang out in, and turn an ordinary game night into something unforgettable!
rows.description_html: Call your friends and prepare to face-off in a virtual arcade showdown! These multiplayer games allow you to band together as a group to save the day, or turn on each other to see who comes out victorious! Designed for in-person gameplay with a crowd, Ricky's Rockin’ Arcade will provide up to five unique arcade games for you to enjoy. The first game is out now, with four more coming this summer! Try your luck in an infiltrator race through a neon landscape with your fellow hackers. Once you’ve experienced Ricky’s first game, you’ll be anxious to see what else he has in store for you! Perfect for game nights, group hangouts, and anytime you’d rather be battling monsters than small-talk!

rows.name: Paper Lily - Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Paper Lily is an RPG horror game in which you can solve puzzles in different ways. Explore a hidden world, meet strange characters, and guide Lacie as she attempts to find answers about her unusual condition.
rows.description_html: Something terrible has happened. You can’t bear to think about it - but you can’t live like this anymore. You stopped attending school, you haven’t left your house in months, you have no reason to get out of bed anymore. There are no choices left. No choice except... that strange golden letter. It’s time to get your life back together. One last try. Paper Lily is a story-driven, psychological horror RPG where each puzzle has multiple solutions and outcomes. There is always another way. Follow Lacie's story as you explore a dangerous hidden world, solve puzzles in multiple different ways, and face strange enemies. The game is playable in about 4 hours and contains multiple endings depending on your actions. Paper Lily - Chapter 1 is the continuation to the prologue, Project Kat, but it can also be enjoyed without having played it. Out of Context Features Multiple ways of solving puzzles! Touch grass, and trees Minigames where you press buttons and push boxes around Call your mother Harmless Snack™ Various things made of paper Bunnies (or whatever those things are) Demons Fast demons Social anxiety simulation Table salt ...Is that Kat? Nah, probably not Bathroom etiquette Death

rows.name: The Year of the Carrot
rows.short_description: A cool game where you pick up carrots, throw stuff around and watch it bounce off the walls.
rows.description_html: Betsy the Bunny Rabbit wants to pick up some carrots! Hop around, pick up and throw stuff, and try to collect all the carrots! Rock out to amazing chiptune ragtime music! See if you can make it through all 96 rooms! It's a puzzle game that's maybe a little different! You can run around, jump, and pick up & throw various things you may find in the room. When you throw something, it flies around the room and bounces off the walls until it hits the ground. It's fun to just hang out sometimes and keep throwing stuff around! You can pick up marbles and throw them around the room. If three marbles of the same color line up, they flash and disappear! Sometimes you want that to happen. Sometimes you don't. It's part of life to learn what you want! You can pick up and throw critters as well. They can't hurt you, and you can't hurt them. If the mood strikes, you can stand on top of them and ride around. Maybe they can help you reach new places! Featuring 12 worlds with 8 rooms each, for 96 rooms total. The 12 worlds are divided into 3 episodes of 4 worlds each. The worlds in each episode can be tackled in any order. So what awaits in these worlds? Sky High Keep : Home to floating Platforms and flying fish. Why are the fish flying? Why not? Tabby Catacombs : These spooky crypts feature the Drop Bolts, which fall down as you stand on them, as well as the Bass Knobs, which fall slower than the bolts but retract faster. You may also find the Anti-Bolts and Treble Knobs, which rise up when you stand on them! Woods of Hermia : Here come the Rocket Blocks! When you stand on them, they move left or right; after you jump off of them, they move back to their original position. Titania Capitol : The Diamond and Heart Blocks will allow you to super-jump and double jump if you jump off of them. Equinox Isle : The Bubble Pots will continuously create bubbles that you can jump on. But be careful! You can’t stand on them for long! Temple of Helena : You’re going to love this! The Magi Blocks appear & disappear at set intervals. Also, there are flying pigs! Mercurial Mines : In the mines, you’ll find Arrow Zingers, which will Zing thrown marbles and critters in all sorts of different directions. Hazy Shade Land : This frozen world has the Elevators, which activate as long as you’re standing on them, and stop otherwise. Also, it has everyone’s favorite: Ice Blocks you can slip on! Plus, there’s 4 more worlds that mix & match all these things to give you a nice finale! Oh, and I almost forgot: the POWERUPS ! The Keys will cause the Door Blocks to open. The Mushrooms will cause the Invisible (hollow) Blocks to appear. The Music Notes will cause all marbles of the same color to flash and disappear. The Gems will turn all marbles of the same color in Metal Balls, which don’t match with anything. …Except for the Metal Gem , which will turn all Metal Balls into Wildcard Marbles, which match with all colors! The Book reverses gravity for Betsy, so you can run on the ceiling! The Magnets change gravity for the marbles, so they will fall in different directions! And the Carrots ! Gotta get those carrots! They’ve got Vitamin A!

rows.name: Project Regolith
rows.short_description: Work together with a partner to solve a series of non-Euclidean Escape Room puzzles to uncover the mystery behind the vanished crew of Outpost Rhea, a deep-space research facility experiencing strange spatial anomalies.
rows.description_html: Join us on Discord! About the Game Explore the Mystery of Outpost Rhea Project Regolith is a 2-Player Cooperative Puzzler made by a small team of 4 in Melbourne, Australia, where you and a partner are tasked with uncovering the mystery behind the vanished crew of Outpost Rhea, a deep-space research facility overseen by a Corporate body that enforces strict NDA clauses and communications embargoes amongst it's employees. The rules of time and space are breaking down aboard the station. Communication is key, as the two of you might not be seeing the same thing. Were those walls there before? Did the door just move? Wait, are you walking on the ceiling !? The station's research has led to some bizarre anomalies that have begun to warp environments on a whim - Explore a series of non-Euclidean puzzles together with your partner to uncover the fate of Outpost Rhea and the experiment at the heart of it all - Project Regolith. KEY FEATURES 2 Player Coop Puzzling - Team up with a partner, friend, enemy, stranger, or anything in-between to uncover the mystery behind Project Regolith. Non-Euclidean Spaces - As the anomalies plaguing Outpost Rhea worsen, you'll come across warped spaces that defy physics, and objects that defy your senses. The Lives of Rhea's Crew - Learn more about the major players aboard Outpost Rhea, from the station's Executive Director, to the humble catering staffers. Thirty (30) collectible Audio Logs tell the story of the station, and help shed light on the experiments aboard the station, and the lives of the crew affected by them. Voiced by an incredibly talented cast made possible by our Kickstarter backers!

rows.name: Embracing Darkness
rows.short_description: 'Embracing Darkness' is a fan visual novel in which players can enjoy a short encounter with Local Villains Tiefedorf and Shuraomaru.
rows.description_html: 'Embracing Darkness' is a fan visual novel in which players can enjoy a short encounter with Local Villains Tiefedorf and Shuraomaru in the form of an interactive fiction story. FEATURES Japanese & English languages available 3 scenarios Non-gendered protagonist that can be read as either male or female Completely free STORY Shuraomaru's story Every day, you get lunch at your favorite café, and you sit down at your favorite table to eat. This time, however, there's someone already on your seat when you get there, and he seems to be waiting for you... Tiefedorf's story After getting lost in the woods during a winter storm, you end up at a mysterious mansion. With nowhere else to turn to, you find yourself accepting the invitation of its owner to stay for tea... Bonus Scenario Ever since you inherited your grandfather's mystic shop, you've been used to dealing with all kinds of phantoms and shady figures. But there's something about two of your newest clients you can't quite put your finger on..

rows.name: Game of Rollink
rows.short_description: Game of Rollink is a PvP card game with auto-battler made with CliCli, where you play as a medieval lord to outwit sinister opponents on the gaming table and seize the supreme throne. Bet wisely because gold and countless lives of loyal soldiers are at stake.
rows.description_html: Join the arena and play Rollink! Challenge a friend to a 1v1 battle or compete against up to 7 opponents to claim the Crown of Destiny! Join our discord to share your feedback! Experience a unique and innovative combination of cards and autochess set in a medieval fantasy world. Feel the adrenaline rush as your cards turn and your troops clash. Strategize and make the best hands to compete for the crown of destiny, a symbol of supreme power, or risk watching your gold be taken by other competitors. Uncover ancient family histories and missions on the table of fate while you play as medieval lords with distinct voice acting and personalities. The story takes place in the era of turbulence under the reign of ill-fated Caesar XV, where the next successor shall rise from the arena to subdue the queen of pirates, who has closed secret deals with the monstrous flying dragons. Take a glimpse of Caesar Empire's former splendour through the marble-pillared corridor, sumptuous palace, and magnificant arena. The solemn yet majestic fuse of orchestra and choir, along with clinking drops of gold and belligerent speech of the lords, invite you to a mythical land far, far away. Summon powerful creatures and valiant troops for a spectacular fight in the arena. Trample your enemies with powerful lord skills as your cards turn into units and battle to death for you. Fold or all in! The odds are changing every minute. Bet strategically because winning is only secured with the right blend of cards, spells and skills. Inspired by but beyond the classic Texas Hold'em gameplay, Game of Rollink holds infinite replayability given its vast combination of lords, hands and spells. Even beginners will get a hang of the game mechanics and be intrigued in a few rounds.

rows.name: Candyboy
rows.short_description: Make it through Halloween in this NES inspired, candy filled adventure!
rows.description_html: It's Halloween night - a time for fear and fright. For tricks and treats. A time... to dine on candy! Join Candyboy on his quest to gather as many sweets as he can before the night is through. But look out! Danger lurks around every corner, and even Candyboy has reason to be afraid. Features Inspired by the old school, tough as nails NES platformers Multiple endings Platformer PACIFICISM! Candyboy can't beat up his bullies, so he evades them instead 6 enemies to beware of, from bad bullies to rabid bats Cool chiptunes to listen to A fun time for audiences of all ages Enjoy the sweetest game of the year with Candyboy!

rows.name: Extinction / Zombie İnvasion 1
rows.short_description: We are trying to kill the doctor who started the zombie epidemic. And various zombies and scary events await us on this journey.
rows.description_html: We need to destroy Mahmut, who started the zombie epidemic, and we go through various ways to destroy him. Various zombies and islands are waiting for us, we return to our island after destroying Mahmut. 10 DIFFERENT ISLANDS The game world with 10 maps offers you many areas to explore. More than 10 regions are waiting to be discovered. WEAPONS Find weapons like pistols, rifles to protect yourself from bloodthirsty zombies. HUN OR FISH Food for milk, health kit etc. Avoid falling into the trap of various types of zombies. Also, use hints to collect keys to advance to other levels. FIRST PERSON There is also a camera angle in the game: First-person DISCOVER EVERYWHERE Explore the world and collect food and ammo to help you survive. 3x100 BLOOD You only have 3X100 health, but you can increase your health. But if you run out of health, the checkpoint will be canceled and you will be back to the beginning.

rows.name: Disavowed
rows.short_description: Disavowed is a Metroidvania that allows the player to freeze time and set up pinpoint shots to stun enemies. It is set in a world of plush and cute creatures where the player has been cast out and needs to go on a journey to gather more strength and get back at his creator for tossing him out.
rows.description_html: Embark on a journey in this Metroidvania to help a lowly reject exact revenge on its sadistic creator, the Tinkerer. Explore diverse zones including The Scrapyard, Plush Kingdom, Prismatic Waterways, and more in an attempt to become stronger for your ultimate revenge. The reject will use the very abilities his brethren were born with to dismantle its foes. The player can learn to wall jump, double jump, dash, and even fire a fully controllable stun shot that nearly freezes time. Anyone who stands in the way of the reject can be sliced down with his sword and various perks he purchased from the Trinkiteer. At the end of the day, The Tinkerer must fall.

rows.short_description: Chasmal is a top down action shooter with procedurally generated elements. Descend into a ruined machine using powerful items to overcome foes and reach the bottom of the depths.
rows.description_html: Chasmal is a top down action shooter with procedurally generated elements. Descend into a ruined machine using powerful items to overcome foes and reach the bottom of the depths. Featuring over 100 items and weapons, four playable characters, and three difficulty settings.

rows.name: Shiitake Showdown
rows.short_description: The showdown between Snakes and Shrooms rages on in this high action first person arena shooter. Use your control over the elements and your experience with a gun to show up your friends and slay your enemies!
rows.description_html: A parasitical race of Myconids has recently surfaced within the world, infecting and wiping out many civilisations. They desire to assimilate everything within their Mycelium network and create a dark world, shrouded in the shadow of their fungi so that they can live on the surface without fear of the light. However, their next target, a collection of cold-blooded Serpents are devout worshippers of the Sun and refuse to let this happen and will do everything in their power to prevent this threat from winning. Unique weapons Battle it out with your friends or foes using a variety of different weapons that each excel in their own scenario. Change from using a shotgun at close range to a sniper from afar to make the most of each weapons strong point. Elemental utility Utilise your power over the elements with 4 to chose from. Wield 2 of these elements at the same time to adapt depending on the situation. Each element suits a different playstyle so try them all and see what suits you best. Diferent maps and game modes With 4 different maps and 4 gamemodes to play on each of them play them all and find what combination is your favorite! Customization Change your caracter skin and color to suit your style. With loads of combinations to choose from there is something to suit everyone!

rows.name: Blood Wizard Odyssey
rows.short_description: An absurd comedy turn-based RPG about wizards in a blood world
rows.description_html: Blood Wizard Odyssey is an RPG about a little Wizard on a big, big adventure... Assemble your team of wretched magicians to traverse a fetid world of Ogres, Ghouls, Blood Imps, Blood, and more(!), and journey to uncover the secrets that this terrible blood earth holds. Includes: -blood wizards -nasty hags -ogres -blood ghouls -dwarves -meat -vinegar -the word of God -several former United States presidents

rows.name: Hedgewars
rows.short_description: Turn-based strategy, artillery, action and comedy game, featuring the antics of pink hedgehogs with attitude as they battle from the depths of hell to the depths of space.
rows.description_html: Hedgewars is a turn-based strategy, artillery, action and comedy game, featuring the antics of pink hedgehogs with attitude as they battle from the depths of hell to the depths of space. As commander, it's your job to assemble your crack team of hedgehog soldiers and bring the war to your enemy. Key Features. Hilarious and strategic turn based combat for up to 8 players. Both local and network multiplayer, with optional AI opponents. Two singleplayer campaigns with a total of 24 missions. Utilize about 58 devastating weapons and utilities! Defeat your foes with simple weapons like grenades or take it to the next level and trash entire landscapes with weapons like the watermelon bomb or piano strike. Improve your skills in a total of more than 25 single missions for learning the game, target practice, challenges and just for fun. Battle on an infinite number of randomly generated maps with 37 environments, or choose from 44 set image maps, or even draw your own in an editor. Play the game your with 25 different game modifiers, tweak almost every aspect of the match. Save your favourite gameplay settings in schemes. Customize your team, with over 280 hats/costumes, 32 graves, 13 forts, 100s of flags and 13 unique voice packs.

rows.name: Kairos
rows.short_description: Kairos is an RTS game set in a medieval fantasy world consumed by Corruption. As a last bastion of life, you must build bases and lead your armies to fight the endless hunger. Discover new magics to purify the land and reclaim what was lost. At the end of times, will you win? Or you will die trying?
rows.description_html: Kairos is an RTS fantasy experience that pits the player against the corruption in the world. The player must build structures and train soldiers, archers, and mages to fight alongside the hero and defeat the corruption. If left to its own devices, the corruption will send corrupted units to defeat the player's forces as well as expand and overrun the land until the player has nowhere left to hide. You must not only train soldiers to fight corrupted enemies but also create purifiers to reclaim the corrupted land. The primary enemy the player will face is a corruption that slowly expands across the continent. The corruptions will not only hurt the players units, but it will build up it’s own army of monsters to take down the player’s kingdom. As such, it is the players job to keep his kingdom alive and, with enough effort, cure their homeland of this vile plague. Using a collection of different units, structures, and magic, the player will be able to build and expand their kingdom into the corrupted parts of the world. As you expand, more resources will become available to the player. This will allow the player to continue to expand into the deeper corruption. Eventually, with enough effort, the player will completely purify the continent, making it a prosperous land.

rows.description_html: Animal Survivors is a casual survival game with minimalistic time-based gameplay with simplistic roguelike elements. rows.short_description: EMPTY SHELL: PROLOGUE will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a japanese island. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a 'recovery operation' without being privy to too many details. A tense roguelite survival horror with a top down perspective.
rows.description_html: EMPTY SHELL: PROLOGUE will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a japanese island in the middle of nowhere. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a 'recovery operation' without being privy to too many details. They said the facility had been abandoned for decades, but once in place it was immediately apparent that something was wrong. Discover the dark secrets of the facility's years of operation, up until the accident that led to the extreme consequences you are involved in. Every time you die, you will control a new volunteer sent to the place. Your starting equipment will be randomized and each level will be generated with a new layout. Dark corridors and cold rooms. Abominable creatures and bloody fights. Puzzles to solve, equipment, logs and documents to recover await you in this roguelite survival horror. Random generated maps every time you enter a new level or you die A top down perspective surrounded by darkness Scavenge weapons, ammo and gadgets to raise your chance to survive Manage your inventory to make room for what you deem vital Different types of enemies will hunt you down each room of the facility Buy upgrades and devices to help you during fights Find logs and documents from the 1950s to unveil the stories of the people who worked there

rows.name: Jump Dash Soar
rows.short_description: Jump Dash Soar is a frenetic, fast, and fun movement-based FPS. Build incredible speed with a powerful dash mechanic combined with rocket jumping, strafe running, slope jumps, and bounce pads!
rows.description_html: Jump Dash Soar ...is a frenetic, fast, and fun movement-based FPS. Build incredible speed with a powerful dash mechanic combined with rocket jumping , strafe running , slope jumps , and bounce pads ! But Jump Dash Soar isn't just about going fast. It's about quickly, but smoothly and precisely, directing that speed to traverse maps, solve timed puzzles, and find hard-to-reach collectibles. Ready to test your FPS skills with some throw-back Boomer Shooter movement? Collectibles Each level is packed with collectibles. Some are a mere rocket jump away, but others are much trickier, and many might seem downright impossible to reach! Some are over 40 meters high. Some are stashed behind laser speed gates, the kind that'll give you a nasty singe if you don't meet the minimum speed. But the most challenging are locked away behind timed doors: activate the door by shooting a button, watch the countdown start, and go fast! The hardest will only give you a single second to make it through! Are you up for the challenge? Tutorials If you're not a seasoned FPS pro, don't worry, Jump Dash Soar has comprehensive tutorials that cover every movement technique available. You can time your rocket jumps down to the millisecond, angle your rocket sprints to a tenth of a degree, and reach ridiculous heights with a slope dash jump all by using information presented clearly on the HUD. You can even check out the view rotation meter to see a real-time readout of how effective your strafe running is at building speed. Even better, Jump Dash Soar has a built-in Macro editor that makes these advanced movement techniques only a key-bind away! Speedruns Once you've first figured out how to get all the collectibles, why not try to get them all... but really fast? Jump Dash Soar has a built-in speedrun mode! Continually improve your time by finding new routes, pickup sequences, and work-arounds. Each collectible has an 'intended' solution, but any movement technique you can use to reach it is fair game! Maps Jump Dash Soar is the work of a single developer, and includes three maps: The Sludge Factory Start your Jump Dash Soar journey in the expansive and intricate Sludge Factory. Learn the basics of dashing, rocket jumping, and slope jumping, and use those skills to reach 48 total collectibles! Some are relatively easy to reach, but others will test all the skills you've learned. Can you speedrun them all in under 8 minutes? The Sanctum of Sludge Ready to go faster, further, and higher? The Sanctum of Sludge is a massive level that'll introduce you to Jump Dash Soar's advanced movement techniques: rocket wall climbs, the incredibly powerful rocket dash jump, strafe jumping, rocket wall runs, and the rocket dash sprint! You could stay on the tutorial path, but why not take on some of the challenge rooms? You'll need everything you've learned to tackle some of these! Try a speedrun to see just how fast you can find all 48 collectibles! Smooth Frog Classic SFC is a throwback level to the old classic deathmatch maps. The Tutorial Guys are now targets! Practice your movement, traverse the map, and improve your shot accuracy!

rows.name: Turtle Racer
rows.short_description: Turtle Racing is an educational undersea experience where you speed through an ocean trench and use your knowledge of marine life to reach the finish before your opponent!
rows.description_html: Turtle Racer is an educational racing game designed for players to learn about biological marine life and their environment. Players take the role of the humble sea turtle as they explore the ocean to learn about sea life and test their knowledge in a thrilling race through an exotic ocean trench! Players have access to two different game modes: A free, relaxed exploration of the ocean floor where they learn various facts about ocean life. The exciting and fast-paced race where your knowledge on marine biology may be the only thing between victory or defeat. Play the game as you wish! Confident in your marine knowledge? Head straight into the race! If not, take your time and learn about the secrets of sea life. But be warned, throughout your race the sea will present various questions to you. Swim through the correct answer and the ocean current will give your turtle a brief speed boost! But answer wrong and your opponent may pull ahead.

rows.name: Temanava
rows.short_description: TEMANAVA is an Adventure/Exploration game where you play as a co-pilot who survived a crash. You will have to learn an unknown language in order to communicate with strange islanders and use your mysterious powers to find your commander!
rows.description_html: After surviving a crash on an unknown island, Amelia, a young co-pilot is now alone, separated from her commander. In her quest to find him and get off the island, she will discover the mysterious language of 'Temanava'. Temanava is populated by strange islanders. Learning a new language will enable Amelia to communicate with temanavians and obtain their help. - Speak with islanders : Select and use the right symbols to build correct sentences and converse with Temanavians. - Try & learn: Check notes of discovered symbols, test them on anything or anyone, anytime and anywhere you want. - Use your Notebook: Your notebook is going to be your best tool to get through this unknown language. - Interact with the world: Use the language to interact with nature and items in order to unlock and explore new places. - A cute and wholesome adventure: Embark on a 3D stylized journey with cute islanders and cozy visuals that makes you want to stay here forever. - An unique language: Temanava's language exists nowhere else and was built based on research made on ancient and faraway languages like Inuit, Pawnee, Arabic or Latin.

rows.name: Out of Three
rows.short_description: Out of Three is a local multiplayer Boss Rush game that can be played with 3 players. The goal: defeat the Boss Gorgone by cooperating with your team members. You and your 2 faithful comrades find yourselves in an unknown dungeon, face to face with a giant medusa. Your fate seems inevitable!
rows.description_html: Out of Three is a 3-player Local Multiplayer Boss Rush game. Lost in a dungeon, you and your two comrades must survive a terrible monster: Gorgon. Beware! 3 inexperienced villagers like yourselves are obviously no match. Fortunately, the gods are merciful and decide to lend you the 3 weapons of the trinity. The Bloody Fists: These boxing gloves belonged to the infamous Tiger-eyed Boxer. Wearing them allows you to drain your enemy's life points when hitting them, restoring your own. The Spield: Can't make up your mind between a spear or a shield? The Spield is the perfect choice. Attack your ennemy while reflecting some damage when shielding at the right time! The Lyre: If music is your thing, you should use the Lyre to harm Gorgon from afar with your false notes. Amidst chaos and disarray, you must find a way to cooperate with your friends to beat the boss. Swap weapons with your teammates and come up with the best strategy. Start from scratch, become true heroes. You'll have to swap weapons during battle if you want your party to be the most efficient. Studying each weapon will come in handy to become a real asset for your team. thank you Pernambuco for these amazing musics! You can go on his spotify or Youtube channel to see his work !

The Bloody Fists: These boxing gloves belonged to the infamous Tiger-eyed Boxer. Wearing them allows you to drain your enemy's life points when hitting them, restoring your own. The Spield: Can't make up your mind between a spear or a shield? The Spield is the perfect choice. Attack your ennemy while reflecting some damage when shielding at the right time! The Lyre: If music is your thing, you should use the Lyre to harm Gorgon from afar with your false notes. Amidst chaos and disarray, you must find a way to cooperate with your friends to beat the boss. Swap weapons with your teammates and come up with the best strategy. Start from scratch, become true heroes. You'll have to swap weapons during battle if you want your party to be the most efficient. Studying each weapon will come in handy to become a real asset for your team. thank you Pernambuco for these amazing musics! You can go on his spotify or Youtube channel to see his work !

rows.name: Robbie's Tale
rows.short_description: An action-packed turn-based RPG. Every decision you make shapes the world around you. 24 Playable classes! A unique crafting system. Test your might in the monster arena! A rich and driven story that will keep you on the edge of your seat.
rows.description_html: In the golden age of peace, the land of Eire has not seen war for many centuries. But all of that is about to change. Take control of our hero, Robbie, as he ventures on a journey to piece together the shattered history of his people while a dark force is growing stronger.

rows.name: BAPBAP
rows.short_description: Join BAPBAP, the Roguelike Party game where no two matches are ever the same. Round up your homies, pick a character, and build a giga-unfair build that'll make them hate you - then do it all over again!
rows.description_html: BAPBAP is a roguelike party game where you craft the most unfair builds to make your friends hate you. Invite and play with up to 7 friends in an all out brawl. Pick a random power after every round and craft the most ridiculous (or regrettable) build possible. BAPBAP is best played with friends who can handle betrayal. Set up custom games with wild rulesets, or jump into community-run servers and embrace the chaos. No matchmaking. No ranks. Just pure, dumb fun. Tight, free-flowing combat that’ll have you screaming for your mom to get the camera. Everything is dodgeable so if you get clapped, that’s on you. Or a goldfish piloting a mech. Or a Russian samurai. Or ramen with legs. Each characters comes with it’s own unique skillset and there’s a character design for everyone—even the freaks 👁️👄👁️. Whether it’s turning into a giant metallic duck, speccing into turretmancy, or literal poison, every game will present you with freshly randomized build combos to gamba with. Build synergies, get winnergies. Block escape routes with a crane’s payload, transform into a vending machine for a sneaky ambush, or do a drive-by in a 1942 Panzerkampfwagon Tiger Tank. BAPBAP is a PvP sandbox where nothing make sense but also everything makes sense. On top of all that, you could get ganked by a roaming giga slime, fish up a nuclear bomb or come face to tentacle with [redacted]  - the better you are at adapting, the more you’ll win. Whether it’s the turnaround 1v3, hitting a sweet multi-target knock up or just watching your mates get hit by their own trap – BAPBAP is here to help you get that sweet hit of dopamine in this increasingly depressing world. Welcome to BAPBAP, where logic goes to die.

rows.name: Redumption
rows.short_description: Redumption is an action adventure game where you explore a town consumed by the waste. Fight bosses and retrieve precious items to save your friends from the witch's curse. Can you clean up the town and achieve redumption?
rows.description_html: Your friends have been transformed into trash! Now it's up to you, as the only one left, to save them. With a little help from the Good Witch of the Woods and her magical broom, sprint across the waste cleaning up trash, fight the evil minions and save your friends. Reclaim lost items and gain power ups to help you on your quest to defeat the Evil Witch of the Waste. Become the hero and save the town from being consumed by junk and debris! Genre: 3d single player action adventure Audience: Recommended for 10 + Platform: Built for PC Features: Open exploration Combat or stealth Level up Controller support

rows.name: Aggregator Elevator System
rows.short_description: Challenge your logic and strategy in new ways in this deductive tile-placement puzzle game. Master a rich system of logical rules where you must arrange blocks within a grid to make everything add up perfectly.
rows.description_html: 'Aggregator Elevator System' is a strategic logic-based number puzzle game, designed and developed with a fresh original gameplay foundation. It caters to those who enjoy faintly similar games like Sudoku, Picross etc. The game involves strategically arranging blocks within a grid to make the horizontal and vertical signal numbers add up correctly. The blocks have intuitive logical properties such as adding, combining, equalizing, XY, distance etc and more which you can use to manipulate the values of the signals to solve each levels. A highly solvable combinatorial puzzle game. Focusing on a deep,versatile and balanced gameplay experience. The game involves the use of number logic, but it will not bog you down with any mind numbing math. The real focus is on analyzing number patterns and clever logical manipulations within tight constraints. The game is designed to respect both your time and your intelligence. CHOOSE AMONG 2 GAME MODES - 60 LEVELS EACH Over 60 semi hand-crafted levels which you can play for hours. The level composition are carefully set by hand but the solutions are randomly arranged through a custom seed. High replay value, as you can start new games using new seeds to generate fresh set of unique levels. Experience simple to complex puzzle systems through the emergent combination of many primitive block operations working in perfect synergy with each other. Multiple difficulty levels. Levels are carefully optimized separately for the two game modes. Aggregator is all about the mental satisfaction of solving logic based number puzzles. No artificial hindrance like timers or move counters. Optional tip and cheat feature to help pass challenging levels. Mouse/Keyboard/Gamepad support. Steam cloud save and achievements integration.

rows.name: December 1914
rows.short_description: A comic-style narrative-oriented game based on the Christmas Eve Truce during World War I.
rows.description_html: A comic-style narrative-oriented game based on the Christmas Eve Truce during World War I. Players will experience December 1914, playing the role of a soldier who has left his family to fight on the battlefield. The game is approximately 30 minutes long. 80% of the proceeds will be donated to countries affected by war. Four interactive mini-games Experience the life of soldiers on the battlefield through simple games with objectives, including: Killing enemy soldiers Delivering supplies past enemy lines Firing your weapon to deter the enemy and guard positions Executing stubborn captives At night Soldiers will have the opportunity to rest briefly at night. This is also when they will receive updates on the war, communicate with friends, enjoy simple military rations, smoke, and look at photos of their loved ones. Sanity value There is a sanity meter in the game, which will change based on the soldier's actions. For example, killing someone will lower the sanity value. The sanity value may also decrease after completing a mission. When the sanity value is too low, the player's perspective will change, colors will fade, and vision will become distorted. Supplies and thoughts of loved ones at night can restore the soldier's sanity. Christmas Eve The Pope proposed a ceasefire for Christmas, but the proposal was rejected by the officials of the warring countries. However, on Christmas Eve, a miracle occurred, starting with a few brave soldiers... Game Size One ending 52 illustrations
