rows.name: Eon of the Green: Area Delta (Prologue)
rows.short_description: A secret scientific research on life’s final terrene days. Your consciousness serves as a vessel gathering information on a future period they dubbed Eon of the Green. Slowly but surely it takes hold of your mind and the only human factor is that colleague on the intercom.
rows.description_html: WARNING: The game's cutscenes potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. After a dramatic failure of an undercover mission you become part of the top secret Klaassen Project. You are still unsettled by your past and wary about the intentions of your superiors. Recurring transmissions take you to Earth in 1 billion years. See breathtaking things and gain the knowledge for your research. You have to find out how life deals with the deadly power of the Sun. Your task is risky though. Can you deal with its stresses and strains? Discuss the weird future lifeforms with your assistant, Agent C. Show what you have learned during the transmissions. Along the way you carve out a unique relationship with her. You have to win her trust but keep up your autonomy at the same time. Both stats will be constantly modified by your answers and checks on them can be passed or failed. At crucial points a failed check means the end of your mission. Agent C wants you to take a psyche test to evaluate your qualities as a researcher. Are you willing to share your true self? It might be risky to fully open up. At the same time, you might be caught lying if you don't. Learn about Arthur Klaassen, the discoverer of Eon of the Green. Agent C will share parts of his diary with you. Haven't you heard of him before? Pay close attention to find out more about the complexities of the Klaassen Project. Key Features: unique game loop of text-based interaction and visuals 25k+ words of interactive fiction hints to the consequences of your choices allow for a tactical approach experimental CGI cut scenes with sound, simulating mental time travel several musical themes to enhance the game's atmosphere

rows.name: Water 2050
rows.short_description: Take on the ultimate challenge of being mayor of the last city with clean water reserves in 2050. Manage resources, discover new technologies and tackle the global water crisis with Water 2050. An innovative blend of city building, resource management, adventure, and survival genres all in one game.
rows.description_html: Water 2050 is a 2d isometric city manager about dealing with water pollution today so that we can have a future tomorrow. Playing as the Major, you’ll run the last inhabitable city in a not-so-distant future in which we turned our planet into a massive polluted landfill. Most water in Water 2050 is very polluted and barely apt for humans; there is a lot of environmental damage that have almost end life on Earth. Nothing that a little time travel can’t fix. Jump in time to the past to implement real-world technologies and behaviours that will reduce water pollution in the future. Deal with natural calamities, contaminated areas, hard choices, and a weirdly long-lived engineer that will assist you as much as possible. The future of Earth can be fixed today. The game is developed in association by the Water Environment Asociation , and aims to raise awareness of current practices and technologies that are being implemented to reduce our water pollution, thus ensuring a better tomorrow for all of us. Part of the money raised with this game is allocated by the WEF to research, dissemination and programs that address solutions to the water crisis. Game Features: Amazing cartoonish 2d isometric graphics. City builder and resource management mechanics. Awesome time traveling tech that enables to manage the city both in the future and in the past. Improving things in the past makes the future better as a consequence. 14 real-world technologies to research and achieve water sustainability Unlock Special buildings as Stadium, Cemetery, Observatory, Space Rocket Launch Site and many more, each with special events to resolve. Natural calamities as heat waves, smog, electric storm, acid rain, drought, blizzards, sandstorms and more will test your ability to keep the city alive. Dozens of events on which to make decisions with an impact on the survival of the city An informative but lighthearted way to address a very serious issue: How to clean and preserve our water. This is an amazing game that takes the adventure, resource management, city building and survival genres, mixing them with the real world water crisis to create a rich and powerful experience that raises awareness about what could happen to water in the future.

rows.name: Ball Animals
rows.short_description: Animal Ball is a local party game, where 2 to 4 animal balls fight against each other...Use your bouncy belly to bounce others away!
rows.description_html: The Background of Animal Ball Animal Ball is a joyful, local multiplayer, competitive, party game. The story is about small animals. Each player can control a small animal and try to use their belly to collide with the rear of others. Being the last character on the field is your goal. The first player to get three wins will obtain the final victory! Diverse Game Modes The game currently has two game modes, come and choose your favorite! Basic Mode: Play on a fixed map. Endless Mode: Fight on an endless scrolling map. Endangered Animal Characters In the game, you can switch between a variety of animal characters, all of which are endangered species: Golden monkey, crested ibis, panda, monk seal, macaw, elk, Siberian tiger... Various Maps Selection Meteorites, magma, bushes and ice fields Multiple Control Methods This game supports controller and keyboard/mouse. Press and hold to charge, release to attack! ATTENTION! Find the timing of release to achieve super bounce! Behind the Animal Ball... Although the atmosphere of the game seems to be joyful and funny, the story behind it is not peaceful: why do animals of different species fight in the same place and try to stay till the end? If they did have a tolerable environment to live in, who would choose to leave their homeland and fight other creatures in a strange place? What kind of truth is behind these tragedies? Do we humans need to take on certain responsibilities? Protecting the environment and protecting animals is an issue that is so often brought up that it will feel numb when you look at it again. Human beings gradually choose to turn a blind eye because of pain or guilt, and immerse themselves in their own happiness, but all these tragedies are still happening... So we made this free game to bring joy to players, but we also hope that everyone who has experienced this joy can pay attention to and think about the story behind this game, maybe the person who can save them and the world is you. About the Developing Team Animal Ball is developed by a group of friends who love animals. There is a detailed list of all developers in the game. Controllers Required! Ball Animals is a local multiplayer game, you will need one or more controllers to enjoy this game with your friends!

rows.name: Vampiric Tower Remix
rows.short_description: A puzzle game where you can fly around as a bat and try not to get zapped by pumpkins.
rows.description_html: Victoria the Vampire ascends the Vampiric Tower once more! A brand-new game featuring rooms from both Vampiric Tower 1 & 2, as well as plenty of new ones. Plus, it has all new graphics and music! And it's much easier than 2! For the uninitiated, Vampiric Tower is a box-pushing puzzle game. The original game was made way back in 2000, when I was 16. Vampiric Tower Remix is the best & definitive entry of the series! Push the boxes around to block the spells from the Pumpkins and the Ghosts. Try to pick up all the vials in each room without getting zapped, and then get to the exit! If you do get zapped, do not fret! You have unlimited lives in this game, so just try again! Turn into a bat to fly over spikes, water, pots, and other stuff in your way! Cast ice spells to turn the denizens of the tower into ice cubes that you can push around! Rock out to amazing chiptune remixes of Mozart classics! Featuring 15 worlds with 8 rooms each, for 120 rooms total. The 15 worlds are divided into 5 episodes of 3 worlds each. The worlds in each episode can be tackled in any order. Let’s check out those worlds! The Old Tower : Featuring classics from the original game! Get re-acquainted with the Pumpkins and Ghosts! Jiangshi Junction : The Jiangshis hop around and stop in place if they touch Victoria. Faerie Gardens : Faeries move back and forth to block Victoria’s progress. Nothing a well-placed ice spell can’t fix! Magick Library : Say hello to the Witches! They are intently reading their books, but when the last vial is collected, look out! Plus, it has all new graphics and music! And it's much easier than 2! For the uninitiated, Vampiric Tower is a box-pushing puzzle game. The original game was made way back in 2000, when I was 16. rows.name: DO_OR_DIE Hunt to Survive
rows.short_description: The concept of 'DO OR DIE – Hunt To Survive' revolves around intense player elimination, diverse weaponry, and buffs, with a primary objective of achieving high scores within a given time limit. The game features three distinct game modes, each offering a unique gameplay experience.
rows.description_html: “DO OR DIE – Hunt To Survive” presents an action-packed multiplayer game with a focus on competitive gameplay and diverse game modes. The primary objective is to connect players on a server and client to engage in intense battles within a give time limit, using various weapons to earn high scores and emerge as the winner. The game allows both solo and team-based play, with up to 8 players connecting to a match. The game features three different type of maps, each offering unique game-play experiences: Free For All: In this mode, all players are connected individually, and their scores are tracked separately. Players spawn at different locations with default weapons. The objective is to fight against each other, acquiring weapons from the environment, and scoring points by eliminating opponents. The addition of buffs adds depth and excitement to the gameplay, and players re-spawn with different locations upon death. Team Death Match: Players are divided into two teams automatically, namely the “Red Team” and the “Blue Team.” If there are four players connected, each team will have two players. The teams compete against each other, and the player’s objective is to work with their team members to defeat the opposing team. Upon death, players re-spawn at their team’s locations. Sword Capture: Similar to Team Death Match, this game mode introduces a scoring system based on capturing the enemy team’s sword and bringing it to their team’s sword table. The team with the most points at the end of the match wins. Players must defend their own sword while attempting to capture the enemy team’s sword. The game boasts breathtaking visuals, interesting gameplay effects, and stylized game modes, encouraging players to engage in winning streaks and experience an energetic and thrilling gaming experience. Players can compete with friends and others, enhancing the competitive spirit of “DO OR DIE – Hunt To Survive” Overall, the game seems to offer a balanced mix of fast-paced action, strategic gameplay, and teamwork, making it an exciting prospect for players seeking an adrenaline-fueled multiplayer shooter experience. No In-game Purchases and Micro Transactions. Follow us on Discord:

rows.name: Etherion Online
rows.short_description: Gear up! Become a prestige master in weapons or master a skill - join thousands of other players in this massive 2D adventure!
rows.description_html: Gear up! Obtain secret items or master a skill - and join thousands of other players in this massive 2D adventure! Etherion Online RPG is a modern-2D action MMORPG which takes place on a newly inhabited planet called Etherion which features scarce resources and a beautiful agrestic architecture. Purchase a weapon, level it up by using it on monsters or other players, and prestige it for rewards! Capture bases with a clan or create your own and attempt to take over the land of Etherion! If you're more of a lone-wolf player - venture off and defeat bosses for extremely rare items or become the solidified as the best duelist in the game at Eden Spar. All weapons in Etherion feature attachments, levels, and reward skins for prestiging - which makes every gun unique in its own way. Complete the unique battle pass which releases every 90 days with exclusive, themed, and limited content! Create your own personal character with our custom character creation system features customizable heads, eyebrows, mouths, eyes, beards, and more! Create your Character Etherion Online RPG features a FREE customization system which utilizes tons of different assets for hair, eyebrows, eyes, beards, mouths, and a variety of colors. There are currently over a million different combinations. If you want to create your own CUSTOM outfit then purchase an upload ticket from the store and find the outfit templates on our Discord! Skills Etherion currently features skills such as weaponry, health, mining, and smithing - but we are working on woodcutting, fishing, firemaking, cooking, bounty hunting, crafting, and much more! Skills also feature a secret pet for each skill - they are extremely rare! Open-World PvP & PvM On Etherion you can battle against entire clans, individual players in a spar match, or go defeat rare bosses for their super-rare items / weapons and trophies. You choose your own path! Collecting In the world of Etherion, there are many different secret items, rewards, and collectibles. Sometimes you’ll have to find them, You can dig for them, or get lucky by defeating something and have them rewarded! From secret pets to weapons, to expensive items and trophies, there’s a lot in store for those who enjoy collecting novelty items.

rows.name: NOX: Chapter 1
rows.short_description: NOX: Chapter 1 is a first-person puzzle game, where the player has to make use of gravity changes, gravity shifts and portals to explore the dreams and nightmares of a child. All this, in a world inspired by the work of Escher.
rows.description_html: NOX: Chapter 1 is a puzzle game, where we play the role of Gabi, an 11-year-old boy/girl who suffers from night terrors and sleep paralysis. In order to escape from their nightmares, you will have to go deep into their traumas and discover the intricate puzzle that is their life. FEATURES Paradoxial Spaces NOX has a series of non-Euclidean spaces, which the player must use to solve different logic puzzles. Everchanging Gravity Gabi's nightmares are inspired by the work of Escher, The Artist creates space made up of doors that act as portals, curves and ramps that will allow you to make gravity changes through space. Projections In the dreams you will find different drawings made by Gabi, some of them will help you to project new ways to escape from their nightmare.

rows.name: Skeletery
rows.short_description: Living as ordinary skeleton is hard - you are dead, but now you need to defend your cemetery against evil humans.
rows.description_html: Join Our Community About the Game Living as ordinary skeleton is hard - you are dead, but now you need to defend your cemetery against evil humans. Features Unconventional setting of being a good skeleton, trying to live the undead life in your cemetery. Attack with weapons! Block with shield! Roll with style! Collect bones ! Buy buildings ! Get buffs ! Doot ! Dark fantasy RPG, with light touch on story and heavy focus on melee combat and base building. Complex fighting, where success is achieved by a careful balance between attacks, blocks and movement. Base building in Skeletery unlocks powerful buffs that will increase your chances to survive waves of humans. A single-player game with levels progression, where each level represents a unique cemetery that attracts new types of enemies.

rows.name: Those Who Crawl
rows.short_description: Escape an ever-shrinking cave tunnel in this tense spelunking horror. As the stone walls transform into flesh, you'll face perilous claustrophobic spaces, flooded passages, and twisted inhuman creatures.
rows.description_html: ​As you progressed through the cave tunnels, they slowly tightened until you could not even stand. Now, as you crawl, you wonder if you are not alone in the darkness. Those Who Crawl is a tense horror game about crawling and climbing through cave tunnels. Each hand is controlled individually with a unique crawling and climbing system. The walls are closing in. As you progress, the stone walls become flesh and bone. The water in flooded tunnels is now blood red. This would be a horrible place to die. Now in the darkness, you hear something moving ... something with many legs. Cut the flesh. Utilize sharpened bone knives to cut away at the sinue and flesh that blocks your path. Stab them into the walls to make improvised handholds. Be careful, however, as the fragile bone will break after several uses, leaving you without a lifeline. Things are moving in the dark. Creatures lurk deep within the tunnels. They are bigger than you and faster. You can't fight back. Your best bet is to run - or rather desperately crawl. You could try using your knives, but would that even work against these monsters?

rows.name: A Familiar World
rows.short_description: Solve jigsaw puzzles to unlock exciting scenes. Discover the mysterious circumstances that led nine women to leave their world and run towards a new life.
rows.description_html: A Familiar World gives the usual jigsaw puzzle genre a different spin. Not only does it feature good-looking models in exciting environments and situations, but it also offers a story element that you unlock by completing puzzles. You can do each puzzle in five different difficulties ranging from surprisingly easy to frustratingly impossible. People who seek a challenge can enjoy this game just as much as those that want to lay back and do some simple jigsaw puzzles. The game plays in and around a castle in a post-apocalyptic world. A long and brutal war left only a few strong men alive. Each settled down in their own part of the world. Those men quickly became the center point of small functioning societies comprised of the remaining females. A Familiar World tells the story of nine women, how they found each other, and how they eventually managed to flee their cruel reality. The story element of this game that can be unlocked by completing puzzles works as a Prologue of a visual novel, A Foreign World . The main story will talk about the struggles those nine women face in this new world they flee to. Can you help them?

rows.name: Heroic City
rows.short_description: A Party MMO with real-world impact. Hang out with your friends and play dozens of action-packed multiplayer games. Team up and unlock impact items to be moved into real world impact such as planted trees and carbon removed from the atmosphere!
rows.description_html: Heroic City is a casual game packed with tons of fun, tens of games, millions of action, and a place for you and all your friends! Hop in to Heroic City and visit the art gallery, drop in and out of speedy and fun games, swag up your character and do good while you're at it! By completing missions and playing games you'll get impact items which you can then hatch and send them out to the real world to plant trees, remove plastic waste from oceans and offset carbon from the atmosphere! The choice is yours - the community together decides which issues we focus on. Be bold, be Heroic! Every tree you plant in Heroic City will be planted to the real world by our partner Ecologi.

rows.name: Eden Eternal-聖境伝説
rows.short_description: The return of classic MMORPG ! Global Direct Operations!Rich gameplays and multiple updates. Ride adorable alpaca and start your adventure with players worldwide!
rows.description_html: The return of worldwide classic MMORPG ! Global Direct Operations! Unite adventurous spirits, ride adorable alpaca, and join players all over the world to create your own journey memories. Sword and Magic will guide you as you explore the world of Eden. Create your own legend and become the Eternal One! 【Explore the Broad World of Eden】 Enter the fanstasitc world with vast and beautiful land. From volcano to glacier, plain to Dark Swamp, experience abandant and unique geography and climatic environments. Step over all mountains to move toward the distance. 【Switch Class Without Restriction】 Freely switch your class according to the environment and the team you stay. Experience the joy of each class and the meaning of adventure. With new class balance and huge optimization, players can find out their own orientations(?) and styles. 【Accompanied by Adorable Alpaca】 These cute and fluffy alpacas love to carry their owner around the Central Continent. Those fluffy partners are must-have mounts for each adventurer during the journey. 【New Continent with Various Races】 Eden is a vast world with various races. it is composed of 5 different continents, nurturing many unique creatures: Anura from southeast forest, Zumi from desert realm, Ursun from mountains. There are also Torturra, Drakin, Ogres, Tuskar, etc. Are you ready to explore the fascinating culture of each race? 【Customize Dyeing】 Flexible dyeing system allows you to become the unique one in the world of Eden. We provide renewed hairstyle and facial expression for character creation, and also add more than double hair, skin, and pupil colors! Enjoy the classic charm of MMORPG with multiple combinations!

rows.name: Iragon: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue to an Erotic RPG Game with a story about magical girls, elves, and a bisexual sorceress.
rows.description_html: ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST About the Game About the Game Iragon: Prologue is the beginning of a story-driven adventure RPG that draws inspiration from anime series like Fullmetal Alchemist, Attack on Titan, and Berserk. It is set in a fantasy world filled with monstrous creatures and merciless soldiers as well as beautiful women who are eager to show you a good time and rock your world. In this prologue, you play as the aspiring knight Darick, thrown into the middle of a war between two nations by a mysterious young woman in need of his help. Iragon: Prologue allows you to experience living out a high fantasy adventure where you are in control of your destiny! It is best experienced in VR, but we've dedicated an equal amount of care and time to make sure that playing without a VR headset packs just as much of a punch. Story You play as Darick, a poor kid from a small village, who won't let anything stand in the way of his dream of becoming a knight and a hero. Everything changes when you meet a young woman who gets ambushed by soldiers of the Empire. You must learn to use your magic and journey into a dangerous world on your quest to bring her home safe. Along the way, you will battle enemy soldiers, undead skeletons, and perhaps cross paths with seductive creatures of the frozen land while you unlock new erotic adventures. Be the hero, live the story, and go on the adventure of a lifetime while immersing yourself fully in the world of Iragon: Prologue. The story is delivered with motion-captured animations and full voice acting from a professional cast. For those who prefer to just get on with slaying witches and laying bitches, we have also made all the cutscenes and interactions skippable. Features Whether you play in VR or not, you can expect us to deliver: A beautiful love interest Interactive experiences with your love interest Different outfits for the love interest Voice acting Motion captured animations A dynamic combat system that features both magic and melee Destructible environments A dialogue choice system that influences the response you get Gameplay This is not just a story with pretty girls. It's an adventure! Fight your way through tough enemies, master the elements with your magic, collect loot, upgrade your powers, go on quests, interact with whoever catches your eye. Immerse yourself fully in the world, the characters, and the story of a full-fledged fantasy adventure RPG.

rows.name: Syren and Friends Roast the Dev
rows.short_description: Join Syren and friends as they roast the dev for failing to be good at anything! Enjoy the cute and curvy cast as they talk about things only a geriatric millennial would understand.
rows.description_html: Join Syren and friends as they roast the dev for failing to be good at anything! The poor dev has tried over and over, but has been unsuccessful at completing any R18 projects lately. Syren, Aoi and Lola expose the slacker in this hard-hitting expose! Syren and Friends Roast the Dev is a short comedic diversion not too dissimilar from a heavily railroaded kinetic novel that lacks momentum. Enjoy the cute and curvy cast as they talk about things only a geriatric millennial would understand. Not quite a game, not quite a visual novel. This software has a few rare and sporadic interactive elements that do not impact the overall narrative. Assuming there was a narrative, to begin with. It does have a few neato hidden object puzzles to solve, a few painful unskippable videos, and some semi-lewd load screens if you are into that sort of thing. All characters are 18 years or older.

rows.name: Ballads and Romances
rows.short_description: Investigate the origins of the literary debut of Adam Mickiewicz, a XIX century-famous Polish poet. In an immersive visual novel, discover the secret of his love, friendship, and artistic inspirations!
rows.description_html: The year is 1822. Adam Mickiewicz is preparing to publish his literary debut. In a moment, the world will know his groundbreaking Ballads & romances. Go with the poet on a journey through his memories and find out what contributed to the creation of such ballads as Świteź, Primrose, or Romanticism. During the game, you will learn interesting facts from the life of Adam Mickiewicz, and you will experience events together with the poet, the echoes of which live in his works! The game is available in Polish and English, as well as in color and black and white.

rows.name: The Cenozoic Era
rows.short_description: The Cenozoic Era is a realistic animal survival game taking place during the rise of mammals, take control of a variety of animals and fight to survive among other players to reach the top of the food chain. Death, Destruction, Survival, Scavenge, Nature, Thrive, Conquer, Hunt. The Cenozoic Era
rows.description_html: The Cenozoic Era : Survive, Adapt, Conquer Step into a breathtaking open world where survival is your only goal. In The Cenozoic Era , control a creature from the past, fight for your life, and uncover the secrets of an untamed, ever-changing world. Whether you're a predator or prey, your journey will be uniquely yours. Explore vast landscapes—from rocky mountains to serene lakes and the endless sky. Customize your creature’s appearance, shape your survival story, and face the brutal realities of nature. With every decision, your survival is at risk—death means starting over or choosing a new animal to control. Online Survival, Brutal Challenges Join players in an intense multiplayer survival experience. As a predator, master the hunt and learn to outwit other players, or scavenge from the remains of fallen animals—but beware, danger is everywhere. Trust no one; every encounter could be your last. Dynamic Seasons and Temperature Prepare for seasonal challenges: survive freezing winters, scorch under summer heatwaves, and manage your creature’s body temperature to avoid hypothermia or exhaustion. Strategic planning is key to thriving in this ever-changing environment. Game Modes Sandbox : Practice, fight, and explore without the fear of permanent death. Perfect for learning the ropes and meeting other players. Survival : Dive into the true test of endurance—grow from a young animal to a formidable survivor. Forge your own story, hunt, and face other players as you fight for dominance. Play Styles We offer a range of play styles, from realism immersion all the way to pink cougars, we have all play styles covered and customizable. Servers can be fully customized to fit any play style they wish and you the player have the choice on what you want! Check the servers configuration and make sure it fits the play style you want before joining. Character Features Breeding and Breeding Mutations Skin Customization and Color Packs Skill Tree System Seamless character growth Events Leaderboard and rewards Breeding competitions Holiday Events Rare unlocks (Skins) World & Gameplay Features Dynamic Seasons (Spring, Summer, Fall & Winter) Dynamic Weather (Rain, Thunderstorms, Snow etc.) Realistic immersive gameplay modes Snow tracks AI Creatures (Rabbits, Fish etc.) Seasonal Food I.E (Deer eating bark during Winter) Other Features Mod Support and Steam Workshop Full Server customization with user assigned roles & colors Game & Server Support: contact@thecenozoicera.com So what are you waiting for? Install and play today completely FREE!

rows.name: Project: SnowBound©
rows.short_description: A Hybrid-MMO made in a futuristic setting, where you can race or catch big air with your customized gear, and with your friends!
rows.description_html: Welcome, you are in for one of the craziest rides of your life with Imysoo Games newest release: Project SnowBound© ! We are currently in Alpha v0.0.3G, and this will be the Early Access version available for everyone to participate. *This game is made by a (solo) 1-man developer team* Project: SnowBound is a H-MMO , or hybrid massively multiplayer game set in a future after humans have colonized their local universe and are expanding not only for new science & technologies. But also for extreme sports! You are a up and coming potential prospect, aiming to become one of the top of the 'High Heaven' circuit players. With nothing but a busted up snowboard, and the prowess of a baby lamb, can you climb your way to the top? Using a top-down unique systems, players will be spawned into an overworld , and from there, they can participate in free-for-all races (FFA RACE) or gain some serious altitude with the big air (BIG AIR) game-modes! Or if you're feeling more homely, you can always go and relax in your inn room, customize your furniture and soak the great mountain air in . Preseason Alpha You can race, level-up, earn currency and bragging rights against your friends and the rest of the server. Purchase & Collect beautiful, exotic, and colorful board wrappers ! You may also pay rent ( in-game currency ) to keep an inn room, which is completely customizable ! You may purchase furniture in order to decorate yourself, or just have somewhere to hang up your trophies! Explore High-Heaven's Inn Get yourself an amazing board wrapper at Board Hall:A Wrap yourself up out there, it can get chilly! Shop XippWear!

rows.name: Sushi Clicker
rows.short_description: A clicker game revolving around Sushi! Create sushi, Sell sushi and buy upgrades in an endless cycle to continue creating infinite sushi to become the ultimate sushi chef!
rows.description_html: Imagine all your favorite clicker games, but made by a 20-year-old that has no idea what he's doing. Welcome to Sushi Clicker! Sushi Clicker is a typical clicker game where the player clicks on an icon in order to create sushi! Players can then buy upgrades through the shop in order to help them continue making more sushi! Create Sushi and spend them in the shop to unleash your amazing sushi-making abilities! Technically infinite upgrades (although the store will break at some point) ✓ 0 achievements, but I'm working on it ✓ Complete with a save game feature! ✓ Japanese-inspired lo-fi music ✓ Comes with a music slider for you to control the volume ✓ Solo Indie game! ✓

rows.name: Sands
rows.short_description: 'The sands have no pity.' The inhabitants of Zetta-115 often say that. The same they instill in their children from an early age. And this is what they whisper about, sitting in their dilapidated shacks, waiting for the impending storm...
rows.description_html: Key Features: A short story driven adventure about a survivor in the middle of desert planet. Beautiful graphics that convey the atmosphere of the game. A variety of puzzles, encounters with dangerous enemies and fascinating investigation. Find out what happened to the planet after the global catastrophe!

rows.name: Project Sphinx
rows.short_description: In this first-person puzzle-solving game, you're a robot with a mission on a space station. And like any great robot, you're going to have to explore, teleport and ricochet your way around the base, in which each room and corridor is a puzzle to solve.
rows.description_html: Project Sphinx is a first person puzzle platformer, in which you make your way through a space station by teleporting. In Project Sphinx, you take the role of a robot sent to a seemingly abandoned space station by a corporation. Your mission is to retrieve crucial data left somewhere on the station's premises. Unfortunately, as is often the case with derelict facilities in the middle of the galaxy - it's in a state of absolute mess and chaos. You're going to have to make your way through destroyed halls, broken down stairways and rooms with seemingly no way out. But you're not just any robot. You're a unit equipped with PAWS - the Portable Arm-mounted Wormhole Slinger (name not approved by the Galactic Corporations Committee). This highly advanced piece of future-tech will let you turn your robot hand into a ball, shoot it, and teleport to it after it bounces off of any solid surface! No, this is not a lie. This is what the future looks like. Using your teleportation power along with your puzzle-solving and platform-jumping skills, there's no way you won't be able to complete your mission. Right? RIGHT? Well, only one way to find out! FEATURES: - Teleport to explore and progress Teleportation is the main means of traversal in the game and it is FUN! You're going to be using your PAWS to jump through the portals you create in order to fulfill your mission. You can teleport almost anywhere, but the blue pools of liquid look pretty dodgy - don't teleport into those, please. - Fast paced traversal Use your skills and bounce around FAST! You can use your robot legs to walk around, sure. But you're a robot with a hand that shoots teleportation portals. Now that sounds like something that could make you go quicker. That's what every robot learns at the 'How to go fast, have fun and not lose too many screws' course in primary school, anyway. It's common robot knowledge. - Mind (and coil) bending puzzles Think the mission will be a walk in the park? Don't worry your little robot head, it definitely will not. You'll have to use every bit of your computing skills to make your way through the station. Rooms will be PUZZLES, corridors will be mazes and your wits will be what sets you apart from other robots on the block. - The ricochet mechanic Teleporting is cool, but there's a trick for it to work. To be able to do it, you have to RICOCHET off of a wall, or any other solid surface, first. Sounds complicated? It's not. Sounds exciting? You bet it is! Thanks to that, you'll be able to gain momentum and speed needed to solve puzzles, move faster and - as an added bonus - look like the coolest robot ever.

rows.name: Pan'orama: Prologue
rows.short_description: Pan'orama is a relaxing and soothing puzzle simulation game in which you create amazing landscapes using different types of tiles, but most of all by discovering the connections between them and finding unique combinations.
rows.description_html: CHECK OUT THE FULL GAME AND ADD IT TO YOUR WISHLIST! About the Game Pan’orama is a tile-placing puzzle game of creating beautiful, mellow landscapes, that calms your mind and lets your imagination run free. In Pan’orama, your goal is to score as many points as possible by connecting pieces of land with each other to create a larger environment. You gather points by placing the colorful tiles to create ever-evolving biomes, placing structures and completing quests, which require you to think ahead and plan accordingly. FEATURES: Sculpt your own world Freedom to create is what drives Pan’orama’s gameplay. Shape your own little world out of fields, forests, meadows and structures. Place tiles of the same kind next to each other to transform the terrain into breathtaking vistas! Complete quests and earn rewards Quests of different shapes and sizes will often pop up, requiring you to place specific tiles in specific places. Placing them in the perfect spot and fulfilling their conditions will net you extra points, as all of your previously placed tiles count towards the quest goals. You’ll have to think tactically to get the most out of them! Discover and build structures Well placed tiles will get you points, and after reaching a certain threshold, you’ll be able to pick one of 3 boosters with structures. These will grant you extra tiles and a structure with a special power (to get even more points!). There are 48 structures in total and once you build them all, you get to place an epic Monument! Free your imagination Being creative and letting your imagination take over is what’s at the core of the game. Sculpt epic mountain ranges, fill lakes and meadows with water, create picturesque towns surrounded by plains and forests. In Pan’orama, nothing stops you from using your imagination to its fullest!

rows.name: The Test: Secrets of the Soul
rows.short_description: You will answer a series of questions that will reveal things from deep within. Some will be uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and are you SURE you want the answers you seek? For it is time to unlock 'Secrets of the Soul...'
rows.description_html: (This game, as well as many others in our bundle, is FANTASTIC for Youtubers & Streamers to create content and engage with their audience. This creates a unique experience for all parties involved, and players playing the game themselves can enjoy the solo experience tremendously all on their own as well!) The Test: Secrets of the Soul The Test Trilogy & Test Series is a social experiment that can be classified as an atmospheric, psychological-simulation with horror elements. Dive into your own psyche and get answers to questions you've kept hidden deep, down inside. Unlock your mind in ways never done before and experience new found knowledge simply by taking, ' The Test .' You will answer a series of questions that will reveal things from deep within. These questions may make you uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek? For it is time to unlock The Secrets of the Soul... Features: Short and sweet. The only game series of its kind. Very psychological & atmospheric. Sit back, relax, and answer deep questions to reveal hidden truths. Super affordable for a unique experience. (Free) Player / Developer interaction. (Players who comment may have their name selected to be characters in future episodes of our new Fateweaver series which can now be found on Steam. All players who wish to be, will be added to the credits of 'Chasing Demons' as a token of our appreciation for your support.)

rows.name: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind - Daily Demo
rows.short_description: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind - Daily Demo is a new, procedurally generated challenge, designed to rack the strongest minds…DAILY! So grab your sword, embark on this brain-teasing roguelike adventure, explore dangerous dungeons, and prepare for the full game! Do you have what it takes to be the GOAT?!
rows.description_html: WISHLIST NOW JOIN OUR COMMUNITY! About the Game The Desktop Dungeons: Rewind - Daily Demo delivers a slice of the award-winning Desktop Dungeons puzzle roguelike challenge to everyone, every single day! Dive into the unique class and dungeon stew that’s on today’s menu and whet your appetite for the full game, one daily dungeon bite at a time. You’ll need to explore, strategize, test your skills, plan your approach to heal your hero, and obliterate bloodthirsty enemies to emerge victorious with a hoard of treasure. DAILY Challenge - This demo will refresh with a new dungeon and throw a new class at you every day. That’s right! Every single day you’ll get a chance to get rich… or die trying! DAILY Rewind - Eating dirt already? Lay down your burdens and try again (you only get one shot so do not miss your chance to blow!) DAILY Demo Leaderboard - Achieve eternal glory and rise to the top of the daily leaderboard, compare your results, and prove to your friends that you are the ultimate dungeon master! DAILY Healing by Exploring - Reveal hidden terrain to regain health and mana. But plan your route carefully or you’ll have nothing left to face the final enemy! Don't let your guard down, because one wrong move could be your last. The choice is yours - will you become a legendary dungeon crawler, or fall to the wayside?

rows.name: Towards the Unknown
rows.short_description: Dive into the Rift and discover the various mysteries it holds. Between mystical creatures and legendary artifacts, you will have to be strategic on this expedition. Die, pass the torch to another explorer and head into the unknown.
rows.description_html: In Towards The Unknown, dive into the Rift and discover the various mysteries it holds. But beware, something strange emanates from the depths. From mystical creatures to legendary artefacts, you'll need to be brave and strategic on this expedition. Die, pass the torch to another explorer and head into the unknown. Enter the Absolute Zero to collect as many resources as possible and discover unique flora and fauna. rows.name: Koltera
rows.short_description: Idle creature-collector, where you mine, train, breed, explore and more with your creatures. Discover all there is in the world of Koltera.
rows.description_html: In this Creature-Collecting Idler, Koltera , you Mine and Train with creatures. As your creatures grow, they will grow stronger furthering their ability to help you. Discover upgrades that will further this output and make things easier. As your operation grows, so will your ability to discover new creatures and trade with traders. Koltera offers 41 unique creatures, each with 11 augmented versions. That's 450+ creatures to collect! Collect over 450+ creatures (41 unique & 11 augmented versions of each) Upgrade from over 18+ different upgradable effects Accumulate coins from your idle mining operation and continue to increase it's output through upgrades and other mechanics Balance and tinker with different creatures, each with their own unique set of genetics, and species base stats Breed and min-max the output of your creatures, by trying to create a perfect one Trade with the traders, in order to discover new species, with rarer creatures having increasingly harder requirements Create a garden which plays like a typical incremental game, in order to summon legendaries Earn offline progress (un-capped) while you are away. You will earn coins and lumin when you come back.

rows.name: The Thief, the Witch, the Toad, and the Mushroom.
rows.short_description: A fable from your childhood. Don't you remember it?
rows.description_html: You're curled up in front of the fire reading a folk tale on a cold winter's night. Something about it seems so familiar. Have you read this before? Explore a cosy and mysterious fantasy universe inspired by fairy tales. The old kind of fairy tales, strange and wild, before the edges were sanded off. Warm and comforting, but with parts you don't quite understand, and you don't know if you want to understand. Befriend strange and wonderful folks. Navigate 4 main routes through the game as you grow closer to the main characters. Align yourself with G-d, Death, or the Devil. Choose your godparent and your destiny. Uncover secrets and mysteries. Something strange haunts this book. What was that shape? At the corner of your vision? Multiple endings. So, so many endings. I cannot be stopped.

rows.name: Agent Team Simulator
rows.short_description: Build a team of Elite Secret Agents, and send them on dangerous missions around the globe.
rows.description_html: CONGRATULATIONS! You have been selected to be the newest Captain of Agent Inc. Welcome aboard. With the World in disarray, and chaos in every corner, can you restore order? Key Game Features Assemble your Agents Elite-level personnel are the heart of your organisation, and it's your responsibility to build a squad full of them. You'll start with just a single Agent, but over time, you will scout more, and the size of your team will grow, from one to hundreds! No two Agents are alike, each has their own unique appearance, backstory, origin, and stats, making every new addition special. Fight Crime Across the Globe From America to Australia, Japan to Costa Rica, there is a job for your Team almost anywhere you can imagine! Choose your Agents wisely, as their stats will determine how suited they are to that Mission. It's all about strategy! Improve your Geography Knowledge With the hugely diverse Agent backgrounds, as well as Mission locations that span all 7 continents, your understanding of the different regions of the world will be expanded in no time! Plus, with Quizzes on the Capitals and Flags of the Countries of the game, you can further bolster your geographic proficiency. (and earn some in-game money in the process). Get Rewarded for Mission Success After the completion of a triumphant expedition, your Agents will return with prizes in the form of 'Credits' and 'Gems', these can be used to Scout for brand new agents, and to purchase Items that will aid future Missions. Also, frequent mission success will help you towards unlocking the 100 Steam achievements! Other Game Features Daily Missions Gacha Mechanics Fun Minigames 100 Achievements Loyalty Bonuses And more There's no time to waste Captain! Download 'Agent Team Simulator' today!

rows.name: Dawn of Griseo
rows.short_description: A medium-length visual novel set in a fantasy world where magic exists. The encounter between a boy living in a rural farming village and a girl who is a dark wizard leads to the revelation of truths that were never meant to be revealed.
rows.description_html: A medium-length visual novel set in a fantasy world where magic exists. Summary . Tino, a boy living in a rural farming village, one day meets Silvia, a girl who is a dark wizard, who had collapsed from hunger. The boy, who has a yearning for magic, decides to go with the girl. Their little adventure leads to encounters between people who were never meant to meet, intersections of destinies that were never meant to intersect, and the revelation of truths that were never meant to be revealed. Why did the Devil Hunt succeed? What on earth are the 'shadows' that suddenly appeared several years ago? This is a story of untying the threads of complex relationships and getting to the truth. Other Characteristics - It take 4-6 hours to play this game. - This game has 2 endings. - The theme song was composed by Sapporo Momoko. Please watch the movie at the top of this page. Main Characters

rows.name: Iso Racer
rows.short_description: Iso Racer is a top-down multiplayer racing game focusing on realistic driving physics combined with drifting. It contains a variety of tracks, cars and the ability to personalize vehicles. It's a great experience for casual and hardcore racing fans.
rows.description_html: In Iso Racer, players take control of a variety of racing cars and compete in a range of events across different tracks. The game features multiplayer mode, allowing players to compete against AI or other players online. The physics of the game are also realistic combined with drifting to make the game more interesting. Players have the ability to customize their vehicles and improve their performance. Drifting Style! The beginning of the game is simple, it looks like a typical top-down racing game, but don't let that fool you! You need to properly cut your speed before the corners in order to pass them with a perfect drift! Car damage is only visual Iso Racer is a racing game developed and published by Pogo Concepts. The game features top-down perspective and is heavily inspired by classic racing games, while still offering modern features such as online multiplayer. We also care about interaction between players, which is why, among other things, we decided to have chat in the form of clouds above the vehicles, and we plan to add more types of competition in the future, beyond the standard races during the same game. Overall, Iso Racing offers a fun and challenging racing experience that is both nostalgic and modern. Its emphasis on strategy and customization sets it apart from other arcade-style racing games, and its online multiplayer mode offers endless replayability for those looking to compete against other players around the world.

rows.name: Parsec
rows.short_description: In Parsec you pilot a spaceship through a field of asteroids trying to destroy as many as possible before they destroy you. You have three different weapons that can be picked up around the world. Health can also be picked up from random spawns and sometimes dropped by asteroids.
rows.description_html: In Parsec you pilot a spaceship through a field of asteroids trying to destroy as many as possible before they destroy you. You have three different weapons that can be picked up around the world, their spawning is random. Health can also be picked up from random spawns and sometimes dropped by asteroids. WEAPONS Blaster Your starting weapon is the Blaster, it has a fairly lackluster firerate but can destroy any asteroid in four shots or less. Minigun The Minigun is exactly what the name implies, a Many-Gun! It has a very fast firerate and only slightly less damage than the blaster, making it a much more effective weapon. Sniper The Sniper Laser has extremely high damage allowing it to destroy any asteroid in a single shot. It can even penetrate multiple with a single shot, but beware of its very low firerate. HAZARDS Small Asteroid Typically breaking off of a passing comet, small asteroids may not look like much but they can pick up incredible speed and quickly destroy any spaceship in their path and push other asteroids very far. They deal 25 damage if stationary but are likely to do vastly more at speed. Medium Asteroid Floating peacefully through space at a leisurely pace, medium asteroids are far less volatile than small ones. They deal 50 damage, while being more than small asteroids they are far less likely to slam into you at a high speed. Large Asteroid Sitting almost stationary, large asteroids are extremely dangerous if you bump into them but incredibly easy to hit and hard not to avoid. They deal 75 damage. Debris When hit asteroids can break into multiple smaller pieces. While the clutter may be annoying they are largely harmless. They deal 25 damage. Health You have 150 health, each 50 is represented by a full blue square in the bottom left of the GUI. Each size of asteroid deals varying levels of damage and you can replenish 50 with a health pickup, represented by a grey square with '+50' on it. Score Multiplier The score multiplier is a special pickup that doubles the points you receive from any asteroids you destroy while it is active. It is represented by a grey square with '2x' on it and you know it's active when '2x' is over your score. Your high score saves between games, see how high you can get!

Explore Molly Eleonor's nightmares, find the truth and, more importantly, do not die. Enjoy this new and scary adventure, you won't sleep again.

Explore Molly Eleonor's nightmares, find the truth and, more importantly, do not die. Enjoy this new and scary adventure, you won't sleep again. Welcome to your new... and last adventure Play as Eleonor, a lonely little girl, in a terrifying first-person adventure and try to survive while escaping from... her dreams?? Nightmares all around every corner This horror game is full of tense moments, scary jumpscares, and nightmare scenarios... Each level is unique, you will have to look for keys, watch your steps, or even take costumes to go unnoticed. I think that... I'm not alone?!? Someone is watching, don't be scared. rows.name: Lobby Cam by Bryn Oh
rows.short_description: An immersive short story walking simulator. Find diary pages to uncover the narrative behind a man who discovers a new channel on his TV. A melancholy story about the grey etiquette of technology.
rows.description_html: An eccentric man discovers an unlikely channel on his TV. Find his torn up diary pages to piece together the story. This is a immersive short story that is part of a larger narrative created by the artist Bryn Oh over the last decade. The whole story spans 120 years and most chapters reside in virtual worlds. Bryn is learning unreal engine in order to (slowly) bring the full narrative to a game platform. With special thanks to the Canada Council for the Arts for their generous support in helping to achieve this dream. In this experience you will walk the environment in first person clicking on diary pages you find strewn upon the landscape. The pages will be stored in a journal which you can refer to in order to understand the full narrative. With each page you find more of the narrative is revealed.

rows.name: Howl of Iron
rows.short_description: Howl of Iron is a 3rd Person Action Adventure game blending HUNT & COMBAT. Stalk on your unaware enemies, fight in open combat and explore the steampunk city of Steamfall.
rows.description_html: Tonight we hunt Howl of Iron is a 3rd Person Action Adventure title with a focus of hunting your enemies. The city offers several paths and heights to move and attack. Travel through the streets of steamfall your way stalking the enemies that scatter the streets and rooftops of the buildings, fighting them melee, avoiding their powerful shots to avoid being defeated, using your combos to finish them off. Death from above Explore back-to back each section to find the patrols’ weak spots. Climb buildings to attack from above and escape unfavorable encounters. Execute unaware enemies. combine light and heavy slashes for greater effect while you dash through their formation. Make them fear you Use your thundering howl to make your adversaries lose their composure, opening them for a quick finishing blow. This game is a university project made thanks to the combined efforts of U-tad students from the Master of Art, Design, Programming and Production.

rows.name: Battlemon
rows.short_description: Battlemon is an action-fighting game where you take control of small, cute character and battle in various different arenas. There are many vibrant and powerful different characters to choose from.
rows.description_html: Cute, chaotic, and competitive — Battlemon lets you and your friends face off with quirky creatures in dynamic arena battles. Step into the world of Battlemon , a fast-paced local multiplayer fighting game where quirky creatures clash in vibrant arenas. Whether you’re going head-to-head with a friend or testing your skills in challenging events, every fight is a chance to discover new strategies and unleash the true power of your favorite Battlemon. Battlemon blends party-game fun with competitive fighting depth , making it perfect for both casual players and those who love finding clever combos. With its charming art style, evolving roster, and easy pick-up-and-play design, it’s a game that keeps surprising you every match. Key Features  Real-Time Arena Battles Engage in vibrant, head-to-head brawls. Battles are handled in real time, so stay sharp and react quickly! Huge and Growing Cast of Characters Choose from a quirky line-up: Dunse, Abble, Blink, Pelage —and more are frequently added via updates. Varied Modes & Events Dive into more than just versus battles—test your skills in raids, boss fights, and other engaging event formats. Free to Play Jump in without paying a penny. Extras like early access characters can be accessed via optional DLCs. Couch-PvP Fun Perfect for casual local multiplayer sessions—just grab a controller, sit side by side, and duke it out. Why It Stands Out Charming Visuals Meet Competitive Depth Cute creature fighters bring a whimsical aesthetic, while unique movesets ensure strategic battles. Inclusive, Local Party Play No online connection needed—perfect for living room fun with friends or siblings. Constant Evolution A continuously expanding roster and event systems mean there's always something new to discover.

rows.name: I Won't Forget Hue
rows.short_description: Disorganized and alone, a woman finds herself crafting new glasses in order to look at her own home with different shaded views. I won’t forget Hue is a psychedelic thriller experience. You’ll go searching for new lenses, try to figure out what is happening to her home and why she is all alone.
rows.description_html: Mystery of the multi-coloured glasses: I Won’t Forget Hue is a first-person, psychedelic thriller game. Disorganized and alone, a woman finds herself crafting new glasses in order to view her own home through a different lens. Throughout the home, you will go searching for new and different coloured lenses, while the house seems to be alive and ever-changing around you. You have the ability to craft new glasses, making you able to see even more of the seemingly multi-coloured house. During your journey through the house, you will hear many noises that seem impossible to explain. But these noises have a cause, only you can’t see them, yet. But once you see them using the correct glasses, they will see you too. Chasing you down the hallways, not letting you have any rest in this altering house. Gameplay: In I Won’t Forget Hue, you will be walking around the narrow hallways and rooms of a dark, old house. But while you explore this mansion, you find that you might not be alone. Different glasses cause the house around you to change. Once the evil finds you looking around, it will chase you all over. You must find a way to use the colours to your advantage, to find new parts and figure out what how to hide from the evil. All while you try to figure out what happened to the rest of your family. But beware as the game progresses, the evil increases. Play alone in this 3D single player game. Find and use the coloured lenses and torn painting pieces. Switch between the different coloured lenses on your glasses to see new parts of the mansion, but also see the evil that hides within it. Stay out of sight when in colour, and find ways to hide from the enemies. Try different types of strategies to discover and progress. Key Features: Living enemies: Enemies listen to your sounds and movements, and will chase you when seen. Psychedelic thriller: Experience colours which cause the surroundings around you to change. 3D horror adventure gaming experience Hide and Sneak: Sneak, hide and move around while staying out of the enemies grasp. Rediscovery: Walk through the same areas, but see and discover new changes every time. Collecting: Find all the torn painting pieces and coloured lenses throughout the mansion. I Won’t Forget Hue is being actively developed by a team of seventeen students. We need your feedback to make I Won’t Forget Hue the great game we want it to be for the players. Get in touch with us via the community Discord, social media or e-mail to tell us what you think and we *will* get back to you!

rows.name: Save the Earth
rows.short_description: Green world simulator. Build good nature strategy. Save the World sandbox game.
rows.description_html: You will try on a role of a saving planet fund. Get engaged with the activities which will affect the Earth’s future. Research, think, make your choice and see your results. Save our home and its inhabitants! Take part in saving our planet together with us! How to play: The player’s goal is to stabilize ecological situation on the whole planet on early stages. And then step by step restore and improve eco-situation of the Earth. In the end of your game you will get your statistics on how successful your mission was. Each step leads to different consequences, you have to make thoughtful actions and fast. Features: Study specifications of regions and their exact problems Track eco-situations of the Earth’s regions Integrate ecological projects Send volunteers for help Fight negative ecological aspects: poachers, trawlers, smugglers Overcome the devastating consequences of disasters Encounter new green technologies Education game about ecology. Play ecology world simulator Save the earth. It’s one of the excellent nature games. Eco-friendly app. Planet Earth and the solar system needs protection. In our world simulator you can rebuild the world and create a good Earth strategy of saving. In our nature and solar system games you can develop modern green projects. Build correct good Earth strategy and tactics to avoid climate smash. Find out more about ocean problems, water poisoning or Earth lighting. Disaster games might be very useful. Playing Save the Earth you can create your own world. Your strategy may either save the planet or smash the world. Play solar system games and learn more about world’s protection. Simulator games are a reflection of the real world. No one wants to destroy the Earth on purpose. But the biological system of the planet is changing. People need a plan to protect it. In our world simulator you’ll see what will happen if we don't change anything. Save the Earth is much more than just a planet simulation clicker. It contains ecological characteristics of real regions of our Terra. Play our strategy game and you’ll be able to make our planet a better place. Civilization and eco sphere need your protection. Saving our world in the strategy game will help to maintain our planet in reality but not only in strategy games. Playing the clicker you may not depend on the internet connection. Solving ecology problems in the world simulator you learn how to do it in the real world. Eco questions do worry our civilization not only in nature games. Take part in saving our planet together with us! We ourselves are in fact active preservationists of so part of the money we get from sales of the game we put to charity.

rows.name: VMVA - Virtual Museum for Virtual Art
rows.short_description: Welcome to Virtual Museum for Virtual Art! It is a freely accessible museum, which exclusively exhibits virtual art. The museum has five main rooms, with four of them following the ”white cube” format. In the main hall visitors can get orientations about the current exhibition.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Virtual Museum for Virtual Art! It is a freely accessible museum, which exclusively exhibits virtual art. Like in many video games, the visitor walks around the museum in a first person perspective using their mouse and keyboard. The museum has five main rooms, with four of them following the ”white cube” format. The fifth and biggest room is the main hall where visitors get orientations about the current exhibition. Although most video games and virtual worlds are inhabited by designed objects and textures, these tend to serve a secondary, decorative role. Often acting as scenery or props, the most common aesthetic experience of virtual art is of a peripheral nature. Whether or not something is regarded as an object of ’fine art’ or rather as a decorative object is a matter of perception. This difference in perception has much to do with the context in which the given artwork occurs. By mimicking the architectural style of a classical art museum, Virtual Museum for Virtual Art seeks to provide a platform for virtual artworks to be perceived and considered as fine art.

rows.name: Qiybz
rows.short_description: Qiybz is a cube-filled auto-platformer with randomized platforms and experimental music, respecting skill, precision and a good balance between cautious and reckless behaviour.
rows.description_html: Qiybz is a game where you control an automatically jumping cube with other randomized cubes being as platforms and / or enemies. The main goal is to achieve the largest true highscore possible, but beware! The higher the score, the higher the difficulty. The spawned cubes are randomized and there are over 20 different cube types that can be spawned, provided certain in-game conditions are met. With randomization also comes the so-called probability hierarchy, with some cubes being so rare that you might not see one even after ten thousand cubes. Familiarizing yourself with the cube types also gains an advantage over randomly jumping on cubes. The gaps between the cubes ensure that precision in landing on to the platforms is crucial. Enemy elimination is also important, as you will see if you try this game... Note that spontaneous change of character skin is not possible, and you must change the skin manually if you want it to change. The same goes for backgrounds. Based on player feedback this can be subject to change, and spontaneous change especially for backgrounds might become a feature in the future. Soundtracks can change based on in-game conditions, but not all soundtracks are available this way, and some must be activated manually if one wants to listen to them. Some important, additional information : The enemies start to spawn after a score of 5, where enemy cubes (the cubes with an 'L' character in them) must be destroyed by jumping on them a number of times in order to get lives. Lives act as a shield against enemy projectiles (for example, the blood cubes), and are also needed to transform score into currency (2 lives per exchange) by jumping on the gray cubes with a peculiar symbol in them. The currency can then be used in the shop to alter the game in some ways. A boss cube can be summoned when the player reaches a score of 10k, and bosses start to automatically spawn after a score of 20k (the higher the score, the harder the bosses that can spawn).

rows.name: A Summer in Our Hearts
rows.short_description: A slice of life VN about three very different young adults, from very different backgrounds, trying to put their best foot forward and find their own ways in life. Will a short summer, away in a foreign town in the middle of nowhere, enough to push your way towards happiness?
rows.description_html: A Summer in Our Hearts is a slice of life visual novel set to explore the life of three young adults, each from a very different background with very different personalities, and how they deal with their personal struggles. Each is trying to put their best foot forward and find their own way towards happiness. Help each other along the way, or stand by and watch as they go on their separate path. Create bonds that last for a lifetime, or walk away to build your own life. Will a short summer, away in a foreign town in the middle of nowhere, enough to push your way towards happiness?

rows.short_description: Outpath: First Journey is a prologue chapter of the main game, Outpath. An experimental clicker base building game. Craft, gather & manage resources, build your base and buy more islands to exploit and expand!

Taking Satisfactory, Minecraft, Forager and the gratifying gameplay loop of clicker/idle games as references, Outpath would be just that. Exploit your environment, craft, build and automate your base in this 3D first-person platformer! Gather. Craft. Build. Explore. Relax. No time limits , no pressure, play at your own pace and style . Gather, collect and manage resources. Craft useful items. Base building, automate everything. Buy islands to expand and exploit! Fishing. Level up skills and unlock new blueprints. Parkour movements. Play active or idle, you choose! Music reacts to your actions. Uncover the secrets of this styliced place.

rows.name: The Visitor
rows.short_description: In 'The Visitor' you will play as an author named Rachel. Your goal is to complete your book chapter by chapter before the deadline that is coming up. The longer you sit and type, the more you will slip into a schizophrenia state of mind. Complete the chapters and return to a normal average life!
rows.description_html: Summary 'The Visitor' is a singleplayer first-person phycological-horror game where you play as an author who suffers from a mental illness. She has procrastinated on completing her book and won't get paid until she finishes it. Unfortunately for her, not only is she running out of money, she is also running out of her medication. There are chapters that you are expected to redo in order to get paid. Her medication had allowed her to stay up until a normal time until she felt tired and had to sleep, as her medication drains she has become exhausted far more quickly. This leads to her sleeping more than usual which, since your are almost out of medication and your deadline for your book is closing in, is not a good thing! Since her medication is low you will experience noises, and visions that you normally wouldn't. Are they real? Who knows. Complete the chapters and get paid in order to return to living your average life. Gameplay In 'The Visitor' you will play as an author named Rachel. Your goal is to complete your book chapter by chapter before the deadline that is coming up. You will be running out of medication so you will start to lose touch of reality. The longer you sit and type, the more you will slip into a schizophrenia state of mind. After each completed chapter you will need to get some rest so you get keep a clear mind and continue your book. If writing is too much, take breaks and explore the farmhouse. The further you progress in the game, the more unstable you will become. Key Features AI There are 2 main AI enemies. One will stalk you and one will chase you. Immersive 3D Sound The sound profile is very important. It will guide you to survival and it will create a suspenseful atmosphere. Headphones are highly recommended.

rows.name: Rabbit Hole Chapter 1
rows.short_description: An ancient evil has descended upon the rural town of Rabbit Hole. Now Shaun Turner not only has to untangle a twisted web of supernatural events and mysteries to save his family but also escape from the hellish remains of his hometown.
rows.description_html: You can support us by purchasing the full game on Steam. The full version of the game contains 3 chapters and the continuation of the story. PLOT: Sean Turner came to the small provincial town of Rabbit Hole to see his daughter. When Sean arrives there, he realized that something terrible had happened in that town. There were no people around, but its empty streets were filled with terrible creatures. Now Sean Turner must save his daughter and get out of this hell. But soon he will realize that there is more in this than meets the eye, and the evil he is fighting with has entered our world for a reason. ABOUT THE GAME: The deeper Sean dives into this mysterious adventure, the more shocking circumstances arise. Sean learns the terrible secrets that the townspeople hid behind the walls of their homes. You’ll visit numerous atmospheric locations, solve varied puzzles and most importantly have to survive the attacks of a myriad of dangerous creatures. The plot unfolds rapidly and immerses you in a complex and supernatural story written in all the best traditions of the Survival Horror genre. GAME FEATURES: A Mysterious thriller with a gripping plot. A large atmospheric town with explorable buildings. Alluring graphics and detailed locations. Varied monsters that react to you based on sight and sound. Multiple viable approaches to combat: fight directly or take a stealthy approach. Numerous mysteries and conundrums to solve.

rows.name: Never Immortal
rows.short_description: Never Immortal is a 2D multiplayer topdown shooter with two different exciting gamemodes. Battle with other players against either hordes of zombies in the Wave Survival gamemode, or against each other in the Zombie Mystery gamemode.
rows.description_html: Never Immortal Never Immortal is a 2D multiplayer topdown shooter featuring two different exciting gamemodes: Wave Survival and Zombie Mystery? Wave Survival (PvE) Can be played alone or with friends In the Wave Survival gamemode, you need to survive waves of zombies to avoid being eaten alive. You can try to survive as many waves as you can or you can also try to beat the map. You can also buy weapons, ammo, attachments or grenades in the shop. Every 5 waves you fight a boss. They have a lot of health so make sure to replenish your health and ammo! You can also try to get the Weapon Upgrade machine which will allow you to give your weapon special powers. Zombie Mystery (PvP) Requires a minimum of 3 players, but recommended for 6+ players In this gamemode you have three roles: Human Zombie Detective Humans and the detective have to survive or find and eliminate the zombies. Zombies have to eliminate the humans and the detective. The zombies at first glance look like the humans but they can transform into their zombie form which gives them speed but at the cost of being able to shoot bullets which means they have to kill the others by walking through them.  All players can buy weapons and items in the shop, with money which can be earned by playing the objective and winning. The zombies have exclusive items they can use to help them win. The detective does twice as much damage as the other players and also has exclusive items. Humans and detectives must refrain from killing other humans. Players can identify bodies by pressing 'Q' by default.

rows.name: Ordinary Day
rows.short_description: In this not so ordinary psychological horror your soul is bound from birth to fufil a singular purpose. Suffering a loss that has kicked in motion the bindings of your destiny, enter Ordinary Day.
rows.description_html: Ordinary Day takes place in a fictional town run by The Church. Founded by the early members and quickly swept in darkness as they uncovered the horror contained nearby, clouded and driven by an external force the church enforced their own rules upon the town, driven to rebirth the darkness. You are bound from birth to fufil a singular purpose, it awaits the day your soul is weakened. ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ You return from a party running late in to the night, exhausted with a long drive ahead you set off home. A decision that changed your life and kicked in motion the ever growing darkness lingering in your soul, enter this not so ordinary horror and uncover the shroud of mysteries.

rows.name: Ghouls Of Divinity
rows.short_description: Command a civilization of dancing ghouls in this fast-paced 3D real-time strategy and god simulation game. Utilize physics-based combat with throwable weapons to expand your tribe. Manage resources, cast powerful spells, and eliminate rival ghoul races to achieve total domination.
rows.description_html: Step into the role of a deity in this fast-paced 3D real-time strategy and god simulation game. Command a civilization of ghouls in a swampy fantasy world, utilizing physics-based combat to lead your tribe to victory. Key Features: Lead a Ghoul Civilization Command a variety of ghouls, each with distinct perks. Manage resources like food and mana to expand your tribe. Equip your ghouls with melee or ranged weapons, engaging in dynamic physics-based combat with throwable weapons. Customize and Strategize Influence your ghouls' behavior by distributing skill points across various stats. Tailor your strategy by enhancing specific attributes to suit your playstyle. Unlock new ghoul types and spells as you progress through the game. Conquer and Expand Use powerful spells to support your tribe or hinder your enemies. Construct buildings to produce weapons, generate mana, and expand your control. Face off against rival ghoul tribes and formidable bosses. Level Editor Create your own levels with a powerful, tool-assisted editor. Design levels effortlessly by setting key details—the rest is automatically generated. Gameplay Overview: As a deity, your mission is to grow and lead your ghoul civilization while managing essential resources like food and mana. Your ghouls have their own behaviors but can be guided to gather resources, build structures, and engage enemies. Food allows them to reproduce and pray, generating mana for casting powerful spells. Customize your tribe through a dynamic skill system that lets you enhance specific attributes of your ghouls, influencing their abilities and tactics. Whether you prefer aggressive combat, resource efficiency, or strategic spellcasting, you can tailor your approach to each scenario. Engage in thrilling physics-based combat where every thrown weapon and environmental interaction can change the course of battle. Equip your ghouls with melee weapons or staffs for ranged attacks to your advantage. Use a variety of spells to bolster your ghouls or disrupt your foes, altering the battlefield and influencing the outcome of engagements. Construct buildings to expand your territory, produce weapons, and generate additional mana. Immerse yourself in a vibrant world where strategy and quick thinking are key. Lead your tribe to ultimate supremacy in this unique blend of real-time strategy and god simulation.

There is no combat in BABBDI. Move set : Press space to Jump Press shift to Sprint Press C to Crouch Press C while sprinting to Slide Left Click to Use items Hold Right Click to Zoom Press E to Interact or Throw items. Press F12 to take a screenshot. (screenshots will be saved to your picture folder in addition to the steam screenshots)

rows.name: Chex
rows.short_description: Chex is a strategic board game currently based on Gliński's hexagonal variant of chess. Players must use their pieces to capture their opponent's king. The hexagonal board introduces new challenges and opportunities.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Chex, an exciting new twist on the classic strategy game of chess! In this thrilling game, you'll need to use all of your cunning and strategy to outwit your opponent on the hexagonal board. Each player starts with a set of pieces, each with their own special abilities and movement patterns. You'll need to carefully plan your moves and anticipate your opponent's actions in order to capture their pieces and emerge victorious. But beware! The hexagonal board introduces new challenges and opportunities for your pieces. Diagonal lines of attack are now a possibility, and you'll need to think creatively to navigate the curved borders of the board. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate hexagonal chess master? Play Chex now and find out! -- ChatGPT Features included: * Gliński's hexagonal chess variant * Undo by pressing 'Z' * Win/Loose by a king's death!
