rows.description_html: Experience fast-paced over-the-top multiplayer action in The Showdown Effect: Reloaded. Join players from around the world to engage in high-octane battles filled with bullets, explosions, and one-liners! Hone your skills fighting against unique characters! Choose from a roster of 10 distinct characters, each with their own unique moves and playstyle! Victory hinges on your ability to leverage your character's strengths against your opponents' vulnerabilities. Master the intricacies of each combatant to dominate the showdown and emerge as the champion! Battle across time and space! From a medieval fortress in `Battle of the Bandits` to the bright neon lights of `Downtown Beatdown`, battle across 6 large maps from across time to see who the true champion of the world is! Showcase your style with unique skins for your character and weapons! Make your character your own with millions of possible skin combinations. Customize your character and weapons so you can be victorious in style! Go solo or team up in a variety of game-modes! Change up the experience with 4 different game-modes. Depending on which platform you step on, the speed of movement and jumping power will vary. Don't forget to save your progress by pressing the 'E' key on the island's landmark.
rows.description_html: To celebrate Christmas in 2022! The purpose of this game is to travel through various platforms to the last island. Run to the stable on the last island, enjoying a simple and casual calm song. Depending on which platform you step on, the speed of movement and jumping power will vary. Don't forget to save your progress by pressing the 'E' key on the island's landmark. =Platform= On the desert platform, speed and jump power are greatly reduced On the magma platform, the speed is very low, but the jumping power is greatly increased. On the ice platform, the speed is very high. =Control= W move forward A move left S move backward D move right SPACEBAR j ump =etc= Automatically respawn at -20y height. The character is movable in the air without drag. At the landmark on the center of the island, you can press E key to change the respawn point and it will be marked with a green flag. This game will not be updated for the time being.

rows.name: The Specter Chronicles: Episode 1 - The False Prophet
rows.short_description: The Specter Chronicles is a cyberpunk visual novel that combines text-based adventure with turn-based tactical combat.
rows.description_html: The Specter Chronicles is a cyberpunk visual novel that combines text-based adventure with turn-based tactical combat. You are a Specter, a highly-trained enforcer of the Warden who rules over humanity as a godlike algorithmic entity. You have suffered a severe memory loss during a mission to track down the Prophet, a rebel leader who defies the Warden’s regime. With the help of a neural engineer, you must restore your memories by reliving them. But what will you discover in your own memories? Explore a dystopian world through branching narratives driven by your decisions Are you a brute who decimates everyone and everything that stands in your path? Or are you a smooth operator who prefers to avoid confrontation? The decision is yours. Defeat your opponents using a unique combat system Engage in turn-based combat where you can combine 6 basic attacks into combos, counters, and feints. Tailor your gear to suit your fighting style Install mods into your weapon and armor to infuse unique properties and functions, such as adding bonus points to an attribute or granting a buff during combat. Randomized runs The fragments of memories that you encounter during a run will be randomly drawn, allowing you to revisit the memories that you want and discard the ones that you don’t. This game is for you if you… Enjoy text-based adventures that read like novellas. Are looking for a break from card battlers and typical RPG combat - the combat system in The Specter Chronicles is definitely one-of-a-kind! Are a comic book fan. This game is NOT for you if you… Don’t like text-heavy games. Prefer action-based combat over turn-based combat.

rows.name: Forest of Frequencies
rows.short_description: Forest of Frequencies is a single player music adventure-strategy game where you must guide spirits back to their bodies. Explore a world filled with dangerous creatures and breathtaking flora.
rows.description_html: Step into a world where music, magic and nature collide. Forest of Frequencies is a single player music adventure strategy game where you can explore a world filled with dangerous creatures, breath taking flora and spirits looking for their bodies. Music, visual art & gameplay comes together to form a unique experience made for those who love the interplay and combination of art forms. Features Tune into the power of magical frequencies Effect the world around you with music. Search for magical frequencies using a radio to aid you on your journey. Hypnotise enemies, guide souls and defeat hungry hollow husks all through the power of music. Protector of musical spirits The forest is suffering. Musical spirits have become separated from their bodies and have had to go into hiding to avoid predation. Find these spirits and safely guide them back to their bodies. Dangers of the Forest On your journey you will encounter different enemies that all pose a unique danger. Some can be hypnotised by music, some are drawn to music and others will detune your radio. You must come up with a plan to keep you and the spirits safe. Choose your own path Find your own way through the environment. The clearest path might not be the safest one… or the most adventurous. Breath-taking environment The magic of music has not only affected the creatures within the world but the flora as well. Glowing mushrooms and coral like fungi dot the landscape. Lose yourself in this rich environment. About the team Forest of Frequencies was made within 14 weeks by Dapper Pigeon, a team of 16 students without prior game design or development experience. Everything in the game from models to the music has been produced by the team itself. The team would like to thank everybody who helped during the process of developing our game and of course you the players! Can't wait? Whishlist now to be notified as soon as Forest of Frequencies is released!

rows.name: Force of Nature 2: Prologue
rows.short_description: Force of Nature 2: Prologue is an introduction to the world of the main game. Explore one of the many worlds and uncover its mystery. This game combines the genres of Survival, Sandbox, Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy and Resource Management
rows.description_html: Force of Nature 2: Prologue offers incredible adventures full of mystery in the world of magic and danger. Play through the first world and uncover its secrets. You will have to gather resources, prepare food, build houses and constructions, grow plants and create hybrids, tame and care for animals, craft clothes and weapons, fight enemies and bosses, touch the world of magic, solve the mysteries of the Force of Nature stone, restore the balance of power and find a way to get home. Experience all the main mechanics of the main game and explore the world. This game combines the genres of Survival, Sandbox, Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy and Resource Management. Key features: Procedurally generated world Day/night cycle and dynamic weather Gathering and crafting of items Building of constructions and houses Farming and animals Different biomes Exploration of dungeons Boss fights Storyline with two possible endings Side quests Character customization Plot At the dawn of times, the far stretching lands of this world were empty and uncontrolled. The Ancient Gods were left desolate, with no one to glorify them nor to lead. Combining the power of all elements they created a stone. The Force of Nature. By the use of its power the gods opened the gates to other worlds and resettled different races through there, populating the earth. The power of the Stone was enormous, using magical wind and streams. Making it possible for all walks of life to live in peace and harmony. This lasted for thousands of years, until one day the Stone was destroyed...

rows.name: To the Top
rows.short_description: It's her wish that you climb to the top. It's mine to make you angry doing it.
rows.description_html: an·ger/ˈaNGɡər/: a strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility. I made this game to make you angry. To the Top is a punishing 2D platformer, a short introduction and homage to the 'rage-game' genre. You move left, right, aim with the mouse, and launch yourself onto platforms. That's the game. Throw in an ounce of log-collecting gameplay and a small story and you've got yourself 'To the Top'. With enough time and practice, you can truly fly through the game, climbing your way towards the top of each new challenging area. Or you could fall down over, and over, and over again. Your choice. Leap through new areas with the power of your own legs Indulge in a short, wholesome narrative Listen to soothing piano tracks Make temporary progress with permanent anger Experience the wonderful sensation of rage

rows.name: Battle Support
rows.short_description: The three factions fight for the entire area, build your own army and your two opponents to compete for the area and seize the enemy's supplies You can manage the supplies and troops in your own area Use vehicles and military technology to support your troops and obtain victory.
rows.description_html: • shop You can spend gold coins to open the parts box or spend gold coins to buy supplies • Armory Obtaining parts can be used to upgrade troops, and can also upgrade assets and defensive weapons. • Combat: The skill box will be dropped during the battle. Players need to manually destroy the skill box. After destroying the skill box, a skill will be randomly selected to assist the player. If the opponent still has troops, you can choose to use the remaining troops for your own use or to reward gold coins after killing. After winning the victory, the player can customize how many troops and supplies to deploy. This function will only trigger other modes in the regional battle. • AI: In the setting interface, the player can customize the name and the name of the AI. The AI will randomly attack in a certain direction in the regional battle. The level of the AI unit is random, and the AI ​​is equipped with a random unit. • How to play: Area war gameplay One game in the area is divided into 3 small area, and players need to win all the small area to win. Single player mode There are 3 dots in the middle, whoever steps on the most dots and persists until the end of the game time will win. Offensive and defensive mode The defensive team needs to defend until the end of the time to win, and the offensive team needs to win 3 areas to win. • Area war: There are 2,280 areas in the entire map. Any one of the teams occupying most of the areas will be considered as the strong side, and then the other two teams will be given the option to surrender. If one of the teams does not surrender, they will continue to fight. If they all surrender, the strong side will You can obtain all the troops and materials of the opponent and win the final victory. Players need to occupy all areas to achieve the final victory. Players must not only occupy the area but also consider the strength and materials of each area. If there is a shortage of materials in a certain area, the troops will drop Therefore, the materials must be replenished in time. The deployed troops and materials can be changed at any time. You can also deploy multiple material factories and material warehouses in the area. After the material factories are deployed and produced, the players can choose to allocate them to any area or material warehouse in the material warehouse. There is a lot of storage space to upgrade the factory storage space will also increase accordingly. The material warehouse is used to store materials and cannot be used for supplies. After the final victory, the materials in the material warehouse will be distributed to the players, so players must protect the material warehouse, material factories and materials. Libraries can be moved to any region at any time. • Challenge tasks: The system will generate different tasks every time. The tasks have time limit and no time limit. Players only need to complete the task within the specified time to get rich rewards. If they are dissatisfied with the reward or the task, they can skip it at any time. • Season Pass: There is no time limit for the pass, and the experience value of the pass is upgraded according to the player's playing time. There are a lot of rewards in the pass, including new troops. When the new season is updated, there will be new assets, new units, new maps, etc., and the specific update will notify players through announcements. rows.short_description: Put on your armor, choose a rifle or a shotgun - now you are part of a special forces group. Shoot your way out of a skyscraper full of zombies.
rows.description_html: Fear or desire to survive - which is closer to you? The VR zombie shooter City Z is your way to find out the answer. To get out of the ruins of the City, you will have to walk along the parapet over the abyss, learn to navigate in the dark and shoot hundreds of walking dead. You have no limits other than your own fears. Zombies have no desires other than the desire to kill. Are you ready for such a rehearsal of the apocalypse? Put on your armor, choose a rifle or a shotgun - now you are part of a special forces group. Your mission is to get to the top of the building and stay alive.

rows.short_description: Entasy Online is a free-to-play 2D Action Mmorpg in top down style. Become a hero by saving Entasy World from creatures!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Entasy Online adventurer! Entasy is a fantastic world that has been attacked by creatures. Your goal is saving Entasy World from these creatures and become a hero! Natives of Entasy World needs you. It is a multiplayer game that you may get quests from the characters to accomplish. You will get stronger equipment by defeating creatures in time. You can also buy and sell items on market to get gold or spend. Trade any item you want with players. Features: Use sword, bow, or magic. Get skills points each level and use 20 different skills. Get 2 stat points each level and improve your character. Reset your skill and stat points any time. Full item and equipment system (helmet, chestplate, pants, boots, gloves, shield/rune, necklace, and ring). Complete quests that npcs have. Trade items with players. Add friends to your friend list and enjoy playing with them. Join groups with maximum 4 players. Customize your character (head, hair style, eye, glove, cloth, shoes, sword, bow, staff)

rows.name: TET
rows.short_description: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises.
rows.description_html: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises. TET is a fresh and colorful cooking game. Enter the world of delicious Vietnamese food through a series of mini games. Cut the tofu, wash the cabbage, delicately roll the spring rolls, and discover the secrets of the tasty recipes. TET was created by Charlotte Broccard, a Swiss-Vietnamese illustrator and game designer, with the desire to share her cultural heritage. With special thanks to game developers Etienne Frank, Guillaume Mezino, Mario von Rickenbach, and Michael Frei for their support. Initiated at ECAL, University of Art and Design Lausanne.

rows.name: Ranger Quest: The Elemental Orbs
rows.short_description: Disaster has befallen you, but hope is not lost. Explore the libraries and learn the ancient incantations to unlock the full power of the Elemental Orbs. Completing your epic quest requires a showdown with the evil Grand Mage Marduk in his magical fortress.
rows.description_html: A fantasy story full of magic and intrigue that will transport you to a different time and place. Ranger Quest: The Elemental Orbs is a full length puzzle game consisting of 10 levels, each longer and more challenging than the one before it. Each one of the elemental orbs possesses a magical ability. To unlock these abilities search the libraries to find the ancient spells. You will need to use magic to advance through the levels and challenge Marduk. Activate shrines and be transported between floors. Only by moving back and forth between floors and shifting the walls of the maze will you be able to find the correct path to the exit. Ranger Quest is a 2D top down adventure game that combines exploration with the puzzle aspects of a maze. Navigate your way through each level collecting items to complete your inventory. Reach the door that marks the exit and unlock the next level to be explored. Before starting your quest, make sure to play the prequel story, Ranger Quest: The Adventure Begins. The Minotaur Maze Engine takes a classic 2D Maze and reinvents it by having the walls move. A game designed to be enjoyable and challenging for players of all ages. For anyone who has enjoyed the simple pleasure of completing a maze at some point in their lives. The Minotaur Maze Engine brings the classic maze into the 21st century. Developed with the Godot game engine. Music and sound effects obtained from ZapSplat. The Minotaur Maze Engine. The maze where the walls move.

rows.name: Wild Americas
rows.short_description: Chisel away a destructible landscape gathering minerals to craft bigger and better explosives in search of a priceless geological oddity.
rows.description_html: Armed with advanced GPR scanning equipment, players will have to employ their wit and expertise to catalog the island's natural resources, all while uncovering hidden conspiracies and schemes behind secret experiments, ancient artifacts, and old tales. Navigate treacherous terrain, climb rocky extensions, and delve deep into the island's underground network of caves and tunnels.

rows.name: Dodd Goes to the Museum
rows.short_description: Explore Dodd's local museum in this short and sweet, casual and relaxing side-scroller adventure! Visit various exhibits within the museum's four wings and talk to various characters along the way!
rows.description_html: Explore Dodd's local museum in this short and sweet, casual and relaxing side-scroller adventure game! Visit various exhibits within the museum's four wings as you: talk to various characters around the museum! collect stray weevils! clean up the museum! Enjoy the atmosphere! The game itself is meant to be in the style of a simple point-and-click game, but with the approach of a side-scroller character interacting with the environment. W/A/S/D (or your keyboard equivalent) or Arrow Keys
